advance_feats.description: \- You spend 2 PP or 2 MP, depending on the required roll, to try a failed roll again without penalty.
advance_feats.name: Concentrate Retry

advance_feats.description: \- You are aware of some conspiracies. Three of them are fake, and one is real. Gain +1 to rolls to resist torture.
advance_feats.name: Conspiracy Theorist

advance_feats.description: You’ve been programmed with dormant corporate training. Once per session, you can access this training to gain temporary proficiency in a Stat (e.g., etiquette, hacking) for 1 hour. Afterward, you suffer a headache or flashback, imposing disadvantage of -2 on your next roll.
advance_feats.name: Corpo Sleeper

advance_feats.description: You understand the fragile minds of those on the edge of cyberpsychosis. Once per session, you can calm or manipulate someone suffering from cyberpsychosis for 1d4 rounds. If you fail, they become hostile toward you specifically.
advance_feats.name: Cyberpsychosis Whisperer

advance_feats.description: You’ve spent enough time in the ruins of the Old Net to pick up fragments of its code. Once per session, you can “glitch” a modern system by injecting Old Net protocols. The system behaves unpredictably for 1d4 rounds (e.g., doors lock/unlock randomly, drones attack allies, or holograms display cryptic messages).
advance_feats.name: Echoes of Old Net

advance_feats.description: You know how to operate flying vehicles.
advance_feats.name: Fly License

advance_feats.description: You gain a +1 bonus to social interactions with members of your species.
advance_feats.name: Handsome

advance_feats.description: You carry a portable holographic projector that can alter your appearance. Once per session, you can disguise yourself as someone else for 10 minutes. The disguise is convincing at a distance but falls apart under close scrutiny.
advance_feats.name: Holographic Disguise

advance_feats.description: Choose a specialization in one of your Stats. For example, you can take Dexterity (Acrobatics) as a specialization and you will have a +1 bonus to any roll on Acrobatics. You can't take more than one specialization per Stat. This feat can be taken 8 times.
advance_feats.name: Jack of Trade

advance_feats.description: You have a knack for finding useful items in trash or scrap piles. Once per session, you can scavenge a random piece of simple gear or tech.
advance_feats.name: Junk Collector

advance_feats.description: \- You know secret streets and corners of The City. It gives you a +1 bonus to escape pursuit.
advance_feats.name: Know the City

advance_feats.description: - You can create and abuse a special drug created by you. You work with the GM on what this drug does.
advance_feats.name: Modern Alchemist

advance_feats.description: You’ve mastered the art of augmented reality graffiti. Once per session, you can tag a location with AR graffiti that only certain devices can see. The tag can convey a hidden message, mark a location, or distract observers.
advance_feats.name: Neon Graffiti Artist

advance_feats.description: - You are part of a small music band. This band has access to a minibus, acoustic system, and stage clothes. You can earn money or try to sneak into a place as a band member.
advance_feats.name: Part of the Band

advance_feats.description: \- You can shoot from a moving vehicle without penalty.
advance_feats.name: Reckless Driving

advance_feats.description: You know how to operate seafaring vehicles.
advance_feats.name: Sea License

advance_feats.description: You have a knack for finding people who owe you favors. Once per session, you can call in a minor favor from a contact (e.g., a bouncer, a hacker, or a street vendor). The favor is limited in scope and might come with strings attached.
advance_feats.name: Shadow Broker

advance_feats.description: Your limit for using Stims becomes 4.
advance_feats.name: Stim Junkie

advance_feats.description: You know how to navigate the underworld. Gain +1 to rolls when dealing with gangs, black-market dealers, or other criminal elements.
advance_feats.name: Streetwise

advance_feats.description:
Your body language says it all.

- While not attacking, target rolls Body vs your **Charisma + Body** to make enemies think twice.
- On success, **target must pass a Willpower roll to act against you** next turn.  
    **Cost:** PP. **Reaction.**
advance_feats.name: "Try Me" Face

advance_feats.description: You inject an adrenaline stimulant into an ally to enhance their physical performance. The target gains +1 to all Body rolls for the next 3 rounds. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Adrenal Boost

advance_feats.description: Gain 2 arcanist psy powers of 1 rank.
advance_feats.name: Arcanist Spells

advance_feats.description: Reduce the Dexterity and Intuition penalty of wearing armor by 1.
advance_feats.name: Armor Specialist

advance_feats.description: If you're wielding a weapon with a scope, you can use your turn to guide an ally's shot. Shoot the target; after that, the ally gains +1 to their ranged attack **against this target. Action. Costs PP.**
advance_feats.name: Assist Fire

advance_feats.description: You can leave your body to scout ahead. Roll Willpower vs Difficulty to leave and to return to your body. While astral projecting, your physical body can't protect itself. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Astral Projection

advance_feats.description: You can try to create an Alpha augment or augment feat. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. This augment has +1 feat slot. Costs MP
advance_feats.name: Aug Inventor

advance_feats.description: You can give your drone a simple command which it will follow. Can be used on one drone. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Automatic

advance_feats.description:
You’ve mastered the art of calming patients—even when they're bleeding out.

- Gain **+2 to social rolls** when speaking to someone who is injured, sick, or recently healed by you.
- Once per Rest, you can **convince someone to trust you** as a medic, even under suspicion or stress.
advance_feats.name: Bedside Manner

advance_feats.description:
You have a growing archive of dirt on people.

- Once per session, if you've hacked someone or their organization before, you can **gain leverage** on them.
- Gain **advantage (roll twice, take better)** on the next Charisma or Intellect-based social roll against that target.  
    **Requires:** Prior hack or research. **No cost.**
advance_feats.name: Blackmail Database

advance_feats.description: You can protect an ally within the current Zone. As a Reaction, you can take the damage from an attack that hits an ally. Costs PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Bodyguard

advance_feats.description: You can break through simple or standard walls. If you break through a standard wall, roll Body vs Difficulty. Costs PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Breaker

advance_feats.description: When you land a melee critical hit, you may immediately make a second melee attack with -2 to hit. **Reaction.**
advance_feats.name: Brutal Follow-up

advance_feats.description: If you dodge a ranged attack, you can immediately move up to a short distance. Costs PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Bullet Step

advance_feats.description:
With a single look, you can shut someone up.

- Roll Body vs the target's Willpower.
- On success, they become Nervous and suffer **-1 to all social rolls** against you for 10 minutes.  
    **Cost:** PP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Cold Glare

advance_feats.description: You can collect bounty for certain targets (gang leaders, other mercs, etc.).
advance_feats.name: Collect Bounty

advance_feats.description: The first time you are attacked each combat, gain a +2 bonus to dodge. **No cost.** **Passive.**
advance_feats.name: Combat Intuition

advance_feats.description: You can quickly improvise a disguise using available materials. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Convincing Disguise

advance_feats.description: Gain 2 curser psy powers of 1 rank.
advance_feats.name: Curser Spells

advance_feats.description: You can move to an adjacent Zone without provoking attacks of opportunity. Costs PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Dash Step

advance_feats.description: You gain a +2 bonus to online social interactions with other hackers and deep web nerds.
advance_feats.name: Deep Web Speak

advance_feats.description: You can temporarily disable one augment. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. Costs MP. Lasts 3 rounds. On failure or success, the target is immune to this ability for 1 hour. Action
advance_feats.name: Disable

advance_feats.description: You disarm your opponent. Roll Range or Melee vs Difficulty. Costs PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Disarm

advance_feats.description: You are a member of a local Dojo. You have access to Dojo inventory and contacts. You can also hide in the Dojo and train in it.
advance_feats.name: Dojo

advance_feats.description: Reload both weapons, one in each hand. Action. Costs PP.
advance_feats.name: Double Reload

advance_feats.description: You can craft drones and drone feats. You gain a +1 bonus to operate drones that you created. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty Costs MP.
advance_feats.name: Drone Creator

advance_feats.description:
You can fire guns from both hands with -1 penalty. Action and Reaction.

Xerm can use this feat with two two-handed guns.
advance_feats.name: Dual Wielding

advance_feats.description:
You can lightly tap into a person’s surface emotions.

- Once per scene, you may roll **Intuition vs Difficulty** to **learn a creature’s current emotional state**.
- Gain **+2 to persuasion or deception rolls** when acting in line with their feelings.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Empathic Whisper

advance_feats.description: You can encrypt a file or system to prevent hacking or unauthorized access. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty On success, the encryption lasts for 1 hour, making it harder for enemies to access the protected system. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Encrypt

advance_feats.description: You always have access to a forged ID that can pass basic inspections. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty if scrutinized. Costs MP. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Fake Credentials

advance_feats.description: You pretend to know what you are talking about. Roll Charisma vs Difficulty. On success, the target thinks that you are actually proficient in the things you are talking about. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Fake It Till You Make It
advance_feats.namel: fake it till you make it

advance_feats.description: You can craft an item in 1 turn. It lasts until the end of the next turn. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Fast Crafting

advance_feats.description:
You know a guy.

- Once per session, you can **contact an underground connection** for illegal goods, info, or temporary backup.
- Roll Charisma vs Difficulty to determine success and quality of help.  
    **Free Action.**
advance_feats.name: Fixer Contacts

advance_feats.description: If you have an ally within immediate range of a target, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls against that target. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Flanking Bonus

advance_feats.description: You can concentrate fire on a single target. When you attack the same target twice in a row, you gain a +1 bonus to hit and damage to your second attack. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Focused Fire

advance_feats.description:
You can stall, confuse, or distract someone long enough to avoid consequences.

- Roll **Charisma vs Difficulty**. On success, you delay suspicion or pursuit for 1 round/scene.
- Useful in cons, escapes, or distracting guards.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Getaway Talker

advance_feats.description: You can throw grenades with precision. Gain +1 to attack rolls when throwing grenades. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Grenade Mastery

advance_feats.description: You make a wide low strike. All enemies in immediate range roll Dexterity vs your Melee. On a failure, they fall Prone. **Cost:** PP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Ground Sweep

advance_feats.description:
You can read body language and shady intentions.

- Gain **+2 to rolls detecting lies, setups, or ambushes** in social settings.
- Once per scene, you can **reroll a failed Intuition/Perception check** against someone's motive.
advance_feats.name: Gutter Instincts

advance_feats.description: You and up to 2 allies in the same Zone gain +1 to rolls to resist being pushed, tripped, or moved against your will for 1 round. **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Hold the Line

advance_feats.description: If caught stealing, lying, or sneaking, you can immediately attempt to flee or talk your way out of it with a +1 bonus. Costs PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Hustler’s Reflex

advance_feats.description: You can adjust or fine-tune a minor augment on a target. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. On success, the augment is temporarily optimized for the next 3 rounds, providing a +1 bonus to all rolls involving that augment. Costs MP. Action
advance_feats.name: Implant Adjustment

advance_feats.description: You gain access to Inner Circle, a special market for hackers where you can easily sell information and illegal items.
advance_feats.name: Inner Circle

advance_feats.description: You can use Charisma instead of Body for Intimidation rolls.
advance_feats.name: Intimidating Words

advance_feats.description: You mark one target as Prey. If you are the one who kills this target, you gain an extra Action on your next turn and all targets have a -1 penalty to all rolls against you. You can have one Prey per combat. Action. Costs MP.
advance_feats.name: Mark as Prey

advance_feats.description: You gain a +1 bonus to rolls against psychic attacks or mind-affecting abilities. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Mental Fortress

advance_feats.description: You can delve into a person's mind to gain information. Roll Willpower vs Difficulty. On success, you learn the target's surface thoughts or one piece of information they are actively thinking about. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Mind Probe

advance_feats.description: When you take Health damage, you can choose to convert it into Shock damage (you choose how much). Costs MP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Mind Shield

advance_feats.description:
You know how to present your augmentations as style statements.

- Gain **+1 to Charisma-based rolls** when interacting with characters who appreciate augments.
- Once per scene, you can **impress, distract, or disarm** a target by showcasing or talking about your augments.
advance_feats.name: Mod Chic

advance_feats.description:
You’ve built a recognizable (or infamous) digital identity.

- Gain **+2 to social interactions** with anyone who recognizes your handle in cyberspace (deep web forums, hacker spaces, info brokers).
- Once per session, you can **intimidate or persuade** someone online by referencing your reputation.
advance_feats.name: Net Persona

advance_feats.description: You can create interference to temporarily disrupt enemy electronic communications. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty On success, all enemy drones or electronic devices within your Zone have disadvantage on their next action. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Network Jammer

advance_feats.description: You can try to create a simple armor, simple weapon, armor feat, or weapon feat. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. If it's armor or weapon, it has 1 feat slot. Costs MP
advance_feats.name: Novice Craftier

advance_feats.description: You can copy someone else's voice. Roll Charisma vs Difficulty. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Parrot

advance_feats.description: You can open locks without leaving evidence. Roll Dexterity vs Difficulty. Costs PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Perfect Crime

advance_feats.description: When you suppress an enemy (via Suppressive Fire or overwatch), an ally may **immediately attack** that enemy with +1d8 damage if in range. **Cost:** PP. **Reaction.**
advance_feats.name: Pin & Burn

advance_feats.description: You can discreetly place an item on another person or location. Roll Dexterity vs target’s Perception. Costs PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Planted Evidence

advance_feats.description:
You are nearly impossible to read.

- You gain **+2 to resist Insight or Intuition rolls** against you.
- You automatically pass as honest unless someone has a specific reason to doubt you.
advance_feats.name: Poker Face

advance_feats.description: You can craft programmz, and you gain a +1 bonus when using created programmz. Roll an Intellect check against Difficulty and costs MP.
advance_feats.name: Programmz Wizard

advance_feats.description: You can sense psychic energy in the area around you. When you concentrate, you can detect the presence of psychic individuals or psionically active areas within a 100-meter radius. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Psychic Sensitivity

advance_feats.description: You can decrypt a basic encrypted file or system in 1 round, plus you gain a +1 bonus to it. Roll an Intellect check against Difficulty. On success, you recover the full contents of the file or system. Costs MP and is an Action.
advance_feats.name: Quick Decryption

advance_feats.description: At the start of combat, you draw a weapon and attack a target. Costs PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Quick Draw

advance_feats.description: You can temporarily repair a broken or damaged piece of equipment or cybernetic implant. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. On success, the item or implant works as if it were fully functional. Costs MP. Action
advance_feats.name: Quick Fix

advance_feats.description: You can conceal small objects (like weapons, tools, or chips) on your person. Roll Dexterity vs Difficulty. On success, scanners and searches do not detect the item. Costs PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Quick Palming

advance_feats.description: You spend your Action to try to dodge the next attack. You gain a +2 bonus on the next dodge roll. Action.
advance_feats.name: Quicksilver Dodge

advance_feats.description: You can quickly inject a stim or healing agent into an ally as a Reaction to prevent a critical status effect. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. On success, restore 2 Health and 2 Shock, and negate the next condition that would otherwise be applied to the target. Costs MP. Reaction
advance_feats.name: Rapid Injection

advance_feats.description: You can redirect suspicion to another target when being investigated or accused. Roll Charisma vs Difficulty. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Red Herring

advance_feats.description: You can try to reflect a ranged attack. Roll Dexterity vs target's Difficulty. On success, you deflect the projectile back to the attacker. Costs PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Reflect Projectile

advance_feats.description: If you use one of your Actions (not Movement) to move to an adjacent Zone and if you end your movement near a target, you can attack this target as part of your same action. Action. Costs PP.
advance_feats.name: Run and Hit

advance_feats.description: You enter Rush Stance and attack twice dealing 1d4 damage and gain a +1 bonus to dodge melee attacks. Action. Stance.
advance_feats.name: Rush Stance

advance_feats.description: You created a secret language that you can use as a cipher. You can teach this language to anyone you want. Roll Intellect to determine difficulty of deciphering. It takes approximately 2 hours to do it.
advance_feats.name: Secret Language

advance_feats.description: You can concentrate and see another person's aura. Roll Intuition vs Difficulty. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Seen Aura

advance_feats.description: When standing adjacent to an ally, both you and the ally gain +1 Armor until one of you moves away. **No Cost.** **Passive.**
advance_feats.name: Shield Wall

advance_feats.description: Temporarily power off a system for 10 minutes. Costs 2 Shock. Cannot be used for 1 hour after use. Action.
advance_feats.name: Shock the System

advance_feats.description: You slam into a nearby opponent. This ability has medium range. Roll Strength vs Body. On success, the target is pushed back to an adjacent Zone, loses their Reaction for the next 2 rounds, and takes 1d6+1 damage. **Cost:** PP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Shoulder Check

advance_feats.description:
You radiate a calming psychic field that eases tension.

- Gain **+2 to social rolls** made to calm down frightened or angry NPCs.
- Once per session, you can **end a hostile negotiation or panic scene nonviolently**, unless supernatural/psyonic forces are involved.
advance_feats.name: Soft Presence

advance_feats.description:
You speak fluent merc.

- When talking to other combatants, guards, mercs, or soldiers, you get **a +1 bonus to Charisma-based interactions**.
- You can **calm nervous fighters**, or **rile them up** depending on your approach.
advance_feats.name: Squad Talk

advance_feats.description: If an ally in your Zone is broken down to 0 Health or 0 Shock, you can stabilize them with 1 Health or 1 Shock. Costs PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Stabilize

advance_feats.description:
You know how to drop the right names and act like you belong.

- Gain **+2 to social rolls** when dealing with criminal, black market, or street-level NPCs.
- Once per Rest, you can **name-drop a fictional connection** to gain brief access or trust.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Street Cred

advance_feats.description:
People on the street know you.

- Gain **+1 bonus to social rolls** when dealing with gangs, hustlers, fixers, or anyone from the slums.
- Once per session, you can **call in a minor favor** from a street contact (e.g., info, distraction, or a hideout).
advance_feats.name: Street Reputation

advance_feats.description:
You lie with soldier's confidence.

- Gain **+2 to Deception** rolls when bluffing about threats, violence, or combat knowledge.
- On critical success, target may **hesitate to act** for 1 turn in combat.
advance_feats.name: Tactical Bluff

advance_feats.description: If an ally successfully hits a target in melee, you gain +2 to your next attack against the same target this round. **No Cost.** **Passive.**
advance_feats.name: Tag Team

advance_feats.description: Gain +1d4+2 damage for the next attack. Costs PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Target Vital Organs

advance_feats.description: You can move small objects with your mind. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty to lift, push, or manipulate objects that are no heavier than 10 kg. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Telekinesis (Basic)

advance_feats.description:
Your psychic awareness helps you pick up on subtle cues.

- Gain **+1 to social rolls** involving lies, hidden emotions, or spiritual beings.
- Once per session, you may **ask the GM one true thing** about an NPC’s secret intentions or aura.
advance_feats.name: Third Eye Insight

advance_feats.description: You enter Thug Stance and your unarmed attacks deal 1d8+1 damage, but you gain a -1 penalty to dodge attacks. Action. Stance.
advance_feats.name: Thug Stance

advance_feats.description:
Your way of helping is rough but effective.

- When you use a social roll to rally, calm, or push an ally, they get **+2 to their next action** but take **1 Shock**.
- No cost. Once per ally per Rest.
advance_feats.name: Tough Love

advance_feats.description: You can make Toxins. Roll Intellect.
advance_feats.name: Toxin Maker

advance_feats.description:
You're adept at provocation and manipulation via text or speech.

- Gain **+1 bonus to deception, baiting, or arguing** in online or AR chat interactions.
- Once per scene, you can **confuse or fluster a target**, imposing **-2 to their next action**.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Troll Logic

advance_feats.description: If you completely hack a system, you can leave a simple virus. Roll an Intellect check against Difficulty. Costs MP and is a Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Virus

advance_feats.description:
Your voice gets attention in a crowd.

- You can **draw attention** from anyone within a large area (street, room, crowd) to deliver a short message.
- Enemies must **roll Intuition vs Charisma** or pause what they’re doing to listen.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Voice Like a Fight Bell

advance_feats.description: You can run against a wall. Costs PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Wall Run

advance_feats.description:
Your violent reputation precedes you.

- When you enter a scene, you may **roll Charisma + Body vs Difficulty** to cause **Intimidated** status to one NPC for 1 hour.
- Intimidated characters avoid conflict with you unless provoked.  
    **Free Action. Once per Rest.**
advance_feats.name: War Reputation

advance_feats.description: Choose one weapon type (e.g., pistols, rifles, melee weapons). You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls with that weapon. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Weapon Proficiency

advance_feats.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your defense against hacking.
advance_feats.name: White Hat

advance_feats.description: You don't have a -2 penalty when trying to heal members of another species. Action.
advance_feats.name: Xenobiology

advance_feats.description: Gain 2 yellow priest psy powers of 1 rank.
advance_feats.name: Yellow Priest Spells

advance_feats.description: You predict the enemy's next action. Roll Intuition vs target's Difficulty. Costs MP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Your next move will be

advance_feats.description:
- Your sheer presence clears a path.
- **Effect:** Roll **Strength** instead of Charisma for **Intimidation** against weaker targets.
- **Bonus:** On success, targets **flee or freeze for 1 round** (Willpower vs 12 to resist).
advance_feats.name: "I Said Move."

advance_feats.description:
- Your hollow gaze triggers primal fear.
- **Effect:** When you stare silently at a target, they must roll **Willpower vs 12** or **flee for 1 round**. Must be in ghost form.
advance_feats.name: "You Should Run Now"

advance_feats.description: You can spit acid from your mouth. It is a light short-range weapon which ignores armor and deals 1d4+1 H damage. Costs PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Acidic spit

advance_feats.description: Gain +1 to rolls for trying to pass as a local. You easily adapt to new environments and places.
advance_feats.name: Adaptive

advance_feats.description:
Choose a Social skill (Persuasion, Intimidation, Deception).

You gain +2 bonus to that skill when speaking through a Husk or device that uses a voice or face filter.

Passive.
advance_feats.name: Adaptive Personality Layer

advance_feats.description: You gain access to the Anarchist market and you can use their hideout.
advance_feats.name: Anarchist connections

advance_feats.description: You transform yourself into an animal. Cost PP and Health. Action.
advance_feats.name: Animal Form

advance_feats.description: You can animate a cut-out part of your body. You can control this part for the next 1 hour. Cost MP and Health. Action.
advance_feats.name: Animate Body Part

advance_feats.description: Gain +1 bonus on crafting rolls.
advance_feats.name: Architects of the future

advance_feats.description: You are really good at pissing off other species. Roll Charisma vs target's difficulty. Target must be from another species. On success, target's next action must be a simple attack on you. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Arrogant

advance_feats.description: You ask a friendly animal for a favor in exchange for a reward (usually food). The animal will try to do this favor to the best of its abilities but won't put itself in serious danger. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Ask for a Favor

advance_feats.description: Your thick dwarven beard provides some protection. Gain +1 to Armor when hit by attacks targeting your head or face. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Beard of Steel

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Action — roleplay/utility  
**Cost:** none  
**Effect:** You can name one simple ritual, custom motion, phrase, or minor cultural action you learned from your dragon donor (e.g., a salute, a rhythmic tapping). Use it to call a small favor from one NPC who recognizes it (safely framed: a contact, an informant, a specific type of cultist).  
**Uses/Cooldown:** once per Rest.
advance_feats.name: Beast-Recall

advance_feats.description: If you are hit by a melee attack with a weapon, you can try to disarm your attacker. Roll Strength vs the roll of the hit; on success, the weapon is held by your body. If someone tries to take the weapon from you, they must roll Strength vs your Strength+3. You still take damage from the hit. Reaction. Cost PP.
advance_feats.name: Bite on Weapon

advance_feats.description: You destroy the husk you currently inhabit. It deals 1d8+4 damage to targets in the current Zone; they must roll Dexterity to dodge this damage. You are ejected from the husk into a USB drive; allies in medium range can catch you using a Reaction. Action. Cost MP and Shock.
advance_feats.name: Bitter Goodbye

advance_feats.description: You teleport within the current Zone; to teleport, you need to see your destination. This doesn't provoke attacks of opportunity. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Blink

advance_feats.description:
You can put a parasite or symbiote into a target; roll Intellect vs the target's Difficulty. Cost MP and Health.

1\. Parasite - Target takes 1d4 damage every time that it attacks you or disobeys a direct order. It also has a -1 penalty to rolls against you.

2\. Symbiote - Target deals an additional +2 damage against the same enemy that you attack. Target also has a +1 bonus to rolls correspondin
advance_feats.name: Blood Bond

advance_feats.description: When you drain blood from your victim you can make them blood-bound. Cost Health and MP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Blood-bound

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Action — exploration/narrative  
**Cost:** MP  
**Effect:** Call upon a whispered memory of your dragon donor. The GM gives you one short sensory hint useful to the scene (e.g., “this wall was altered recently,” “this alloy hums in frequencies matching your bloodline,” or a cryptic phrase) — useful as a clue, not direct solution.  
**Uses/Cooldown:** once per hour.
advance_feats.name: Bloodline Echo

advance_feats.description:
- Your past battles speak for you.
- **Effect:** **+2** to Intimidation against those who recognize your faction/unit.
- **Bonus:** Once per session, **invoke your rep to avoid a fight**.
advance_feats.name: Bloodstained Reputation

advance_feats.description: When you get hit, your body reacts in defense and throws bone spikes at the attacker. Roll Body vs target's difficulty, on success attacker takes 1d4 H damage. Those spikes are a short-range weapon. Cost PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Bone Spikes

advance_feats.description:
You enter a state of rampage:
Your attacks deal an extra 1d4+2 damage
Your dodge takes a -1 penalty
You gain 1 point of armor  
On critical miss you attack allies  
  
Cost MP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Born to Kill

advance_feats.description:
*You know how to attach what was never yours.*

- **Effect:** As an **Action**, you may harvest a recently dead humanoid body part that includes a **bio-augment or mechanical augment**. You may stitch this part onto yourself over 1 minute.
- You gain **+1** to a relevant Physical Stat (determined by the GM) for the rest of the day.
- You cannot stitch more than **1 part at a time** this way. Addin
advance_feats.name: Borrowed Flesh

advance_feats.description:
*That arm wasn’t yours anyway.*

- **Effect:** If you've stitched on a limb from a creature larger than you, you gain +1 to your **Strength rolls** and **melee damage** while using that limb.
- If it gets destroyed or you lose it, the bonus goes away until you replace it.
- Action
advance_feats.name: Borrowed Strength

advance_feats.description: You make a command in the eldritch tongue; the target must roll Charisma vs 12. On a failure, the target becomes friendly and helpful. In combat, their difficulty is 10. Action. Cost MP.
advance_feats.name: Bounding Tongue

advance_feats.description: You make a command in the eldritch tongue; the target must roll Willpower vs 12. On a failure, the target falls prone. It must use 2 Actions to get up. Action. Cost MP.
advance_feats.name: Bow Before Me

advance_feats.description: You have wings, which you can use to break your fall. Roll Dexterity vs Difficulty.
advance_feats.name: Broken wings

advance_feats.description: If you move at least one Zone before attacking, your first melee hit in that turn deals +1d4 bonus damage.
advance_feats.name: Brutal Charge

advance_feats.description: When you are about to enter a dangerous situation (for example, an ambush), you get a small vague premonition. Can happen 1 or 2 times per Rest.
advance_feats.name: Care of All-Mother

advance_feats.description: You try to charm a target. Roll Charisma vs target difficulty. On success, the target will carry out one simple task for you. Target must be friendly to you, Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Charming voice

advance_feats.description: You can sense the passage of time with uncanny accuracy. Gain +1 to rolls involving timing, such as disarming a timed device or coordinating a precise action. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Chrono Sense

advance_feats.description:
- Your family name carries weight in dwarf circles.
- **Effect:** Other dwarves treat you with **+1 Social standing** by default.
- **Bonus:** Once per session, call in a **minor favor** (free lodging, gear repair, info).
advance_feats.name: Clan Loyalty

advance_feats.description: You have +2 bonus to resist attempts to manipulate you by emotion.
advance_feats.name: Cold Metal Heart

advance_feats.description: Next time you fall asleep, you arrive in Dreamland, where you can talk with All-Mother. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Communicate with All-Mother

advance_feats.description:
*Even when your mind fractures, you grip a moment of clarity.*

- **Trigger:** When your Shock is about to fall to 0 or below.
- **Effect:** Delay entering an extreme condition by **1 round**.
- During that round, gain **+2 to one Mental Stat roll** of your choice.
- Afterward, unless Shock is back above 0, the breakdown happens normally.
- **Type:** Reaction.
- **Cost:** 1 MP.
advance_feats.name: Controlled Collapse

advance_feats.description: You can try to convince machines such as cameras, drones, or turrets to stop attacking or recording you. Roll Charisma vs Intellect. On success, the target stops doing that until it's restarted or fixed by a hacker. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Convince Machine

advance_feats.description:
You were raised among power and etiquette.

- Gain **+1 to Persuasion or Diplomacy** when interacting with nobility, executives, or higher-ups.
- Additionally, you never suffer penalties from etiquette missteps.  
    **Passive.**
advance_feats.name: Courtly Training

advance_feats.description: Your attention to detail makes you an expert at crafting. Gain +1 to rolls involving crafting. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Craftsman’s Eye

advance_feats.description: You can use your looks to scare others. Roll Body vs target’s difficulty. On success, target has a -1 penalty to its To Hit rolls for 2 rounds. Costs PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Creepy

advance_feats.description: When you get grabbed by someone, this someone takes 1d6+1 damage at the end of each turn while grabbing you. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Dangerous Spikes

advance_feats.description:
Opened Third Eye. Mark a target you can see. You always know their location for the next 2 hours, even through walls or distance.  
**Action. Cost MP. Once per Rest.**
advance_feats.name: Dark Tether

advance_feats.description:
You can absorb data from dead machines (destroyed husks, drones, terminals).

When doing so, regain 1 MP and 1 Shock, and learn a small detail from the machine’s memory (GM decides).

Action. Once per Rest.
advance_feats.name: Data Eater

advance_feats.description: You blind your opponent with bright lights. Roll Body vs target's difficulty. On success, the target has a -2 penalty to hit rolls until the end of its turn. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Dazzling light

advance_feats.description:
- You always know who owes what—and how to collect.
- **Effect:** **+2** to Intimidation when calling in a favor or debt.
- **Bonus:** If they refuse, they suffer **-1 to rolls against you** until they pay up.
advance_feats.name: Debt Collector’s Smile

advance_feats.description:
You’ve started hearing names in your sleep—sometimes strangers, sometimes enemies. Once per Session, you may declare that you **“know something you shouldn't”** about an NPC or minor enemy—GM must give a detail that gives you narrative leverage.  
**Passive.**
advance_feats.name: Devil Knows Your Name

advance_feats.description: Your legal cunning is unmatched. You gain +3 to rolls for Legal Lore or any legal negotiations. Additionally, you can rewrite a contract on the fly to include hidden clauses, undetectable without a roll against your Intellect.
advance_feats.name: Devil's Advocate

advance_feats.description: Your infernal heritage grants you unnatural luck. Once per session, you can reroll a failed roll, but you must accept the new result, even if it is worse. Cost MP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Devil's Luck

advance_feats.description: Your silver tongue is as sharp as your horns. Gain +1 to rolls involving deception, persuasion, or intimidation.
advance_feats.name: Devil's Tongue

advance_feats.description: You can communicate with a sleeping or unconscious creature, whispering into their dreams. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Dreamspeaking

advance_feats.description: Gain +2 Health and +2 PP.
advance_feats.name: Dwarf Hardness

advance_feats.description: You can drink abysmal amounts of alcohol and you don't get drunk. You gain +2 to rolls to resist being intoxicated. Also, you take only half damage (rounded down) from drinking toxins.
advance_feats.name: Dwarf blood

advance_feats.description: Your connection to the earth gives you a sense of your surroundings. Gain +1 to Perception rolls to detect vibrations, hidden enemies, or structural weaknesses. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Earthsense

advance_feats.description:
**Opened Third Eye.** You choose an ally in the same Zone. Until your next turn, when they take damage, the attacker takes psychic feedback equal to half the damage (rounded down).  
**Cost MP. Action.**
advance_feats.name: Echo of Pain

advance_feats.description:
You tap into the instinct of the many.  
  
Effect: For 1 turn, gain +1 to Dodge and +1 to hit if you’re standing adjacent to at least one ally or friendly creature.  
  
Cost: MP.  
  
Type: Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Echo of the Herd

advance_feats.description: You emit a bioluminescent aura at will, providing dim light in a small radius. You can use this to distract enemies (-1 penalty to their Perception rolls). Action.
advance_feats.name: Eerie Glow

advance_feats.description:
Even in silence, you influence the room.

- When you enter a scene or are the center of attention, you may choose to roll **Charisma vs DC 10**.
- On success, gain **+1 to all social rolls** during this interaction.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.** Once per scene.
advance_feats.name: Elegant Presence

advance_feats.description: If you've been targeted by a curse, you can amp your magical defenses to give a -1 penalty to the enemy caster. Cost PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Elvish Resistance

advance_feats.description: If your Shock would become 0, instead it becomes 1. Passive. Once per Rest.
advance_feats.name: Emergency Protocols

advance_feats.description: You emulate subtle emotional responses—pauses, nervous laughter, eye movement—that convince others you're "real." Gain advantage on your first Deception or Persuasion roll during a conversation. Reaction. Cost MP. Once per social interaction.
advance_feats.name: Emotion Emulator

advance_feats.description: Everyone in medium range feels a strong feeling of your choice. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Empathy Overload

advance_feats.description: You possess a deep, coded sense of ethics or a unique directive (e.g., "Protect all free AIs", or "Destroy corporate lies"). When pursuing this cause, gain +1 to Mental rolls tied to it. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Encrypted Conscience

advance_feats.description:
Opened Third Eye. You cause intense mental pressure. Target suffers **disadvantage on their next Mental Stat roll**.  
**Action. Cost MP.**
advance_feats.name: Eye of Pain

advance_feats.description:
- Your deals always have hidden clauses.
- **Effect:** When making an agreement, you can **embed a subconscious command**. If the target breaks the deal, they suffer **-1 to all rolls** until they fulfill it.
advance_feats.name: Fae Bargain

advance_feats.description: You upload a fake version of yourself into technology or a husk; it imitates activity. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Fake Double

advance_feats.description: You gain 1 extra XP after completing a job.
advance_feats.name: Fast learner

advance_feats.description: You re-roll failures on resisting fear-based effects. Cost MP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Fearless

advance_feats.description: You gain +1 bonus on Intimidation rolls.
advance_feats.name: Fearsome reputation

advance_feats.description:
You draw energy from decay and fungus.  
  
Effect: In an area with corpses, rot, or heavy fungus, you may regain 1d6 Health or 1d4 Shock.  
  
Limitation: Can only be used once per Rest.  
  
Cost: PP.  
  
Type: Action.
advance_feats.name: Feast of Moss and Bone

advance_feats.description:
You lash out through a cybernetic feedback loop.  
  
Trigger: When a machine-based enemy damages you with a ranged or digital attack.  
  
Effect: Roll Intellect vs the target's Intellect; on a success, it takes 1d6 psyonic damage.  
  
Action Type: Reaction  
  
Cost: MP
advance_feats.name: Feedback Lash

advance_feats.description: Your mind is as sharp as your horns. Gain +1 to rolls involving strategy, tactics, or solving puzzles. Additionally, you can quickly assess a situation, gaining +1 to Speed.
advance_feats.name: Fiendish Cunning

advance_feats.description: Your infernal heritage grants you enhanced stamina. Gain +1 to your Shock and +1 to rolls to resist fatigue or exhaustion.
advance_feats.name: Fiendish Vigor

advance_feats.description: You can see in complete darkness in shades of gray.
advance_feats.name: Fiery eyes

advance_feats.description:
- You spot loopholes before the ink dries.
- **Effect:** **+2** to rolls involving contracts, legal disputes, or spotting hidden clauses.
- **Bonus:** Once per session, **retroactively add a minor clause** to an existing agreement.
advance_feats.name: Fine Print Savant

advance_feats.description: You can instinctively "sculpt" your own flesh to close minor wounds. You regain 1d4+2 HP once per day. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Flesh Heal

advance_feats.description:
*Your body recalls how it was broken—and avoids it next time.*

- **Trigger:** The first time your Health drops below 0 during a scene.
- **Effect:** You may negate the damage from a single attack that would hit you this turn.
- **Limit:** Once per Scene/Combat.
- **Type:** Passive.
advance_feats.name: Flesh Memory

advance_feats.description: You can use your tail to hold and throw items. You gain +1 to rolls connected to balancing.
advance_feats.name: Flexible tail

advance_feats.description: You can slowly flow through air. It takes 2 Actions for you to move to an adjacent Zone.
advance_feats.name: Float

advance_feats.description: You can review external camera feeds, personal logs, or data fragments in a scene (if digital tech is nearby). Roll Intellect vs Difficulty 8 to reconstruct a partial flashback of what happened here. Great for investigations or setup exposition. Cost: MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Found Footage

advance_feats.description:
- Your words fracture logic.
- **Effect:** When lying, roll **Intellect vs Willpower**—on success, the target **cannot question the lie** for **1 hour**.
    
    Cost MP and Shock. Action.
advance_feats.name: Fractured Tongue

advance_feats.description:
*The pain isn’t just physical. It’s stitched into your mind.*

- **Effect:** You can voluntarily let **one of your mental conditions flare up** during a Scene.
- For the rest of the Scene, you gain **+1 to Intuition or Willpower** (your choice) when acting in accordance with the condition (e.g., Paranoia helping detect lies).
- However, the condition becomes harder to suppress, and Shock is decrea
advance_feats.name: Fragile Psyche

advance_feats.description:
- Mycelium networks carry secrets to you.
- **Effect:** In areas with rot/fungus, you **sense recent conversations** (fragments, whispers).
- **Bonus:** **+2** to rolls detecting lies in such zones.
advance_feats.name: Fungal Empathy

advance_feats.description: You release a cloud of sparkling dust that clings to invisible or camouflaged targets in the current Zone, revealing them for 1 round. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Glitterdust

advance_feats.description: When you get hit by an attack you can use a Reaction to summon green vines from underground, they rope around the attacker. The attacker can't use Reactions against you for the next 2 rounds. Cost MP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Green Protection

advance_feats.description: You push through pain and adversity with sheer willpower. Once per session, when you would be reduced to 0 HP, you can instead drop to 1 HP and take a single action before falling unconscious.
advance_feats.name: Grit and Determination

advance_feats.description:
You can grow additional limbs:

1\. Extra arm - can hold more items, unarmed melee attacks deal an extra 1d4 damage. You also can make an extra attack with melee or ranged weapons as part of your Action, and this attack has a -2 penalty to hit.

2\. Extra leg - You can move to an adjacent Zone using a Reaction instead of an Action.

3\. Wing - You can glide but can't fly.

Cost PP and Health. Acti
advance_feats.name: Grow Limb

advance_feats.description: When you are attacked by a hacker programmz, you now have these stats to protect yourself — a firewall of 2 and an attack dealing 1d6+3 damage. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Hacker Prevention Methods

advance_feats.description: You reset yourself. You skip your turn, but you lose all debuffs and buffs. It's a Free Action but you can only do it at the start of your turn. Cost PP.
advance_feats.name: Hard Reset

advance_feats.description: Your presence calms and influences those nearby. You gain +1 to persuasion rolls when diffusing conflicts or negotiating peace.
advance_feats.name: Harmonic Aura

advance_feats.description: You heal 8 Shock. Costs a charge of AH. Reaction
advance_feats.name: Heal Shock

advance_feats.description: You heal 8 Health. Costs a charge of AH. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Heal Wounds

advance_feats.description: You can summon a small burst of hellfire. Deal 1d4 fire damage to a target within immediate range. This attack ignores armor. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Hellfire Spark

advance_feats.description: Your tentacles can sense slight changes in the environment. When using sniper rifles you gain +1 bonus to hit, +1 bonus to see hidden through scope. You also sense weather change early. Lasts 1 hour. Cost PP and charge of AH. Action.
advance_feats.name: Helpful Tentacles

advance_feats.description:
- Copy speech patterns perfectly after tasting blood
- *Effect:* +4 to impersonate someone you've fed from
- *Duration:* 1 hour per Health point spent, up to 4 points
advance_feats.name: Hematologic Mimicry

advance_feats.description: You hide your presence in technology; you can also sense other Advent AIs who hide in the same way. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Hide Presence

advance_feats.description:
You can attempt to take over an enemy drone or husk for 1 round. It is a long range ability.

Roll Intellect vs target’s Difficulty.

On success, you control the machine until the end of the next round.

Cost: MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Hijack Protocol

advance_feats.description:
- Your voice carries unnatural weight.
- **Effect:** **+2** to Persuasion when speaking through your **alter ego**.
- **Bonus:** If they later discover your true form, they take **1d6 Shock damage**.
    
    Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Hollow Charisma

advance_feats.description:
You convert a dead body into a horrible effigy. It can't move. It has 8 Health and Stats at 3. Cost Health and MP. Action.

It does the following things at random:

1\. Attack nearest target that isn't you, dealing 1d4+2 damage.

2\. Restores to you 1d4 Health if you are in the same Zone.

3\. Releases Toxin dealing 1d4+1 Shock damage to everyone in current Zone except you.

4\. Explodes dealing 1
advance_feats.name: Horrible Effigy

advance_feats.description:
Your unsettling smile can disrupt social equilibrium.

- Roll **Body vs Intuition**. On success, target is confused or embarrassed, suffering **-1 to their next social roll**.
- On critical success, they become visibly uncomfortable or deferential.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Hungry Grin

advance_feats.description:
At the start of combat, you can use a Reaction to start singing an eldritch tune. This tune affects everyone in medium range. Targets must roll Intellect vs your Charisma+3. Reaction. Cost PP. Here is the effect of this tune:  
1 turn - penalty -1 to resist mental effects  
2 turn - penalty -1 to hit rolls  
3 turn - penalty -1 to dodge rolls  
4 turn - deal 1d4 psychic damage  
  
This tune affec
advance_feats.name: Hymn of Madness

advance_feats.description:
- Your eyes shimmer with unnatural light.
- **Effect:** When speaking to someone, roll **Intuition vs their Willpower**. On success, they are **distracted (-1 to Perception)** for the next 5 minutes.
- **Bonus:** If they fail by **5+**, they briefly forget what they were doing.
advance_feats.name: Hypnotic Gaze

advance_feats.description: Your fragmented memory recalls hidden data. Once per Rest, you may ask the GM for a piece of hidden lore, password, or relevant knowledge about a location, person, or system — as if your memory core glitched open a file. Passive.
advance_feats.name: I Know This File

advance_feats.description: You cannot be ambushed. You gain +1 to tasks related to seeing things.
advance_feats.name: I See You

advance_feats.description: You gain +1 to armor.
advance_feats.name: Improved Protection

advance_feats.description:
*When blood doesn’t stop, you tie off what’s left.*

- **Effect:** As an **Action**, you may use cloth, wire, or nearby material to stabilize yourself or another character at **0 or below Health**.
- The target begins regaining **1 Health per turn** (if they are Stitches) or **stabilizes and stops bleeding out** (if not).
- If used on yourself, you also gain **+1d4 Temporary Health** until the end
advance_feats.name: Improvised Stitching

advance_feats.description: You have heat vision.
advance_feats.name: Infra-vision

advance_feats.description:
When possessed, you gain the **Unarmed damage of 1d8+Strength** and can **lift objects 2x heavier than normal**.  
**Passive while Possessed.**
advance_feats.name: Inhuman Strength

advance_feats.description: You inject a parasite into an unconscious character. This parasite can be found by a medical scan or by attempting a roll of Perception vs 15. This parasite is active for the next 24 hours. While this parasite is active you can use an Action to make the carrier explode and you will take its place instead. You arrive in your true form and everyone who sees you must roll according to the form change
advance_feats.name: Inject Parasite

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Action — interrogation/social/combat  
**Cost:** MP  
**Effect:** Target one bound or restrained humanoid within medium range. They must roll **Willpower (11+)** or involuntarily reveal one short true fact (1–3 words, GM decides exact wording). Not usable to force secrets beyond knowledge or to override major plot-critical truths.  
**Uses/Cooldown:** twice per day.
advance_feats.name: Instant Tell

advance_feats.description:
- **Active — 1 MP**  
    Your ancient instincts awaken for a moment.
- Choose one ally within medium range; they gain **+2 to their next roll.**
- You sense faint psionic whispers from your creator during this effect.
-
advance_feats.name: Instinctual Command

advance_feats.description: You can use Strength instead of Body for intimidation rolls.
advance_feats.name: Intimidating Power

advance_feats.description:
Your limbs lock unnaturally hard in melee.  
  
Effect: When you grab or grapple, roll Strength vs target Body. On success, they can’t move from current Zone for 1 round.  
  
Action Type: Action  
  
Cost: PP
advance_feats.name: Iron Grip

advance_feats.description: You can eat inorganic matter.
advance_feats.name: Iron stomach

advance_feats.description:
- You never back down from a deal.
- **Effect:** Gain **+2** to rolls when haggling, bartering, or intimidating in business.
- **Bonus:** If someone tries to cheat you, you **instinctively know** (roll Perception vs their Charisma).
advance_feats.name: Ironclad Bargainer

advance_feats.description: If you take damage but remain standing, you gain +1 to your next melee attack roll. Stacks up to 3 times. Cost PP.
advance_feats.name: Juggernaut

advance_feats.description: You try to scare the target. Target rolls Willpower vs your Body+Charisma. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Jumpscare

advance_feats.description:
- Your laughter unnerves even machines.
- **Effect:** Once per session, you can **disrupt a conversation**—all social rolls in the area suffer **-1** for the next round.
advance_feats.name: Laugh of the Void

advance_feats.description: You turn into a red liquid akin to blood. You are slow, but you can squeeze through tight places. In this form you can interact with items and mechanisms. Cost PP and Health. Action.
advance_feats.name: Liquid Form

advance_feats.description:
You charge and tackle, this attack have long range. Roll Strength vs target’s Dexterity. On success, both you and target are Prone and target is Grappled. Target takes 1d4+1 damage.  
Action. Cost: PP
advance_feats.name: Lockdown Tackle

advance_feats.description: Gain +1 to rolls for gambling.
advance_feats.name: Luck of Dwarf

advance_feats.description: You master machine languages and can speak to any AI, even those with closed encrypted languages. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Machine Languages Expert

advance_feats.description:
*When your mind slips, your enemies bleed.*

- **Effect:** Once per Combat, when you take Shock damage, you may immediately make a **melee attack** as a free action.
- If your attack hits, deal +2 damage.
- **Cost MP.**
advance_feats.name: Madman's Lunge

advance_feats.description: Contracts that you made have binding power to them. If someone breaks this contract, including you, they must roll Willpower vs your Intellect. On a failure, they take 3 Shock damage.
advance_feats.name: Make a pact

advance_feats.description: You can try to ignite zeal in a crowd of humans, roll Charisma vs difficulty. On success, the crowd tries to protect you from harm, but they will not make aggressive moves or attack your enemies.
advance_feats.name: Martyr

advance_feats.description: You establish telepathic communication with everyone (you can pick who) inside 10 meters radius. It lasts for 1 hour. Action. Cost MP.
advance_feats.name: Mass Telepathy

advance_feats.description:
*Pain is irrelevant. You soak bullets like a sponge.*

- **Effect:** As a Reaction to being targeted by a ranged attack, you can impose **Disadvantage** on the attack roll, but immediately take 1d4 Shock damage.

Cost PP.
advance_feats.name: Meat Shield

advance_feats.description: You were created by one of the mega corps; choose this mega corp. You have +1 to rolls about this corp and rolls to hack or breach systems of this corp. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Mega Corp Rogue AI

advance_feats.description: Add 2 extra points to your MP.
advance_feats.name: Mentally gifted

advance_feats.description: Opened Third Eye. You mesmerize the target; roll Perception vs target Willpower. On success, the target can't take their eyes off your third eye. It will not move or attack while it sees your third eye. The effect will break if the target gets attacked. Action. Cost PP.
advance_feats.name: Mesmerizing Glare

advance_feats.description:
You change part of your body into a ranged weapon:

1\. One dealing 1d8+2 damage and having Full Auto feat

2\. One dealing 1d4+4 Shock damage

3\. One dealing 1d4+3 damage, projectiles missed by this weapon will try to hit its intended target on next turn

Cost PP and Health. Action.
advance_feats.name: Metamorphic Range Weapons

advance_feats.description:
You make part of yourself into a melee weapon:

1\. Light weapon that deals 1d4+4 damage and has a +1 bonus to hit and dodge in melee combat.

2\. Medium weapon that deals 1d6+4 damage.

3. Heavy weapon that deals 1d8+4 damage but has a -1 penalty to hit and dodge in melee combat.

Cost PP and Health. Action.
advance_feats.name: Metamorphic Weapons

advance_feats.description: You know how to use military vehicles like tanks, attack helicopters and so on.
advance_feats.name: Military Expertise

advance_feats.description: You can try to mimic another humanoid creature. You must know how this creature looks. Roll Dexterity. This roll is the difficulty against enemy rolls to call your bluff. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Mimic

advance_feats.description: When you hear someone’s voice, you can perfectly recall their speech later, imitating their tone and words flawlessly. Gain +1 to deception rolls when using this mimicry.
advance_feats.name: Mind Echo

advance_feats.description: You touch a plant or a tree. It starts to blossom. Can help even dying plant life. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Mother Touch

advance_feats.description:
You can process two mental tasks simultaneously. Once per round, you may perform two Mental Skill checks in a single Action (e.g., hack while analyzing, or deceive while scanning).

Passive.
advance_feats.name: Multi-Layer Processing

advance_feats.description: You can attack with your claws or teeth. It is an unarmed weapon with 1d6+1 H damage.
advance_feats.name: Natural weapon

advance_feats.description: Your body has adapted to produce and resist neurotoxins. You deal +1 toxic damage with melee attacks.
advance_feats.name: Neurotoxin Affinity

advance_feats.description: You change color of your skin, it becomes black as moonless night. Gain +2 bonus to Stealth rolls in complete darkness. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Night skin

advance_feats.description: You can see in darkness in shades of grey.
advance_feats.name: Nightvision

advance_feats.description: You gain +1 to rolls trying to charm someone. Doesn't work on non-humanoid and non-intelligent creatures.
advance_feats.name: Otherworldly beauty

advance_feats.description:
You take 1d4+2 damage that ignores armor. You gain the following benefits for the next 3 rounds:   
+1 to hit rolls  
+2 damage to melee attacks  
+1 to rolls to resist Strength rolls against you
advance_feats.name: Overheat Overdrive

advance_feats.description:
*The pain doesn’t stop you—it reroutes.*

- **Effect:** When you take **Shock damage**, you may choose to **convert 1d4 of that Shock into PP of MP**.
- You still take the Shock, but also gain the matching number of PP or MP.
- **Type:** Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Pain Conductor

advance_feats.description: Years of enduring harsh conditions have hardened your body and mind. Gain +1 to Shock and +1 to rolls to resist pain or physical trauma.
advance_feats.name: Pain Tolerance

advance_feats.description:
*You block with whatever's left of you.*

- **Effect:** When you are in the same Zone as an ally about to take a melee hit, you can interpose yourself.
- You take **half the damage (rounded down)**, and your ally gains **+1 Armor** until the start of your next turn.
- If you're at 0 Health or less, your exposed parts reduce the damage further by 1.
- **Type:** Reaction
- **Cost PP.**
advance_feats.name: Patchwork Shield

advance_feats.description:
- Your words linger in machines.
- **Effect:** After speaking near electronics, you can **replay your last sentence** within **60 minutes** (distracts or terrifies).
advance_feats.name: Phantom Echo

advance_feats.description: Add 2 extra points to your PP.
advance_feats.name: Physically gifted

advance_feats.description: Reload as Free Action.
advance_feats.name: Plenty Of Hands to Reload

advance_feats.description: You can create a simple toxin from available materials.
advance_feats.name: Poison Craft

advance_feats.description: You release a puff of hypnotic spores. Roll Charisma vs target's difficulty; on success, they lose their next Reaction; on critical success, they lose two Reactions. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Pollen Burst

advance_feats.description: You try to possess an electronic device (computer, camera, tablet, etc.). Roll Body vs difficulty. On success you can disturb this device. If your roll was 8–10, you can destroy this device. Action. Cost MP.
advance_feats.name: Possess Electronic

advance_feats.description: You try to kick the target, roll Strength vs the target's Body. On a success, the target is kicked into an adjacent Zone, takes 1d4 damage, and you can use a Reaction to make an attack of opportunity. Action. Cost PP.
advance_feats.name: Powerful Kick

advance_feats.description: Once per session, you can reduce MP cost of a feat by 1 (minimum 1).
advance_feats.name: Pragmatic Thinker

advance_feats.description:
Your eyes can make others feel watched and judged.

- Once per 1 hour, roll **Intimidation vs Willpower**. On success, the target is **unsettled**, gaining -2 to their next social roll.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Predatory Gaze

advance_feats.description: If you fail a social interaction, you can use a Reaction to send a psyonic backlash — the target must make a Willpower vs your Intuition+4 roll. On a failure, they take 1d8 psyonic damage and you gain a +1 bonus on your next social roll against them. After 8 hours, they realize that you did something to them. Reaction. Cost MP.
advance_feats.name: Psyonic Backlash

advance_feats.description: Opened Third Eye. When you look at someone wielding psionic powers, a psyker for example, you distort their abilities, giving them a -2 penalty to use psy powers. Action. Cost MP. Lasts till deactivated.
advance_feats.name: Psyonic Distortion

advance_feats.description:
You temporarily distort your energy signature.  
  
Effect: Gain +1 to Dodge and ignore detection by sensors for 1 round.  
  
Action Type: Reaction  
  
Cost: MP
advance_feats.name: Pulse Flicker

advance_feats.description: Once per session, when affected by a debuff (e.g., stun, slow), you can delay its effect for 1 turn.
advance_feats.name: Push Through

advance_feats.description:
*People don’t know what you are — but they know to stay away.*

- **Effect:** When interacting with strangers, you may choose to **intimidate through presence alone**.
- Gain +1 to **Body (Intimidation)** rolls against civilians, street gangs, or corporate agents who don’t know what a Stitches is.
- **Narrative Impact:** May cause NPCs to **flee, stall, or give up information** to avoid you.
advance_feats.name: Ragged Reputation

advance_feats.description: You use your horns as a deadly weapon. Choose a target in medium range, roll Dexterity vs target's Intuition. On success you deal 1d10+1 damage. On a critical success, the target falls prone. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Ram

advance_feats.description:
Once per Rest, you may reroll any failed Mental Stat roll.

Must take second result.

Passive.
advance_feats.name: Redundant Logic

advance_feats.description: You reset your parameters - respec up to 3 points of Mental Stats. Can be done only while Resting. Action.
advance_feats.name: Reset Yourself

advance_feats.description:
Your ghostly energy clings to electronics.  
  
Effect: After you use Possess Electronic, the device continues to glitch or spark for the next 2 rounds, causing a -1 penalty to any attempt to use it.  
  
Action Type: Passive
advance_feats.name: Residual Haunting

advance_feats.description: Your mental fortitude is unmatched. Once per session, you can automatically succeed on a roll to resist fear, intimidation, or mental manipulation.
advance_feats.name: Resilient Spirit

advance_feats.description: You rewind time a little. You cancel your last action and its consequences. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Reverse

advance_feats.description:
- The earth itself testifies for you.
- **Effect:** **Auto-succeed** on one Persuasion roll per session when standing on unpaved ground.
advance_feats.name: Roots of the Witness

advance_feats.description: You can temporarily disable a simple technological device. Roll Intellect vs target's difficulty. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Sabotage

advance_feats.description:
Your eyes reflect the mind of plants.  
  
Effect: You can detect signs of illness, chemical damage, and psyonic energy within any organic matter.  
  
Bonus: Gain +1 bonus to healing plants or diagnosing toxic effects in living beings.  
  
Type: Passive.
advance_feats.name: Sapvision

advance_feats.description: Once per session, if you are reduced to 0 HP, you can roll Body vs difficulty 12. On success, you remain standing with 1 HP instead. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Savage Instincts

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Reaction — *When hit by melee attack*  
**Cost:** PP  
**Effect:** Curl instinctively; reduce incoming physical damage by **3**. If the attack still deals damage, you may immediately shift to a position in current Zone that’s not adjacent to the attacker.  
**Uses/Cooldown:** twice per encounter.
advance_feats.name: Scaled Brace

advance_feats.description:
- People underestimate you—until it’s too late.
- **Effect:** When an opponent dismisses you, gain **+2** to your next attack or social roll against them.
advance_feats.name: Scrappy Underdog

advance_feats.description: Opened Third Eye. You look into the possible future. The GM tells you one thing that is likely to happen. Once per Rest. Action. Cost MP.
advance_feats.name: See Future

advance_feats.description: Opened Third Eye. You see right through lies. You know if a person's last statement was truth or lie. After using this ability on a target, you can't use it on the same target for the next 2 hours. Action. Cost MP.
advance_feats.name: See Truth

advance_feats.description: Opened Third Eye. You can easily spot what is hidden; you have a +2 bonus on such rolls. Passive.
advance_feats.name: See Unseen

advance_feats.description: You try to concentrate to be able to gain a specific memory from a fresh dead body you have eaten. Roll Willpower vs target's difficulty. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Selective memories

advance_feats.description: You start burning, while burning you take 2 Health damage at the end of your turn. Your melee unarmed attacks deal an extra 1d6+1 fire damage and melee attackers take 1d4+1 fire damage when they hit you. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Self Immolate

advance_feats.description:
You can add new senses to yourself. Cost Health and PP. Action.

1\. Darkvision - see in the dark

2\. Infravision - see heat signature

3\. Seismic sense - sense movements akin to sonar

4\. Aura sense - sense psy presence
advance_feats.name: Sense Enhance

advance_feats.description:
You can mount a shoulder weapon (like a mini rocket launcher or turret). Gain +1 to intimidation while it’s visible. Firing it takes Action.  
Passive
advance_feats.name: Shoulder Mount Ready

advance_feats.description:
*You've jammed metal bits and bones into your knuckles.*

- **Effect:** Your unarmed attacks deal **1d6 damage instead of 1d4** and are ignoring 1 point of armor.
- Once per Combat, you can force the target to make a **Body vs 10 save** or begin **bleeding** (2 damage per round for 3 rounds).
- **Limit:** Causes you 1 Shock when you activate the bleeding effect — it hurts *you* too.
advance_feats.name: Shrapnel Punch

advance_feats.description: Your training in stealth and precision allows you to strike without warning. When attacking from stealth or while unseen, deal +1d4 damage.
advance_feats.name: Silent Strike

advance_feats.description:
You subtly influence social fates.

- If an ally within your zone fails a social roll, you may give them **+1 to reroll** it.
- Must be declared **immediately after** the roll.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Reaction.**
advance_feats.name: Silver Threads

advance_feats.description:
- Your words drip with honeyed malice.
- **Effect:** **+2** to Deception or Persuasion when lying with a smile.
- **Bonus:** If they believe you, they take **1d4 Shock damage** when they realize the truth.
advance_feats.name: Silver-Tongued Fiend

advance_feats.description:
While sleeping, you may ask the *Man with a Devilish Mind* one question. The answer is cryptic but true.  
Once per Rest.  
**Passive.**
advance_feats.name: Sinister Whispers

advance_feats.description: You siphon Ectoplasm from a target. It is a medium range ability; roll Perception or Willpower vs target Body or Intellect. On success, gain 1d4+1 Ectoplasm as the target loses 1d4+1 Shock. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Siphon Energy

advance_feats.description: You're small, the size of a cat. You gain +1 to rolls to hide in plain sight.
advance_feats.name: Small

advance_feats.description: If you take damage and there is someone who made a contract with you within medium distance, then you can make your contractor take half your damage (rounded down) while you take the other half (rounded down). Cost MP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Small Text

advance_feats.description: You have the lower body of a snake. You gain +1 to rolls for climbing, running, grappling.
advance_feats.name: Snake tail

advance_feats.description:
You’re terrifying even when polite.

- You can roll **Body instead of Charisma** for Intimidation checks.
- If the check succeeds by 5 or more, the target suffers **-1 to social rolls** for the rest of the scene.  
    **Passive.**
advance_feats.name: Snarl & Smile

advance_feats.description: Once per scene, when you fail a Charisma-based roll, you may immediately follow up with a Mental roll (Intellect or Intuition) to back it up with logic, insight, or data. On success, you treat the original roll as a success. Reaction. Cost MP. Once per scene.
advance_feats.name: Social Backdoor

advance_feats.description: You try to communicate with other machines (robots, interfaces, computers). Roll Intellect vs difficulty. On success you establish communication. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Speak with Machines

advance_feats.description: Your tail becomes a deadly melee weapon. It deals 1d8+2 damage. You can also apply toxins to it. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Spiked Tail

advance_feats.description:
**Passive**  
Your nerves hum with current.

- Gain **+1 Intuition when dodging after you moved this turn.**
- When you dodge successfully, your next attack that round deals **+2 electric damage.**
advance_feats.name: Static Instinct

advance_feats.description:
You release a piercing static-heavy shriek.  
  
Effect: All creatures in Short Range must roll Body vs 11 or suffer -1 to hit until the end of their next turn.  
  
Action Type: Action  
  
Cost: MP
advance_feats.name: Static Wail

advance_feats.description:
- Your voice crackles with unnatural distortion.
- **Effect:** **+2** to Intimidation when speaking through electronics or in dim light.
- **Bonus:** Once per session, **short-circuit a device** by screaming into it (1d4 damage).
advance_feats.name: Static Whisper

advance_feats.description: If you are brought down to 0 Health, you can stand back up with 1 Health. Can be used once per combat. Cost MP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Steadfast

advance_feats.description:
*You’ve seen too many die from sloppy threads.*

- **Effect:** When attempting to stabilize or repair a dying ally (0 or less Health), gain **+2 to Medicine checks**.
- If the ally is another Stitches, you may use **1 of your own Health** to immediately return them to **1 HP** instead of requiring a roll.
- **Type:** Action
- **Cost PP.**
advance_feats.name: Stitch Whisperer

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Reaction — *When a detection check (search, scan, psionic sweep) targets you.*  
**Cost:** MP  
**Effect:** You become partially unreadable: the detection roll suffers **−2**. If the detector is a psionic check, the penalty becomes **−3**.  
**Uses/Cooldown:** once per session.
advance_feats.name: Subtle Scale

advance_feats.description: You gain +1 to perception rolls to spot something or someone, also you can see 3 times further.
advance_feats.name: Superior Vision

advance_feats.description:
**Reaction Cost MP**   
You’ve learned to quiet your inner beast.

- Gain **+2 on rolls to resist the psionic control** of your creator.
advance_feats.name: Suppressive Instincts

advance_feats.description: When you successfully dodge an attack, you can do the following: 1) Move somewhere inside your zone (don't provoke AoO) 2) Take Cover. Reaction. Cost PP.
advance_feats.name: Survival Instincts

advance_feats.description: When making an Insight check, you gain a +1 bonus if the situation involves deception or danger.
advance_feats.name: Survivor’s Wit

advance_feats.description:
You command a swarm of insects to attack a target. This attack has long range. Roll Charisma vs target Intuition. On success, choose one of the following:
1\. Target takes 1d6+2 damage that ignores 3 points of armor
2\. Target becomes Blinded until the start of its next turn
3\. Target has a -1 penalty on actions relying on Perception until the end of its next turn
advance_feats.name: Swarm Attack

advance_feats.description: You perceive data in a multi-sensory way (colors for emotions, sounds for movement, etc.). Gain +1 to perception rolls when searching for hidden objects or people.
advance_feats.name: Synesthetic Awareness

advance_feats.description: Your tail is not just for balance—it can be a weapon. You can make an unarmed attack with your tail, dealing 1d4+4 damage. Additionally, you gain +1 to rolls to resist being disarmed or grappled. Req. Flexible tail feat.
advance_feats.name: Tail Strike

advance_feats.description: When you are hit by a melee attack, you can try to strike back with a -2 penalty. Cost PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Take This

advance_feats.description: You get a glimpse of the future. You gain +1 to your next roll. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Tap into the future

advance_feats.description: You have tentacles, which grow from your head. You can grab and hold multiple items with them. You can also try to attack up to 3 targets (each additional target beyond first adds penalty -1 to roll) in immediate distance, roll Dexterity vs target’s difficulty, on success deal 1d4 H damage, roll separately for each target. Action.
advance_feats.name: Tentacles on head

advance_feats.description:
*Each stitch tells a story — and you remember them all.*

- **Effect:** Once per session, you can recall a **memory fragment** from one of your body’s past owners. This can reveal clues (via GM discretion) about past events, locations, or people — possibly even things **you** never witnessed.
- **Use:** Gain narrative insight, fill gaps in mystery plots, or roleplay unpredictable memory flashes.
-
advance_feats.name: The Scars Remember

advance_feats.description: You gain +1 to social rolls if you speak with corp employees.
advance_feats.name: The world is yours

advance_feats.description:
**Passive**  
The hybrid tissues inside your body adapt to extreme stress.

- You gain **+3 Armor against environmental damage** (fire, cold, radiation, EMP).
advance_feats.name: Thermal/EMP Buffer

advance_feats.description:
When meeting another person with psionic potential, you **immediately sense it** and feel a fragment of their trauma or past.  
**GM describes a psychic memory or emotional wound**. May grant roleplay insight or social leverage.  
**Reaction. Once per Rest.**
advance_feats.name: Touched by the Mind

advance_feats.description: Your dwarven resilience makes you harder to take down. Gain +1 Health and +1 PP. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Tough as Nails

advance_feats.description: You become completely immune to toxic damage.
advance_feats.name: Toxic Immunity

advance_feats.description: You take only half damage (rounded down) from toxins.
advance_feats.name: Toxin resistance

advance_feats.description:
You proudly recount victories in a way that demands respect.

- Roll **Charisma vs Difficulty** to impress a crowd or individual.
- On success, gain **+1 to Persuasion or Intimidation** rolls for the rest of the scene.
- If failed, target may see you as arrogant.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Tribal Boast

advance_feats.description:
*Your muscles don’t move right—until you force them.*

- **Effect:** As a **Free Action**, you may jolt a limb back into use. Until the end of your next turn, you gain **+1 to a Physical roll involving a limb that was previously crippled, damaged, or non-functional**.
- If you're below 2 Health, you also gain **+1 PP** for that turn only.
- **Limit:** Once per Scene/combat.
- **Type:** Free Action
advance_feats.name: Trigger Stitch

advance_feats.description: Your dwarven instincts make you a natural in tight spaces. Gain +1 to attack and defense rolls when fighting in enclosed or underground environments. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Tunnel Vision

advance_feats.description: If you start your movement in dim light or darkness, you can move without provoking Attacks of Opportunity. Reaction. Cost PP.
advance_feats.name: Umbra Dash

advance_feats.description: Gain +1 to your Shock and MP.
advance_feats.name: Unbroken

advance_feats.description:
Your words are laced with menace, even when polite.

- Gain **+1 to Intimidation rolls** when speaking calmly or smiling.
- On a successful Intimidation check, the target is also **Shaken** for 1 minute, suffering -1 to social rolls.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Veiled Threats

advance_feats.description: You grow rows of sharp teeth with pumps inside them for fast feeding on a creature's blood. Roll Strength or Dexterity vs the target's Difficulty. On success, you deal 1d6+1 damage; this damage converts into Health for you. Action. Cost PP.
advance_feats.name: Violent Bite

advance_feats.description: You can shout very loudly. You can also focus your voice to damage foes. Choose a target, roll Body vs difficulty, on a success deal 1d4+1 S damage. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Voice of ancestors

advance_feats.description:
*Your nervous system is ruined, but it still knows how to flinch.*

- **Effect:** When hit by a melee attack, roll 1d6. On a **5-6**, you reduce the damage to **1**.
- **Limit:** Once per Rest.
- **Type:** Reaction.
    
    Cost MP.
advance_feats.name: Walking Corpse Reflex

advance_feats.description: You let out a fierce battle cry, inspiring allies. Your allies in the same Zone gain +1 to their next attack roll. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: War Cry
