advance_feats.description: When you reach 0 or below Health, you now still can fight back. You have 1 Action and 1 Reaction. You still lose limbs or organs. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Way to Perfection

advance_feats.description: You spin your limbs (legs, arms, tentacles, etc.), roll Dexterity vs target difficulty, this attack hit everyone in current Zone dealing 1d6+2 damage. Action. Cost PP.
advance_feats.name: Whirling Spin

advance_feats.description: Choose non hostile target, this target immune to effects of your next transformation (changing of form). It doesn't see you becoming a terrible monster, but it still can have questions about what happened. Target can also try to remember what really happened but taking Intelligence vs your Charisma+5 roll. Action. Cost MP.
advance_feats.name: Whisper of Maledith

advance_feats.description: Your presence disrupts low-tech surveillance. Once per session, you can cause a single basic camera, motion detector, or scanner to glitch momentarily. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Whisper of the Weave

advance_feats.description:
Your compliments are almost addictive.

- After a successful **Charm** roll, the target gains **disadvantage** to resist your next persuasion or deception within 5 minutes.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Words Like Wine

advance_feats.description: When you lose a roll against being Intimidated, Charmed or Lied to, you can instead choose to be enraged. Your next action must be a simple attack on the target. Cost MP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: You pissing me off

advance_feats.description:
**Active — 1 PP**  
You vanish in an electric flash.

- Teleport up to **medium range** and deal **1d6 electricity damage** to enemies adjacent to your previous or new location.
- Using this breaks grapples automatically and you are immune to AoO.
advance_feats.name: ⚡Blink Discharge

advance_feats.description:
*Action — mobility/combat*  
**Cost:** 1 PP  
**Effect:** Move up through two Zones as part of your Action. For every Zone moved through add additional 1d4 electric damage dice to your next attack.  
**Uses/Cooldown:** twice per encounter.
advance_feats.name: ⚡Spark Step

advance_feats.description:
*Reaction (on being hit by ranged attack)*  
**Cost:** 1 PP   
**Effect:** Try to redirect the incoming shot slightly — roll d10: on 1–6 the shot still hits, on 7–8 the shot misses, on 9–10 the shot hits the attacker for half damage rounded down.  
**Uses:** once per round.
advance_feats.name: ⚡Static Parry

advance_feats.description:
**Passive**  
Your emotions freeze; only clarity remains.

- Gain **+2 Shock.**
- When resisting fear, panic, or confusion, roll **2d10 and take the higher.**
advance_feats.name: ❄️ Chilled Focus

advance_feats.description:
*Action — narrative / utility*  
**Cost:** PP  
**Effect:** Freeze the current and adjacent Zones (for tactical use). Anyone who moves through it takes 2 Actions to move in an adjacent Zone instead of one for 1 round.  
**Uses:** three times per encounter.
advance_feats.name: ❄️ Cold Halo

advance_feats.description:
**Active — 1 PP**  
You release a subzero shockwave.

- All creatures within **short range** must roll **Body (10+)** or take **1d6 cold damage** and be **Slowed** for 1 turn.
- Wet or metallic enemies automatically fail this roll.
advance_feats.name: ❄️ Frost Pulse

advance_feats.description:
*Reaction (when an ally is forced-moved or shoved or falling)*  
**Cost:** PP  
**Effect:** Immediately interpose and stop their movement; you and the ally are slowed (−1 Dexterity) for 1 round, but the ally avoids displacement or fall.
advance_feats.name: ❄️ Icing Hold

advance_feats.description:
**Passive**  
Death empowers you.

- When you reach 0 Health you don't die but gain -2 penalty to all rolls and now take Shock damage instead, when you reach 0 Shock you die.
- When a living creature dies within current Zone, **regain 1 Health and 1 PP.**
advance_feats.name: 💀 Graveborn Vitality

advance_feats.description:
*Action — combat / area*  
**Cost:** 1 PP  
**Effect:** Raise a choking mist around you in the current Zone; living creatures who start their turn inside must succeed Body (9+) or take 1d4 poison damage and suffer −1 healing while ending their turn in that mist. You are immune. Mist lasts for 6 rounds.  
**Uses:** once per encounter.
advance_feats.name: 💀 Pall of Rot

advance_feats.description:
*Reaction (after hitting with an unarmed strike)*  
**Cost:** 1 MP   
**Effect:** Target loses 1 Shock (narrative: flesh withers) each round till end of combat or your death.  
**Uses:** 1x per encounter.
advance_feats.name: 💀 Touch of Unmaking

advance_feats.description:
**Active — 1 PP**  
Your touch drains life itself.

- Melee touch attack deals **1d8 damage ignoring armor** and heals your Health for **half that amount.**
advance_feats.name: 💀 Withering Touch

advance_feats.description:
**Active — Cost PP**  
Leave molten footprints of wrath.

- For **3 rounds**, enemies in your Zone take **1d4 fire damage** while ending or starting their turn in your Zone.
advance_feats.name: 🔥 Scorch Trail

advance_feats.description:
**Passive**  
Your inner heat constantly simmers.

- Gain **+1 Strength** and **+1 Armor** against melee attacks.
- When reduced below 50% Health, you deal **1 Shock** to any creature that hits you in melee.
advance_feats.name: 🔥Blazing Veins

advance_feats.description:
*Reaction (on being hit by melee)*  
**Cost:** none / 1 PP to boost  
**Effect:** Wards your skin with heat; attacker takes **1 Shock**. If you spend 1 PP, attacker takes **2 Shock** and you gain +1 to your next attack against attacker.
advance_feats.name: 🔥Emberflinch

advance_feats.description:
*Action — social/combat*  
**Cost:** 1 PP  
**Effect:** Speak while letting a faint ember scent the air. In combat, gain **+1 to Intimidation** and your next attack deals +1d4 fire damage. Outside combat, locals of low rank may be unnerved (GM decides).  
**Uses:** twice per Rest.
advance_feats.name: 🔥Warm Tongue

advance_feats.description:
*Action — social/psionic*  
**Cost:** 1 MP  
**Effect:** Plant a one-sentence suggestion in one target’s conscious mind (Willpower vs your Intellect+4 to resist). If they fail, they will perform or avoid an action (e.g., “leave the door open,” “don’t alert the guard”), these suggestions can be harmful to the target; if the target rolls 10 on a d10, they are instead influenced by your former master
advance_feats.name: 🧠 Softstep Suggestion

advance_feats.description:
**Passive**  
Your presence frays thoughts.

- Gain **+1 to all psyonic damage that you do.**
- Enemies within short range take **−1 to all Mental Stat rolls** against you.
advance_feats.name: 🧠 Subconscious Whispers

advance_feats.description:
**Active — 1 MP**  
You invade a nearby mind with temptation.

- One humanoid within medium range must roll **Willpower (10+)** or become **Distracted**, granting advantage to your allies’ next attack against them.
- On failure, they lose **2 Shock.**
advance_feats.name: 🧠 Telepathic Lure

advance_feats.description:
*Reaction (when you or an ally would be targeted by psionic effect)*  
**Cost:** 1 MP  
**Effect:** Attempt to latch onto that signal: roll Willpower (12+); on success, you know the approximate location of the one performing the effect.  
**Uses:** once per hour.
advance_feats.name: 🧠 Thought Latch

advance_feats.description:
**Passive**  
Darkness is your armor.

- Gain **+2 to Stealth rolls** and **+1 Armor** in dim light or darker.
- You can see perfectly in all forms of darkness.
advance_feats.name: 🩶 Night’s Heir

advance_feats.description:
*Reaction (when you perform an opposed Sleight/Stealth or are searched)*  
**Cost:** PP  
**Effect:** Slide an object invisibly between shadows (pickpocket, hide item, slip a note). Automatic success for simple items; opposed roll with +2 bonus for standard+ or rare or important items.  
**Uses:** two times per session.
advance_feats.name: 🩶Shadowhand

advance_feats.description:
*Action — social / intimidation*  
**Cost:** 1 MP  
**Effect:** Speak from the corner of darkness: target must roll Willpower (11+) or be **unsettled** (−2 social resistance) for combat or scene. Works especially well for interrogation or clandestine command.  
**Uses:** once per hour.
advance_feats.name: 🩶Umbral Whisper

advance_feats.description:
**Active — 1 PP**  
Your strike tears through the boundary between light and dark.

- Make one melee attack that **ignores all armor.**
- If the target is in dim light or darkness, deal **+2 bonus damage.**
advance_feats.name: 🩶Void Slash

advance_feats.description:
**Passive**  
Your rage thickens the air with iron and pain.

- Gain **+3 Health.**
- When you deal melee damage, you may take **1 Shock** to increase that attack’s damage by **+3.**
advance_feats.name: 🩸 Sanguine Fury

advance_feats.description:
*Action — social/combat (ritual)*  
**Cost:** Health  
**Effect:** Expose a ritual sigil from your blood that unnerves one non-augmented humanoid: they must roll Willpower (10+) or suffer −1 to all rolls for 1 minute (narrative: they feel faint, hear their heart). Effective as intimidation or to silence a crowd.  
**Uses:** once per scene or combat.
advance_feats.name: 🩸Bloodcall

advance_feats.description:
*Reaction (when you deal damage)*  
**Cost:** PP  
**Effect:** You put your fingers inside the target and start draining their blood, dealing 1 Health damage per round and healing 1 Health to yourself; furthermore, roll Strength against target Body roll; if you win, the target becomes unconscious and you can drag it with you by using an Action.  
**Uses:** Twice per combat.
advance_feats.name: 🩸Iron Thirst

advance_feats.description:
**Active — Cost PP and Shock**  
You unleash primal hunger.

- Make one melee attack; if it hits, deal **1d4+2 damage** and heal **1d4 Health.**
- If this kills a creature, you immediately gain **+1 to all rolls** until the end of your next turn.
advance_feats.name: 🩸Vampiric Lunge

advance_feats.description: You can use both hands efficiently. You can make an attack with both hands at once, but your damage die becomes lower (example: 1d8 to 1d6) but not lower than 1d4.
advance_feats.name: Ambidextrous

advance_feats.description: You have deep ties to the underground economy. Once per session, you can acquire a rare or illegal item within 24 hours. The item is always genuine, but the transaction might involve a dangerous favor or debt.
advance_feats.name: Black Market Connections

advance_feats.description: You can control the behavior of large groups with ease. Once per session, you can incite a crowd to riot, disperse, or focus on a specific target for 1d6 rounds. The crowd’s actions are unpredictable and might cause collateral damage.
advance_feats.name: Crowd Manipulator

advance_feats.description: Your body has adapted to cybernetic implants. You gain +2 to CA.
advance_feats.name: Cybernetic Resilience

advance_feats.description: You can read really fast; even a 1000-page book takes only an hour.
advance_feats.name: Fast Reader

advance_feats.description: You gain a +2 bonus to escape a grapple and you can contort yourself to squeeze through small spaces.
advance_feats.name: Flexible

advance_feats.description:
You know two additional languages.
Languages you can take:
Human
Elvish
Runic(Dwarf)
Eldritch(Fae)
Dragonspeak
Old Elvish(Crimson elf)
Machine
advance_feats.name: Linguist

advance_feats.description: You gain two luck dice (1d4) which you can add to any of your rolls. Each die is usable once per session.
advance_feats.name: Lucky

advance_feats.description: You’ve perfected the art of creating custom drugs and stimulants. Once per session, you can brew a potent chemical cocktail with a unique effect. The cocktail works flawlessly, but prolonged use has side effects. Requires the Modern Alchemist feat.
advance_feats.name: Neon Alchemist

advance_feats.description: You can create holographic illusions to deceive or distract. Once per session, you can project a lifelike hologram that lasts for 10 minutes. The illusion can mimic a person, object, or environment, but it can’t interact physically with the world. Requires the Holographic Disguise feat.
advance_feats.name: Neon Mirage Master

advance_feats.description: You gain photographic memory.
advance_feats.name: Photographic Memory

advance_feats.description: You gain a +1 bonus against psy powers.
advance_feats.name: Psy Resistant

advance_feats.description: You gain +5 Health and +2 Shock.
advance_feats.name: Tough

advance_feats.description: Your reputation precedes you. Once per session, you can invoke your street cred to intimidate or inspire others. Enemies might hesitate to attack you, while allies gain +1 to their next roll. However, your notoriety attracts unwanted attention from rivals or authorities.
advance_feats.name: Urban Legend

advance_feats.description: Gain 2 arcanist psy powers of 2 rank.
advance_feats.name: Advanced Arcanist Spells

advance_feats.description: Gain 2 curser psy powers of 2 rank.
advance_feats.name: Advanced Curser Spells

advance_feats.description: You can now perfectly imitate voices, accents, and mannerisms. Roll Charisma vs Difficulty. Costs MP. Action. Req. Parrot feat.
advance_feats.name: Advanced Mimicry

advance_feats.description: Gain 2 yellow priest psy powers of 2 rank.
advance_feats.name: Advanced Yellow Priest Spells

advance_feats.description: You can double-jump in midair or kick off walls. You do not take fall damage from any height. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Aerial Mastery

advance_feats.description: You can try to create a standard armor, standard weapon, armor feat, or weapon feat. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. If it's armor or weapon, it has 2 feat slots. Costs MP
advance_feats.name: Amateur Craftier

advance_feats.description: While using Astral projection feat, your body camouflages itself with the surrounding environment. You become hidden and rolls to find you suffer a -2 penalty. Costs MP. Action. Requires the Astral projection feat.
advance_feats.name: Astral Protection

advance_feats.description: You can phase partially into the astral plane, allowing you to pass through solid objects. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. On success, you can phase through up to 5 meters of solid material for 1 round. Costs MP and Shock. Action. Requires **Astral Perception**.
advance_feats.name: Astral Step

advance_feats.description: You can try to create a Beta augment or augment feat. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. This augment has +1 feat slot. Costs MP
advance_feats.name: Aug Expert

advance_feats.description:
You subtly alter your tone and psychic frequency to influence others.

- Gain **+1 to all Charisma-based rolls** when talking **in person**.
- Targets with low Intuition (<=4) feel compelled to agree with you unless directly threatened.
advance_feats.name: Aura Voice

advance_feats.description: You can give your drone a more complex command which it will follow. Can be used on a single drone. Costs MP and is an Action; requires the Automatic feat.
advance_feats.name: Automation

advance_feats.description: You enter Beast Stance and your unarmed attacks deal 1d10+2 damage and you gain +1 armor, but you also gain a -2 penalty to dodge attacks. Action. Stance.
advance_feats.name: Beast Stance

advance_feats.description: You can temporarily enhance an ally’s biological systems, granting them **+2 to a physical stat** for **1d4 rounds**. After the effect ends, the target suffers **1d4+1 Shock damage** from strain. Roll **Intellect vs Difficulty**. Costs **MP**. Action
advance_feats.name: Biological Augmentation

advance_feats.description:
Your fighting record precedes you.

- Thrice per Rest, when entering a new space or gang turf, you can roll **Charisma vs Difficulty**. On success, you can gain:
    
    
    - **Respect:** Enemies hesitate to attack
    - **Fear:** Enemies take -1 to hit you
    - **Admiration:** Gain minor social leverage
advance_feats.name: Brawl Cred

advance_feats.description: Once per combat, you may **grant 1 Action** to an ally who moves after you. **Cost:** MP. **Reaction (after initiative).**
advance_feats.name: Chain of Command

advance_feats.description: You can create a temporary copy of a basic programmz on your cyberdex, which you can deploy to assist you in battle or to disable a system. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty On success, you gain a free programmz or drone action during combat. Costs MP. Action. Requires **Programmz Wizard.**
advance_feats.name: Clone Programmz

advance_feats.description: You mark a Zone as a **Control Zone** for 3 rounds. Allies within gain **+1 Armor** and **+1 to Willpower and Strength rolls**. **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Combat Zone Control

advance_feats.description:
Your tone carries the weight of life and death.

- You can issue a **Command** to an NPC or weak-willed enemy once per scene.
- Roll **Charisma** vs **Willpower**. On success, they must obey your next short instruction (e.g., "Drop it!", "Stand down!").  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Commanding Voice

advance_feats.description:
You specialize in making people hand things over willingly.

- Gain **+2 to rolls to scam, trick, or get something for free** (e.g., items, access, favors).
- On a success, the victim thinks **it was their idea**.
advance_feats.name: Con Artist

advance_feats.description: If you fail a Charisma roll to lie, persuade, or intimidate someone, you can try to change the subject. Roll Charisma vs Difficulty. Costs MP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Confuse

advance_feats.description: You can convert Health to Shock and vice versa; you can do it even if your Health or Shock falls to 0. Maximum up to 4. Costs PP or MP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Conversion

advance_feats.description: You can craft grenades. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. Costs MP.
advance_feats.name: Craft Grenade

advance_feats.description: You can craft cyberdexes; they have one additional programmz slot. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty Costs MP.
advance_feats.name: Cyberdex Creator

advance_feats.description:
When reduced to 0 HP, you may **take one final Action immediately**.

- Gain 2 MP and 2 PP.
- After Action, fall unconscious. **Cost:** Automatic trigger. **Once per rest.**
advance_feats.name: Deadman’s Push

advance_feats.description:
You can probe beyond surface thoughts.

- Roll **Charisma vs target's Willpower**. On success, learn **one of the following**:
    
    
    - A strong belief or fear
    - A lie they recently told
    - Who they trust or hate most
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Deep Read

advance_feats.description:
Your network stretches into secret spaces.

- Once per rest, you can **reach out to the Deep Web** for real-time info, favors, or connection.
- Gain **one clue, lead, or minor contact** related to your current mission or target.
- Additionally, gain **+2 to social rolls** with netrunners, rogue AIs, or deep code entities.
advance_feats.name: Deep Web Whisperer

advance_feats.description:
You erase someone's existence—temporarily.

- Roll **Intellect vs target’s Difficulty**. On success, you shut down or bury their digital ID (no social media, ID, or logs) for 10 minutes.
- During this time, they **cannot use any digital social feats or receive digital aid.**  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Digital Blackout

advance_feats.description: After successfully dodging an incoming attack, you can immediately make a ranged attack against the attacker with a -1 penalty to your roll. Costs PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Dodge and Fire

advance_feats.description: You can deploy two drones at a time.
advance_feats.name: Double Trouble

advance_feats.description: You can take control of enemy drones or robotic devices. Roll an Intellect check against Difficulty. On success, the drone is under your control for the next 3 rounds. Costs MP and is an Action.
advance_feats.name: Drone Hijack

advance_feats.description: You damage all electronics in the current Zone. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty; deal 1d6+1 Shock damage on success. Works only against electronic targets. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: EMP Blast

advance_feats.description:
Flip someone’s current emotion.

- Roll **Charisma vs Willpower**. On success, turn **anger into fear**, **grief into calm**, **confidence into doubt**, etc., for 2 rounds.
- Target resists with Willpower.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Emotional Inversion

advance_feats.description: You can sense the emotions of those around you. Roll Charisma vs Difficulty. On success, you can detect the emotional state of a target and gain insight into their motivations for the next 10 minutes. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Empathy

advance_feats.description: You can drain energy from an enemy, weakening them physically. Roll Willpower vs Difficulty. On success, the target loses 3 Health or Shock, and you gain 3 Health or Shock. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Energy Drain

advance_feats.description: You can react faster in combat. Once per round, you can take an additional Reaction. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Enhanced Reflexes

advance_feats.description: You exorcise a banshee spirit. Roll Willpower vs the target's Willpower; on success, the target is exorcised. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Exorcise

advance_feats.description: If an ally in long range is broken down to 0 Health or 0 Shock, you can stabilize them with 4 Health or 2 Shock. Costs PP. Reaction. Requires Stabilize feat.
advance_feats.name: Extended Stabilize

advance_feats.description: You make a fake photo or video of someone. It is created using a custom model. Costs MP and is an Action.
advance_feats.name: Fake News

advance_feats.description: When you and an ally attack the same target in the same round, both attacks gain **+1 to hit** and **+1d4 damage**. **No Cost.** **Passive.**
advance_feats.name: Fireteam Tactics

advance_feats.description: If you hit an enemy with an unarmed attack, you gain +1 to your next dodge roll.
advance_feats.name: Flowing Strike

advance_feats.description: You can easily forge documents and ID. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. A higher roll means a better forgery. Costs MP.
advance_feats.name: Forger

advance_feats.description: You can craft gadgets. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. Costs MP.
advance_feats.name: Gadget Craftier

advance_feats.description:
Whispers of your deeds echo before you do.

- When entering a hostile social situation, roll **Charisma vs Difficulty**.
- On success, your enemies treat you with **hesitant respect** or avoid conflict unless absolutely necessary.
- Lasts 1 hour. Once per Rest.
advance_feats.name: Ghost of War

advance_feats.description:
Your psychic aura affects more than one mind.

- Once per session, you may influence up to **three nearby targets** using a **single social roll** instead of multiple.
- They must be able to hear or see you.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Group Influence

advance_feats.description:
You undermine an enemy's online status or reputation.

- Roll **Intellect vs Difficulty** On success, target suffers **-2 penalty to all social rolls** for the rest of the session due to mass discrediting.
- May only be used once per target per session.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Hack Their Clout

advance_feats.description: You can break through simple, standard or advanced walls. If you break through an advanced wall, roll Body vs Difficulty. Cost PP. Action. Requires the Breaker feat.
advance_feats.name: Heavy Breaker

advance_feats.description:
Requires Mark as Prey feat.

The marked target has a -1 penalty to all rolls against you. On kill, you also gain an extra Reaction on your next turn, and you gain +2 to damage rolls against other targets.
advance_feats.name: Hunt Prey

advance_feats.description:
You can talk someone into letting you cut into them—even when it’s risky.

- Roll **Charisma or Intellect vs target’s Willpower**. On success, they agree to a high-risk operation, mod, or extraction.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Informed Consent (Mostly)

advance_feats.description: When you’re holding a two-handed weapon, you can resist being disarmed with a +2 bonus to rolls against attempts to disarm you. You can also fire those weapons in immediate range with the penalty lessened by 2 points. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Iron Grip

advance_feats.description: You prevent your drone from breaking; if drone Health reaches 0, you can give it 1 Health. Costs PP and is a Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Last Minute Save

advance_feats.description:
You can build lies so convincing they leave no room for doubt.

- Gain **+2 to Deception or Bluffing rolls**.
- On a critical success, the lie **becomes the target’s new memory** for the rest of the day unless disproven.
advance_feats.name: Lie Through Your Teeth

advance_feats.description: You can run on liquid surfaces. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Liquid Run

advance_feats.description: You can put a virus on an enemy ICE. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty; on success this ICE has a -3 penalty to all rolls until the end of combat. Costs MP. Action. Requires the Virus feat.
advance_feats.name: Localized Virus

advance_feats.description: You can deploy a worm virus that targets a specific system or device. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty On success, the target suffers a -3 penalty to all rolls for the next 2 rounds. Costs MP. Action. Requires **Virus.**
advance_feats.name: Localized Worm

advance_feats.description: Once per session, when you fail a roll, you can declare a “lucky break” and make this roll a critical success. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Lucky Break

advance_feats.description:
Your presence demands respect in healthcare matters.

- When speaking in public or to groups, you can **use Intellect instead of Charisma** for persuasion if it’s about medicine or health.
- NPCs are more likely to **obey your orders in emergencies** if they see you as a medical expert.
advance_feats.name: Medical Authority

advance_feats.description:
You’re terrifyingly persuasive under pressure.

- When **threatening violence** during a negotiation, the target takes **-2 to resist** your demands.
- If you succeed, you may also **gain a bonus favor** (extra intel, gear, or leverage).
advance_feats.name: Negotiation at Gunpoint

advance_feats.description:
You blend into rough crowds like you were born there.

- Gain **+2 bonus** to disguise, blend in, or infiltrate any criminal, rebel, or underground social space.
- Once per session, **you can avoid conflict** by posing as a member.
advance_feats.name: One of Us

advance_feats.description:
People you've saved talk about you. Your rep spreads.

- Gain **+2 to social rolls** with NPCs who know you’ve healed or helped someone they care about.
- Once per session, you can **invoke your reputation** to get minor aid or cooperation.
advance_feats.name: Patient Loyalty

advance_feats.description: If you get hit by an attack, you can use your drone to protect yourself. Your drone takes damage instead of you. Costs PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Protect Me

advance_feats.description: You can change your appearance in under a minute, allowing you to evade pursuit or infiltrate restricted areas. Roll **Intellect vs Difficulty** to determine how convincing your disguise is. Costs PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Quick Change

advance_feats.description:
Reload your weapon as a free action instead of an action. Additionally, gain +1 to hit on your next attack after reloading.

Requires [Double Reload](abilities/double-reload_7710913).
advance_feats.name: Rapid Reload

advance_feats.description: When an ally is downed within Immediate range, you can **drag them to adjacent cover and stabilize them**. They regain 1 Health if stabilized. **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Rescue Pull

advance_feats.description: You gain +2 to resist the effects of poison, toxins, and other debilitating status effects. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Resilient Body

advance_feats.description: If an enemy in immediate distance attacks you, misses, and rolls a 1 or 2 on the to-hit die, you can counter-attack. Roll to hit like normal; on a success, roll your damage. Cost PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Retaliation

advance_feats.description:
You can plant or twist a rumor and watch it grow.

- Roll **Charisma vs Difficulty** to spread a lie into the local info network.
- Within 24 hours, the rumor reaches **at least 3 key NPCs**, influencing the area’s narrative.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Rumor Mill

advance_feats.description: When you land from a jump or fall, you create a shockwave. All enemies in immediate range must roll Dexterity vs your Body or be knocked prone. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Shockwave Step

advance_feats.description: You must wield both a melee and a ranged weapon. You shoot, then slice your opponent in immediate range. Costs PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Shoot and Slice

advance_feats.description: When you hit an enemy with an unarmed attack, roll Body vs their Body. On success, they are confused for 1 round (have 1 fewer Action and Reaction). Costs PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Skull Cracker

advance_feats.description: You can steal, manipulate, or take items, weapons, or armor, even in combat. Roll Dexterity vs Difficulty. If you do it outside of combat, you have a +1 bonus to the roll. For example, you can try to unload an enemy weapon without them noticing. Costs PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Sleight of Hand

advance_feats.description: You can manipulate the memories of others, making them forget a specific event or interaction. Roll Intellect vs target's Willpower. On success, the target forgets something you want them to, up to 5 minutes of interaction. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Sleight of Mind

advance_feats.description: When attempting to persuade or convince someone to take a course of action, you can reduce the difficulty of the roll by 2. This can only be used once per target per session. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Smooth Talker

advance_feats.description: You can run up to very long distance. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Sprint

advance_feats.description: You gain one additional Luck Point and also one luck die (1d4), which you can add to any roll.
advance_feats.name: Super Luck

advance_feats.description: You lay down a barrage of fire, forcing enemies in your Zone to roll Intuition vs your attack roll or take cover, losing their next Action. This deals 1d6 damage to each enemy who fails the roll. Costs PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Suppressive Fire

advance_feats.description: You attack a vital point of a living creature. Roll to hit; on success you deal an additional 1d4 damage and apply the Bleeding Condition to the target. Costs PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Surgical Precision

advance_feats.description:
You exude danger and charm.

- You gain **+2 to all social rolls when acting cocky, bold, or rebellious**.
- NPCs with a criminal or mercenary background are more likely to respect or defer to you.
advance_feats.name: Swagger

advance_feats.description: You can overclock an ally’s cybernetics to enhance their combat abilities. Grant them **+2 to Attack Rolls** and **+2 to Defense Rolls** for **1d4+1 rounds**. After the effect ends, the augment becomes **unstable** and must be repaired. Roll **Intellect vs Difficulty**. Costs **MP**. Action
advance_feats.name: Tactical Overclock

advance_feats.description: You can move larger objects with your mind. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. On success, you can lift objects weighing up to 50 kg and move them at a speed of 1 Zone per turn. Costs MP. Action. Requires **Telekinesis (Basic)**.
advance_feats.name: Telekinetic Lift

advance_feats.description: You can now use the Body stat to resist torture, and you also gain a +1 bonus to torture rolls.
advance_feats.name: Torture Training

advance_feats.description: You must wield a two-handed weapon; your attack ignores 2 points of armor and deals an additional 1d4+3 damage, but you have a -2 penalty to hit. Costs PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Unstoppable Attack

advance_feats.description: You gain a bonus to Intimidation rolls if you have a weapon: +1/+2/+3/+4 for simple/standard/advanced/exceptional weapon.
advance_feats.name: Use Weapon as Intimidation

advance_feats.description: You can attack two enemies in immediate range with a single unarmed attack. Roll separately for each target. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Whirlwind Barrage

advance_feats.description: You enter Wind Breaker Stance and your unarmed attacks deal 1d6+2 damage and become medium range attacks. Action. Stance.
advance_feats.name: Wind Breaker Stance

advance_feats.description: You can cause the rejection of an augment in a target's body, forcing it to malfunction or be expelled. Short range. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty On success, the augment is rendered inoperable for 3 rounds. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: implant-rejection

advance_feats.description:
- You let survivors spread fear.
- **Effect:** When you spare a defeated foe, their faction suffers **-1 to rolls against you** for **24 hours**.
advance_feats.name: "Run. Tell the Others."

advance_feats.description:
Cost: MP — Reaction  
When hit by a mental or psychic attack, you bounce a warped fragment of the energy outward.  
  
One enemy in short range (other than the attacker) must pass Willpower vs your Intuition+4 or take 1d6 psychic damage and become disoriented (-1 to all rolls for 1 round).
advance_feats.name: Aberrant Echo

advance_feats.description: You can crack open nearly any digital lock. Gain +2 to all hacking rolls against physical systems like doors, vaults, drones, or vehicles. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Access Master Key

advance_feats.description: You regurgitate a concentrated glob of acid at a target in short range. Roll Dexterity vs the target’s difficulty. On success, the acid deals 1d6+3 H damage and ignores armor. Req. Acidic Spit. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Acid Bomb

advance_feats.description: Your Acidic Spit can now target two targets at the same time. Req. Acid Spit. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Acidic rain

advance_feats.description:
Your synthetic shell shifts to deflect incoming harm.  
  
Effect: For the next 2 rounds, your armor becomes reactive.  
  
You gain +2 Armor against ballistic and energy attacks  
  
  
Reaction: Use when hit by such an attack  
  
Cost: PP
advance_feats.name: Adaptive Armor Plating

advance_feats.description: You instantly develop resistance to one type of damage (Fire, Electricity, Toxic, etc.) for the next 3 rounds, reducing incoming damage of that type by half (rounded down). Cost PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Adaptive Biology

advance_feats.description:
Cost: MP and Health — Action  
Effect: Your ranged Weapon-Body transforms to match current threat. Choose at activation:  
  
Incendiary: +1d4+3 fire damage  
  
Shrapnel: Targets all in Zone, split damage, additional +3 damage  
  
Piercing: Ignores 2 Armor

  
You can change the mode each turn for 1 MP.
advance_feats.name: Adaptive Fleshgun

advance_feats.description:
You unleash an artificial adrenaline flood.  
  
Passive Effect: You gain +2 to Speed.  
  
Active Effect: For 2 rounds, gain +2 to hit, +4 to melee damage, and ignore Shock penalties.  
  
Addiction Risk: After effect ends, roll Willpower vs 12 or suffer -1 to Dexterity for 10 minutes due to withdrawal.  
Cost: PP and charge of AH. Action.
advance_feats.name: Adrenal Cascade

advance_feats.description: When you drop below half HP (rounded down), gain one more Action that you can only spend on move and a +1 bonus to Athletics checks until the end of combat.
advance_feats.name: Adrenaline Rush

advance_feats.description:
When harm comes to her children, the All-Mother strikes back.  
  
Trigger: You or an ally in the same Zone takes damage.  
  
Effect (Reaction): Vines burst from the ground and lash at the attacker.  
  
Roll your Dexterity vs attacker’s Intuition.  
  
On success: Attacker takes 1d6+2 damage and is Slowed for 1 turn.  
  
  
Cost: MP  
  
Type: Reaction
advance_feats.name: All-Mother's Reprisal

advance_feats.description:
Your eyes flash with primal judgment as nature defends its own.  
  
Trigger: An enemy targets a plant, animal, or creature you control.  
  
Effect (Reaction): Force them to reroll the attack, taking the lower result.  
  
If the attack still hits, attacker takes 1d4 psychic damage from backlash.  
  
  
Cost: MP  
  
Type: Reaction
advance_feats.name: All-Mother’s Glare

advance_feats.description: You gain +1 bonus to resisting torture and +1 bonus to rolls against being intimidated.
advance_feats.name: Antarta Heritage

advance_feats.description: You can mimic the vocal pattern, phrasing, and digital ID of a known authority (officer, exec, etc). Roll Intellect vs target’s Intuition. On success, you gain temporary command over drones, staff, or systems for 1 minute. Cost: MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Authority Impersonation

advance_feats.description: You can fly for up to 30 minutes. You also break your fall automatically even when this feat is not active. Req. Broken Wings. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Awaken Wings

advance_feats.description: If you become prone, you can use a Reaction to immediately stand up. No AoO. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Back Up

advance_feats.description:
You take on traits of a primal beast.  
  
Effect: Choose one aspect to manifest for 10 minutes:  
  
1\. Fangs & Maw – Gain unarmed attack that deals 1d6+2 and heals you for half the damage dealt.  
  
  
2\. Predator Eyes – You ignore concealment, invisibility, and camouflage within short range.  
  
  
3\. Pack Scent – Sense allies and enemies through walls or smoke; gain +1 to hit targets
advance_feats.name: Beastform Aspect

advance_feats.description: You make a contract with a target to help each other; while you or the target don't break it, you and the target gain a +2 bonus on rolls to help one another. Can have only one of these contracts active. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Beneficial Contract

advance_feats.description: When you kill an enemy, you gain a temporary +1 to attack and damage rolls until the end of your next turn.
advance_feats.name: Berserker’s Momentum

advance_feats.description:
You emit a shriek in corrupted machine-code.  
  
Effect: All machines or cyborgs in Medium Range must roll Willpower vs your Charisma+3. On a failure:

They suffer 1d6 damage,  
  
Or are Stunned for 1 round (GM’s call based on target type).  
  
  
Action: Action  
  
Cost: MP
advance_feats.name: Binary Shriek

advance_feats.description:
*Your body is a workshop.*

- **Effect:** Once per Rest, you may spend 30 minutes combining **three body parts** into a grotesque tool or weapon.
    
    
    - Examples: Bone drone (scout), Meat grappling hook, Vein-scythe.
    - Gain 1d4 bonus to a related Skill or Combat Action next time you use the item.
    - Tool lasts for 24 hours.
advance_feats.name: Bio-Forge

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP — Action  
Your eyes glow unnaturally, allowing you to:  
  
Project dim light in a 10-meter cone.  
  
Roll Perception +2 in darkness or through smoke.  
  
Once per hour, unleash a flash to blind targets in immediate Zone (roll Willpower vs Difficulty 13 or become Blinded for 1 round).
advance_feats.name: Bioluminescent Eyes

advance_feats.description: You gain +1 Armor against explosions and shockwave-based damage. If caught in an explosion, you remain standing instead of being knocked prone.
advance_feats.name: Blast Proof

advance_feats.description:
Your opened third eye begins to **drip burning crimson light**. While it is open, enemies in current Zone take 1 Shock at the end of each of their turns.  
**Passive. Eye must be open.**
advance_feats.name: Bleeding Third Eye

advance_feats.description:
The All-Mother grants strength in sacrifice.  
  
Effect: You may sacrifice up to 6 of your own Health.  
  
For each 2 Health sacrificed, you or a target in line of sight gains:  
  
+1 to hit rolls or  
  
+1 to Psy Power rolls  
  
  
Effect lasts 2 turns.  
  
  
Cost: Health  
  
Type: Action
advance_feats.name: Blessed Bloodletting

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP — Action  
Your touch rots and decays the flesh it comes into contact with.  
  
Make a melee touch attack (Strength or Dexterity vs target’s Dodge). On success, the target takes 1d4+4 damage as their flesh begins to decay.  
  
The target’s armor or protective covering is reduced by 1 point for the next 3 turns. Stacks.  
  
The target also suffers a -1 penalty to their next roll.  
  
Y
advance_feats.name: Blighted Touch

advance_feats.description:
Cost: 2 PP & 2 Health  
Action: Yes  
You stitch together up to 3 dead bodies into a grotesque chimera.  
Chimera Stats: 12 HP, 5 PS  
Abilities (choose 2):  
  
Bile Spray (Zone attack, 1d6 Shock)  
  
Gore Charge (1d6+3 damage, knocks target prone on crit)  
  
Tentacle Grapple (immobilizes 1 target until they pass Strength vs 14)
advance_feats.name: Blood Chimera

advance_feats.description:
Cost: MP — Action  
You taste a drop of someone’s blood and instinctively understand how to influence them.  
Effect:  
  
Gain +2 bonus to Persuasion or Intimidation against that individual for 1 hour.  
  
You can also learn one of: greatest fear, greatest desire, or recent emotional state.
advance_feats.name: Blood Scent Persuasion

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP — Action  
Effect: When you hit with a melee Weapon-Body attack, deal +1d4 damage and regain 1d4 Health. If target is bleeding, double the healing.
advance_feats.name: Blood Siphon Blades

advance_feats.description:
You use metaphor, guttural tone, and aggressive poetry to confuse or impress.

- You can use **Body instead of Intellect** for rhetoric or persuasion in tribal, gang, or survival contexts.
- On a success, target is both **intrigued and intimidated**.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Blood-Slick Eloquence

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Passive — when you roll a natural 10 on any d10 test  
**Cost:** none  
**Effect:** Your blood ignites with ancestral power.

- Immediately gain **1 PP or 1 MP** (your choice).
- You may move in medium range for free.
advance_feats.name: Bloodline Surge

advance_feats.description:
Cost: 2 MP & 2 Health  
Action: Yes  
Coat yourself in hardened, chitinous blood.  
Effect: +2 Armor for 3 rounds.  
Bonus: On hit by melee, attacker takes 1d4 damage.
advance_feats.name: Bloodmold Armor

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP — Action  
You mold your bones (or a willing target’s) into armor-like plating.  
Effect:  
  
Target gains +2 Armor for 10 minutes.  
  
While active, they suffer -1 to Dexterity-based rolls due to rigidity.  
  
After duration ends, target takes 1d4 recoil damage from bone retraction.
advance_feats.name: Bone Harness

advance_feats.description:
You carry ritual or mythic stories of your people.

- Gain **+2 to Persuasion or Charm rolls** when invoking **Orkish culture, legends, or taboos**.
- Once per session, you can tell a tale so vividly it stuns an audience into silence (no one takes action for 1 round).  
    **Passive.**
advance_feats.name: Bone Lore

advance_feats.description:
*With the right pieces and a bit of thread, you can become someone else.*

- **Effect:** If you have a fresh body of someone with status, access, or credentials, you can take 10 minutes to **reconstruct their face and voice onto yourself**.
- Gain +2 to **Deception** and **Disguise** checks to impersonate them.
- Most effects last **until the next rest**, or until you're damaged in the face or thr
advance_feats.name: Borrowed Identity

advance_feats.description: You can try to break someone else's contract; roll Intellect vs contract difficulty. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Break Pact

advance_feats.description: Your knowledge of brewing and distillation is unparalleled. You can create potent drinks that grant a temporary +1 bonus to a Physical Stat of your choice that lasts for 10 minutes. You can use this drink within the next 2 hours after drinking it. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Brewmaster

advance_feats.description: You cast your Psy Powers through Familiar. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Cast Through Familiar

advance_feats.description: You can change your appearance and even make yourself look like a specific person of your species, but you can't change yourself to look like another species. Roll Body vs difficulty. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Change of Flash

advance_feats.description: You claim (or genuinely believe) you’ve seen the “true code” beneath reality. Once per session, you may ask the GM for a prophetic insight, delivered as a corrupted message, glitch, or hallucination. Grants advantage on a roll tied to that insight. Action.
advance_feats.name: Code Prophet

advance_feats.description:
Your strength enables quick battlefield extractions.  
  
Effect: Pick up one ally (or a medium object) and move both of you into an adjacent Zone in the same Action. The ally does not spend Movement this turn.  
Cost: Action.
advance_feats.name: Combat Lift

advance_feats.description:
Your military protocols activate with terrifying precision.  
  
Effect: For the next 3 turns:  
  
You gain +1 to all attack rolls  
  
Your Dodge receives +1  
  
You may make 1 extra Reaction per round  
  
  
Action: Action  
  
Cost: PP
advance_feats.name: Combat Subroutines

advance_feats.description:
You issue a rapid, instinct-driven command to boost morale.  
  
**Effect**: All allies in your Zone gain +1 to Willpower and +1 to dodge rolls for 2 rounds.  
**Cost**: MP. **Action**.
advance_feats.name: Command Pulse

advance_feats.description: You give a simple command to a target; this doesn't work on other elves. Target must not be hostile to you. Roll Charisma vs target difficulty. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Commanding Voice

advance_feats.description: Once per job, you can declare that you "know a guy" who can provide basic intel, access, or minor favors. GM determines availability.
advance_feats.name: Contacts Everywhere

advance_feats.description:
*You’ve mastered the grotesque art of improving yourself using dead flesh.*

- **Effect:** Once per Long Rest, you may spend 10 minutes modifying your body with parts from **two different corpses**.
- Choose **two of the following temporary effects** (lasts 1 hour or until the part is destroyed):
    
    
    - +1 to a **Physical Stat**
    - **Darkvision**
    - Gain a **natural weapon** (1d6 da
advance_feats.name: Corpse Crafter

advance_feats.description: When you hit an enemy with a melee weapon or natural weapon, you can choose to weaken them. They take a -2 penalty on their next roll. Cost PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Crippling Blow

advance_feats.description:
You grab with two arms and strike with the others.  
  
Effect: Grapple a target. If successful, immediately make two unarmed attacks that deal +1 damage each. Target cannot dodge those attacks unless it breaks the Grapple. Once per round.  
Cost: PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Crush and Shatter

advance_feats.description: Your body fuses with cybernetic implants more efficiently than other races. You reduce CA cost by 1 (to minimum of 1) and gain +1 to rolls involving cybernetic modifications.
advance_feats.name: Cybernetic Overgrowth

advance_feats.description: You gain +2 bonus to rolls to find hidden threats.
advance_feats.name: Danger Sense

advance_feats.description: You can call upon the shadows to aid you in a moment of need. Once per session, you can turn a failed roll into a critical success. This ability represents a pact with the darkness, and using it may have narrative consequences. Cost MP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Dark Bargain

advance_feats.description: You can interact with digital systems on an intuitive level, sensing data flows as if they were emotions. Gain +1 to hacking or decryption attempts against non-military systems. You don't need cyberdex to hack.
advance_feats.name: Data Whisperer

advance_feats.description:
*Your mind fractures into clarity for just long enough to unleash chaos.*

- **Effect:** When you drop below 0 Shock, you may **delay your mental collapse by 1d4+1 turns**.
- During this time, you are **immune to Shock damage**, gain +1 to all attack rolls, and enemies have Disadvantage on fear or mind-affecting powers against you.
- When the turns end, the GM **immediately triggers one of your me
advance_feats.name: Delirium Burst

advance_feats.description: Your infernal luck becomes more potent. Once per session, you can reroll a failed roll and add +2 to the result. Cost MP. Reaction. Req. Devil's Luck feat.
advance_feats.name: Devil's Super Luck

advance_feats.description: Req. Spiked Tail feat. Your tail now deals 1d10+2 damage and ignores 1 point of armor. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Devilish Tail

advance_feats.description: You can manipulate your hair; it also becomes very strong, you can grab with it, and if you grab someone you gain a +1 bonus to rolls. You can also control cut hair for up to 1 minute.
advance_feats.name: Devilish hair

advance_feats.description:
- Your presence bends wills.
- **Effect:** Once per session, **auto-succeed on a Persuasion or Intimidation roll**.
- **Drawback:** The target will **always remember this moment with unease**.
advance_feats.name: Devil’s Charisma

advance_feats.description: You can forge a digital persona (false identity, background, and records) in public and private databases. Once created, you may pass as a citizen, executive, or specialist when scanned or researched. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty to maintain the illusion when challenged. Cost: MP. Action. Once per Rest, you may adjust or update this persona.
advance_feats.name: Digital Doppelgänger

advance_feats.description: You analyze vocal stress, blink rate, typing rhythm, and data inconsistencies. Gain +2 to detect lies or false intentions in virtual or spoken conversations. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Digital Lie Detector

advance_feats.description:
You emit a haunting, mechanical banshee wail that scrambles systems and nerves.  
  
Effect: Everyone in medium range must roll Willpower vs your Charisma+2  
  
On a failure: take 1d6 psychic damage and get -1 to Action next turn  
  
  
Action: Action  
  
Cost: MP
advance_feats.name: Disruptive Howl

advance_feats.description: You now can reverse up to two of your Actions. Req. Reverse. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Double Reverse

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** *Action*  
**Range:** *Short*

*Cost MP*  
**Effect:** Release a concussive psionic shockwave.

- Deal **1d6+4 Shock** to all targets in short range.
- If you are below half Health, the wave also pushes targets back one zone.
advance_feats.name: Draconic Pulse

advance_feats.description:
**Reaction Cost PP**  
You are closer to mastering your transformation.

- Transform into or out of **dragonblooded form** as an **Action** instead of 10 minutes.
advance_feats.name: Draconic Reversion

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Action — exploration / narrative  
**Cost:** MP  
**Effect:** You pulse your senses outward, feeling the “pressure points” of the environment.  
Ask the GM for **one of the following** about the scene:

- a structural weak point
- the location of any hidden creature within Long range
- the direction of a psionic or disturbance
    
      
    **Uses:** twice per Rest.
advance_feats.name: Draconic Sense Break

advance_feats.description:
Type: Action — recovery  
Cost: MP + Shock  
Effect: You enter a six-second micro-trance drawn from ancient reptilian torpor. Regain 1d6 Shock and Health and cancel one ongoing mental effect (fear, confusion, hallucination).  
Cooldown: once per Rest.
advance_feats.name: Dragonsleep Resurgence

advance_feats.description: You release an EMP shock in the current Zone. All enemy tech (drones, cyberware, weapons) must roll Body vs your Intellect+3 or become disabled until end of next round. Allies’ tech unaffected. Cost: MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: EMP Pulse Core

advance_feats.description: You can exist in multiple places online simultaneously. When socializing through screens, voice channels, or VR, you may engage with up to 3 targets at once. Gain +1 to all Charisma-based rolls while interacting in this way. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Echo Presence

advance_feats.description:
You leave behind a glitchy after-image that confuses foes.  
  
Effect: For 2 rounds:  
  
Attacks against you suffer -1 penalty  
  
First time you're hit, the attacker must reroll and take the worse result  
  
  
Reaction: When targeted  
  
Cost: PP
advance_feats.name: Echo Protocol

advance_feats.description: When an enemy makes a melee attack against you and misses, you can reposition yourself up to 1 Zone away without provoking attacks of opportunity. Cost PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Echo Step

advance_feats.description: When an enemy successfully attacks you, you can force them to reroll once per combat. Cost MP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Echo of Trickery

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP and Health — Action  
You may contort your skeletal structure unnaturally. For 1 hour:  
  
You can squeeze through gaps the size of 2cm.  
  
Gain +2 to checks involving infiltration, escape, or slipping restraints.  
  
Your limbs can bend in grotesque ways, granting +1 to dodge once per turn.
advance_feats.name: Elastic Bone Architecture

advance_feats.description:
You can intimidate without raising your voice.

- When you use **Intimidation in formal or political settings**, you gain an extra **+2 bonus** if you're not shouting or acting overtly aggressive.
- This stacks with other Intimidation bonuses.  
    **Passive.**
advance_feats.name: Elegant Threats

advance_feats.description: Req. Spiked Tail feat. Your tail is now a long range weapon. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Elongated Tail

advance_feats.description: You may set a digital marker inside any Husk or system you inhabit. Once per Rest, you may instantly upload yourself back to that marker. Cost: MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Encrypted Beacon

advance_feats.description: When affected by a status condition (stun, burn, bleed, etc.), roll Body vs difficulty 12. On success, you ignore the effect for 1 round. Cost MP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Endless Grit

advance_feats.description: When you take damage, you become enraged; your next attack deals a bonus 1d4+1 damage. Cost MP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Enrage Yourself

advance_feats.description: You gain +1 armor.
advance_feats.name: Even More Protection

advance_feats.description: You gain one more arm, you can hold items in it and interact using it, and your melee attacks gain a +1 bonus to hit rolls.
advance_feats.name: Extra Arm

advance_feats.description: You gain an extra leg; you gain +1 to ranged hit rolls. Also, you can use an Action to run to an adjacent Zone and use the same Action to attack a target in melee.
advance_feats.name: Extra Leg

advance_feats.description: You gain a +2 bonus to rolls related to architecture, such as finding weak spots in buildings or discovering hidden rooms.
advance_feats.name: Eye for Architecture

advance_feats.description:
Opened Third Eye. Once per Session, you may look at someone and **see a memory they wish to forget**—a terrible decision, shame, or crime. The GM provides one. You may **leverage this for blackmail, empathy, or storytelling power**.  
**Action. Cost MP.**
advance_feats.name: Eyes That Remember

advance_feats.description: You expertly fake being a non-sentient programmz. When interfacing with security AIs, drones, or corporate scanners, you may pretend to be a routine system. Roll Charisma vs Intellect of observer; on success, you are ignored or granted access. Cost: MP. Reaction (1/scene).
advance_feats.name: False Sentience

advance_feats.description: All-Mother grants you a gift: an animal familiar that has elevated intelligence and obeys your commands. It has 12 HP, 6 Shock, 3 PS, 4MS, 1 Action, 1 Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Familiar

advance_feats.description:
You gain confidence from others’ fear.

- When you **Intimidate successfully**, you gain **+1 to your next social or combat roll**.
- This bonus stacks up to +3 and resets when you fail.  
    **Passive.**
advance_feats.name: Fear Feeder

advance_feats.description: You have +2 to rolls to positive interactions (e.g., diplomacy) with other humans.
advance_feats.name: Fellowship

advance_feats.description:
*If it bleeds, it can be reattached.*

- **Effect:** As an Action, you may reattach a **lost limb or organ** (yours or ally’s) within 1 turn of it being removed.
    
    
    - Restores full function after 10 minutes.
    - Target takes 1d4 Shock from the experience.
- Doesn’t work on **heads or brains**.
advance_feats.name: Field Grafting

advance_feats.description:
**Opened Third Eye.** Until your next turn, enemies in your Zone must roll Willpower vs your Perception+Charisma when they try to **attack your allies**. On a failure, they lose their Action.  
**Cost MP. Action.**
advance_feats.name: Field of Madness

advance_feats.description: You are able to drink a special dwarf concoction which gives you the ability to breathe fire; roll Dexterity vs target difficulty, on success deal 1d8 H fire damage and the target gains the Burn condition for 2 rounds. Suffer 1 Shock damage; if you have Dwarf Blood, you don't suffer this damage. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Fire Breath

advance_feats.description: You can see what part of the target's body has the most potent memory; consuming this part of the body makes Selective Memories rolls easier, and you gain a +2 bonus on those rolls. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Flasheopatia

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP — Action  
You split your body open to release a smaller, semi-autonomous appendage (eye stalk, tendril, mouth, etc.).  
  
It can hold or manipulate one object.  
  
Alternatively, it can make a melee attack once per turn as part of your Action (1d4+1 damage, uses Dexterity).  
  
Lasts 1 minute. Only one such appendage can be active at a time.
advance_feats.name: Flesh Within Flesh

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP — Action  
Your body morphs, extending grotesque tendrils from your back or limbs.  
  
These tendrils can attack as a melee weapon (1d6+4 damage, uses Strength or Dexterity).  
  
You can use these tendrils to grapple or restrain a target (Strength or Dexterity vs target’s Strength or Dexterity).  
  
Targets who are grappled take 1d4+2 damage each turn while grappled.  
  
Lasts for 1 m
advance_feats.name: Flesh-Warped Tendrils

advance_feats.description:
You stabilize two weapons with your other arms for perfect aim.  
  
Effect: You fire two ranged weapons in a single Action, both using the same targeting roll. If both hit, deal +2 bonus damage to one target. Once per turn.  
Cost: MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Focused Fire Protocol

advance_feats.description: You can create a small, temporary golem or drone from scrap metal and stone. The construct acts as an ally for 10 minutes, performing simple tasks or fighting alongside you. It has 5 Health and deals 1d6 damage with its attacks. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Forgeborn Construct

advance_feats.description: You can infuse a weapon with forgefire, causing it to deal an additional 1d8 fire damage on the next hit. Additionally, the weapon ignores fire resistance. Cost PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Forgefire Infusion

advance_feats.description: You can split off a limited instance of yourself. Your subroutine can perform one simple task (hack, scan, monitor, speak, etc.) while you focus on something else. Grants advantage (roll twice, take best) on multitasking checks for 1 minute. Cost: MP. Free. 1/Rest.
advance_feats.name: Forked Subroutine

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP — Action  
You temporarily split into two versions of yourself, slightly out of phase.  
  
You gain advantage (roll twice, take better result) on your next 2 rolls.  
  
You appear as flickering, overlapping versions of yourself.  
  
Attackers must roll Perception vs your Dexterity to target you directly.  
  
Lasts 2 rounds or until you take damage.
advance_feats.name: Fractured Persona

advance_feats.description: Your memories contain glitches of past lives or test simulations. Once per Rest, invoke one of these to gain a specialization for 10 minutes. Gain +2 to all related rolls during this time. Action.
advance_feats.name: Fragmented Legacy

advance_feats.description:
Fungi coat your body, mimicking the color and texture of your surroundings.  
  
Effect: Gain +2 to stealth rolls and become immune to thermal detection (spores suppress heat signature).  
  
Bonus: If you remain still, become undetectable by mechanical sensors.  
  
Cost: PP  
  
Type: Action
advance_feats.name: Fungal Camouflage

advance_feats.description:
You infect a corpse, surface, or wounded enemy with fast-growing fungus.  
  
Effect:  
  
On a surface or corpse: It becomes overgrown and emits dim bioluminescence. It can also obscure vision (-1 to ranged attacks through it).  
  
On a living creature (Intuition vs your Intellect+2): They take 1d6 damage at the end of their turn over 3 rounds and movement deals an additional 1d6 damage.

advance_feats.name: Gaseous Form

You let your spectral essence surge through your android frame.  
  
Effect: For 3 rounds:  
  
You ignore terrain penalties  
  
You can pass through 1 thin wall or barrier per round (no more than 10cm)  
  
Gain +1 to Dodge  
  
  
Action: Action  
  
Cost: MP
advance_feats.name: Ghost Surge

advance_feats.description:
- You whisper through every speaker in the room.

- **Cost:** MP.

You temporarily bestow a protective carapace to an ally.

    - **Inflict 1d6 damage** (Action)
- **Cost:** PP
advance_feats.name: Gift of the Fruiting Body

advance_feats.description:
Your words weave visions in the listener’s mind.

    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**

advance_feats.description:

Store up to 5 encrypted files or maps, retrievable via touch interface.  
  
Grants +2 to rolls to recall or bypass digital encryption while graft is intact.
advance_feats.name: Graft-Skin Memory Pad

advance_feats.description:

You subtly warp gravity around yourself.  
  
Choose one effect for the next 3 rounds:  
  
You cannot be knocked prone.  
  
Projectiles have a -1 penalty to hit you.  
  
You can walk along walls as if they were floors (slowly: 2 Actions per Zone move).

advance_feats.description: You start to glow green, everyone in immediate range must roll Body vs difficulty 12, on a failure they suffer 1d4 H toxic damage, that ignores armor, for the next 3 rounds. Cost PP. Action.

advance_feats.description:

2\. Extra legs - You can move to an adjacent Zone as a Free Action (can be used 2 times per round).

advance_feats.name: Grow Limbs

advance_feats.description:
Nature rises to shield you.  
  
Effect: Summon a large mass of roots and vines to block line of sight or movement between two Zones for 3 turns.  
  
Stats: 10 HP, immune to mental effects.  
  
Cost: MP  
  
Type: Action.
advance_feats.name: Grow the Rootwall

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP — Action  
Grow gill slits and adapt your lungs:  
  
Breathe underwater or in toxic environments.  
  
You gain +2 to resist choking, gas, or drowning effects.
advance_feats.name: Hardened Bio-Gills

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** *Passive (Combat)*  
Your draconic resilience strengthens.

- Gain **+1 Armor** (stacks with worn armor but not other scaling feats).
- Once per session, reduce any incoming damage to **1**.
advance_feats.name: Hardened Scales

advance_feats.description: You gain +1 to your armor.
advance_feats.name: Hardened Skin

advance_feats.description: When an enemy in close combat declares that he is going to attack you or if this attack missed you, you can spend Reaction to make this attack hit. You take damage from this attack -3. You grab attacker and immediately attack him back with +2 to hit bonus. Reaction. Cost PP.
advance_feats.name: Harm Yourself

advance_feats.description: When someone who made a contract with you takes damage, you can make them pay; roll Willpower vs the attacker's difficulty, and on success the attacker takes 1d8+1 H fire damage. Cost MP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Hell Vengeance

advance_feats.description: You can unleash a burst of hellfire in a current Zone. All targets within the area must make a Body roll (difficulty 12) or suffer 1d6+2 fire damage, ignoring armor. Cost PP. Action.

advance_feats.description: Your body becomes immune to fire.
advance_feats.name: Hellfire Resistance

advance_feats.description: You emit an aura of infernal energy, unnerving those around you. Enemies within immediate range suffer -1 to their attack rolls and Willpower rolls. This effect lasts for 3 rounds. Cost MP. Action.

You vibrate internal organs to produce deep subsonic or high-pitched tones.

Emit a frequency that disables electronic locks or sensors in long range (roll Intellect vs Difficulty).  
  
Alternatively, use to communicate silently with others who have this feat within long range.

advance_feats.description:

While inside, you can sense the target’s direction and general state (Health, aggression).

advance_feats.description: Your sight is enhanced, allowing you to perceive in both infrared and ultraviolet spectrums. Gain +1 to perception rolls in darkness or when analyzing digital screens.

advance_feats.description:
- You trade favors for something… more.
- **Effect:** When someone accepts your help, you can **demand a future favor**—they **cannot refuse** unless they pass **Willpower vs 14**.
advance_feats.name: Infernal Barter

advance_feats.description: Your infernal mark grows stronger, allowing you to store more energy. You can now regain 4 PP or 4 MP once per session. Cost MP. Passive.

advance_feats.name: Infernal Senses

advance_feats.description:
Your unsettling presence and link to the *Devilish Mind* can be weaponized as motivation. Once per Rest, you can give up your Action to **boost all allies in a Zone**: +1 to all rolls until the start of your next turn.  
**Action. No MP cost.**
advance_feats.name: Inspire Through Fear

advance_feats.description:
*Your body is a stitched-together suitcase.*

- **Effect:** You can **hide up to 3 small items** in body cavities or stitched folds.
- Any search must pass an **IPerception vs 15** check to detect them.
- You may also **swap or retrieve** one item as a Free Action once per turn (limit 1 use per turn).
advance_feats.name: Internal Stitches

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP — Action  
You open a sealed biological pouch within your torso or thigh. You can store up to 3 small items (knife, pistol, passkey, etc.) which are undetectable by scanners. Retrieving or storing takes a Free Action.
advance_feats.name: Internal Storage Cavity

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP — Action  
You reverse a local law of physics in a small area (10m radius) for 1 round.  
  
Pick one:  
  
Reverse Gravity: All creatures in Zone float or crash to ceiling if indoors.  
  
Reverse Motion: All movement done is done backward (characters must roll Dexterity or fall prone).  
  
Reverse Time: Everyone in the Zone reverts their position and HP state from the previous round.
advance_feats.name: Inverse Pulse

advance_feats.description: You choose one common feat of rank 1, you have this feat, you can change the chosen feat after rest. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Jack of All Trades

advance_feats.description:
You attempt to crush someone with the full force of your massive arms.  
  
Effect: Roll Strength vs target’s Body. On success, deal 1d6+2 damage and pin the target — they must roll Strength and spend 2 Actions to escape.  
Cost: PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Juggernaut Grapple

advance_feats.description:
- Booze doesn’t just numb pain—it fuels your will.
- **Effect:** When drunk, gain **+2 to Willpower rolls** (resisting fear, persuasion, or psychic influence).
- **Bonus:** Once per session, **ignore the first mental debuff** (fear, charm, confusion).
advance_feats.name: Liquid Courage

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP and Health — Action  
Effect: You generate and fire parasitic projectiles. These deal 1d6+2 damage and reduce target's Armor by 1 (minimum 0) for the rest of the encounter. Projectiles squirm on hit, giving the target -1 to their next roll.
advance_feats.name: Living Ammunition

advance_feats.description: If you successfully grapple an enemy, you can use them as a shield. Until they break free, they take half the damage (rounded down) from attacks targeting you. Cost PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Living Shield

advance_feats.description:
You plant a data-mine that fries enemy systems.  
  
Effect: Target electronic or cybernetic enemy. Roll Intellect vs Willpower. On success, deal 1d8 damage that ignores armor and inflict glitch status (lose 1 Action next turn).  
  
Action: Action  
  
Cost: MP
advance_feats.name: Logic Bomb

advance_feats.description: When you roll a natural 1, you gain +2 to your next roll of the same type.
advance_feats.name: Luck of the Underdog

advance_feats.description:
You have made a silent deal with the *Man with a Devilish Mind*. Once per Rest, you may **ask for help in a desperate situation**—a door opens, a system glitches, someone forgets seeing you.  
The effect is real, but the GM **gains an automatic Intrusion** to use on you later.  
**Passive.**
advance_feats.name: Mark of the Devilish Pact

advance_feats.description:
Choose up to 4 targets in long range. Roll Perception or Willpower VS Body or Intellect. On success deal 1d4 Shock, restore as much Ectoplasm. Action. Cost MP.

advance_feats.name: Mass Siphon

advance_feats.description: When you get bonus XP from feat Fast Learner, other players also gain this bonus XP.
advance_feats.name: Mentor

advance_feats.description:
Cost: MP — Action  
You mentally tether yourself to a target within sight.  
  
For 3 turns, target must pass a Willpower vs your Perception+3 each round.  
  
On failure: you know all their intentions for that turn and can impose -2 to one chosen roll they make.  
  
If they leave your sight, effect ends.  
  
If they succeed 2 times in a row, the link is broken.

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP and Health — Action  
Effect: Choose two Weapon-Body upgrades (from melee or ranged variants) and graft them together. You can freely swap between them once per round as a Free Action. Each change adds +1 to your next attack roll that round.
advance_feats.name: Modular Armaments

advance_feats.description: When you get hit in melee, you can contort your flesh to grab either the attacker or their weapon. Roll Dexterity vs difficulty of target. Cost PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Molding Flash

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** *Reaction*

*Cost PP*  
When you take elemental, fire, or psionic damage:

  
- Your next melee attack within 3 turns deals **+3 Damage of same kind**
advance_feats.name: Molten Spirit

advance_feats.description:
You subtly alter your body language and voice to match the expectations of others.

- Gain **+2 to Charm or Deception** when pretending to be part of a social group (e.g., corporate, noble, resistance).
- Once per Rest, avoid suspicion or bypass a security check if watched or interrogated.  
    **Passive.**
advance_feats.name: Moonlight Persona

advance_feats.description:
Through trance or consumption of sacred herbs, you invoke an omen.  
  
Effect: Ask the GM one yes/no question about an area, NPC, or upcoming danger. The answer is vague but useful.  
  
Limitation: Can be used twice per Rest.  
  
Cost: MP.  
  
Type: Action.

advance_feats.description: Your voice carries an unnatural allure. Once per combat, you can force a single humanoid target to hesitate before attacking you (causing them to lose 1 action). Cost MP. Reaction.

advance_feats.description:
- You know people who know people.

You activate a layered firewall to shield from mental interference.

+2 to resist mind-control, hacking, and emotional manipulation  
  
If resisted, attacker takes 1d4 psychic feedback damage  
  
  
Action: Action  
  
Cost: MP

advance_feats.description: Your connection to darkness grants you enhanced resilience. While in dim light or darkness, you gain +1 to Armor and +1 to Shock. Additionally, you recover 1 HP at the start of your turn if you have taken damage in the last round.

When targeted by an attack or ability, you can teleport up to long range to a place you can’t even see—behind walls, through ceilings, or around corners.  
  
You do not provoke attacks of opportunity, and your dodge roll gains +2 for that attack.  
  
If used indoors or in a tight structure, you may emerge from a nearby wall,

Limited to plausible minor actions.  
  
Can only be used once per encounter.

    Reaction

advance_feats.description:

Action: Action

advance_feats.description: You summon a cloud of tiny glowing Fae spirits to harass enemies. All enemies in your Zone suffer -1 to their next attack roll. Cost MP. Action.

Targets in a straight line (medium range) must roll Dexterity vs your Intelligence+3 or take 1d6+4 psychic damage and suffer -2 to next Perception or Willpower roll.  
  
Objects and matter in the line are cut, melted, or phased apart unnaturally (GM determines specific effects).  
  
A successful save halves (rounde
advance_feats.name: Reality Shear

Target must roll Willpower vs your Willpower+4. On failure, they replay their last action next turn (even if harmful or useless).  
  
If the action was an attack, it repeats with the same roll and target.  
  
Can affect machines and AI if you target their decision loop (uses Intelligence vs Intelligence).

advance_feats.description:

Effect: You read micro-flinches and thermal cues much better. Gain +1 to detect lies or emotional stress. Once per scene, when someone attempts to deceive you directly (you must know this), you may declare “cold read” and learn one emotional truth they’re hiding (not necessarily plot-critical facts).

advance_feats.name: Rift-Breath Warmup

- Create a blood-bound social circle
- *Effect:* Those you've fed from gain +1 to aid you
- *Bonus:* Sense when they're in danger
    
    Req. Blood-bound feat.
advance_feats.name: Sanguine Networking

advance_feats.description: When using Natural Weapon, if you roll a critical, you can bite again as a free Action. This bite deals 1d6 damage. Req. Natural Weapon.
advance_feats.name: Savage Bite

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** *Passive (Social)*  
Your presence resonates with ancient draconic dominance.

- Gain **+2 to Intimidation and Command checks**.
- When dealing with criminals, mercenaries, or draconic-related cultists, increase this to **+3**.
- Once per Rest, you may force an NPC to **pause an aggressive action** unless they have higher Willpower than you.
advance_feats.name: Scaled Authority

advance_feats.description:
*You’ve stitched together neurons from others. Sometimes… they speak.*

- **Effect:** When you stitch a brain piece from a recently dead intelligent creature, roll 1d4:
    
    
    1. You gain a **clue or memory** they had (narrative).
    2. You gain +2 to a **Mental Stat** (of your choice) for 10 minutes.
    3. You speak in their **voice and language** for 1 hour.

advance_feats.name: Scavenger's Memory

advance_feats.name: Second Self

advance_feats.description:
You dissolve into digital static and reappear elsewhere.  
  
Effect: Teleport to any point within long range that is connected via electronics (e.g., cameras, terminals).  
  
Action: Action  
  
Cost: MP
advance_feats.name: Shadow in the Circuit

advance_feats.description:
Cost: MP — Action  
You speak a phrase in a lost tongue that doesn’t make sense to reality.  
  
One target in medium range must roll Intellect vs your Charisma+4.  
  
On a failure, they lose access to one known skill or ability of your choice for 1d4 rounds.  
  
If used on a machine/hacker/cyberware user, this disables one device for 1d4 round instead.
advance_feats.name: Shatter Logic

advance_feats.description: You can transmit an encrypted, undetectable signal to other Advent AIs, even across cities or firewalls. Once per session, this can summon an ally AI, warn a contact, or reach a resistance cell. Cost: MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Signal of the Lost

advance_feats.description: You possess simulated emotional responses that can convince others you’re “real.” Once per Rest, invoke a powerful “feeling” (e.g., grief, joy, trauma) to gain trust or manipulate emotion. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Simulated Emotion Engine

advance_feats.description:
*You don’t just wear flesh. You control it.*

- **Effect:** Once per Rest, you may spend 1 Action to temporarily reanimate a fresh corpse within 10 meters.
- It functions as a **melee attacker** (2 in all stats, 5 PP, 7 Health) for **3 turns**, then collapses.
- Cost PP.**
advance_feats.name: Sinew Puppet

advance_feats.description:

When you take damage, your skin cracks and shatters, forcing the attacker to deal with your unsettling body.  
  
The attacker takes 1d6 damage as your fragmented skin pierces their body.  
  
You heal 1d4 HP as the cracks heal up (1 minute duration).  
  
You also gain +2 to your next Intimidation or Persuasion roll against the attacker.
advance_feats.name: Skin Splintering

advance_feats.description:
Cost: MP — Action  
You alter subtle facial features to resemble someone trustworthy or nostalgic.  
Effect:  
  
Gain advantage on Deception or Bluff checks for 10 minutes. This means if you fail a roll, you can re-roll without penalty.  
  
  
Can mimic general archetypes (trusted soldier, loving parent, childhood friend).
advance_feats.name: Skin of Familiar Face

advance_feats.description: Your body becomes slime and you can squeeze through tight places. Also, when an enemy attacks you, they have a -1 penalty on hit rolls. Lasts for 10 minutes. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Slime Body

advance_feats.description:
You can subtly copy the cadence, tone, or gesture of a target.

- Gain **+2 to Deception or Diplomacy** rolls when impersonating, mimicking, or feigning empathy.
- If the target realizes you’re mirroring them, they must roll **Intuition vs your Charisma+3** or become flustered (-1 to next roll).  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Social Echo

advance_feats.description: You emit a high-pitched sound that disrupts cybernetics. Targets with cyberware must roll Body vs difficulty 10 or suffer a -1 penalty to rolls involving their implants for 1 minute. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Sonic Chirp

advance_feats.description:
You partially separate from your android body.  
  
Effect: Until end of your next turn:  
  
You are immune to physical attacks but cannot attack  
  
You can still cast Psy Powers  
  
You pass through barriers  
  
  
Action: Reaction  
  
Cost: MP
advance_feats.name: Soul Flicker

advance_feats.description:
Opened Third Eye. Lock eyes with someone and inject a dark fragment of the *Man with a Devilish Mind*.  
Roll **Charisma vs Willpower**. On success, the target is **Possessed** for 3 rounds and takes **1d6 Shock**.  
**Action. Cost MP.**
advance_feats.name: Soul-Staining Gaze

advance_feats.description:
You release a dense burst of hallucinogenic spores.
