Effect: Everyone (except you) in the current Zone must roll Willpower vs your Body+3 or suffer one:  
  
1\. -2 to all rolls until end of next turn  
  
  
2\. Fall prone while overwhelmed by illusions  
  
  
3\. Randomly target a creature in Zone due to confusion
advance_feats.name: Spore Cloud

advance_feats.description: You spray a Blood cloud which confuses enemies and hides yourself. It covers medium distance and while in it you are invisible to naked eye, enemies still can hear you. Reaction. Cost PP and Health.
advance_feats.name: Spray Blood

advance_feats.description:
You coordinate fire with an ally in the same Zone.  
  
Effect: Choose one ally. Both of you can reroll your next ranged attack and take the better result. This bonus lasts for 1 round.  
Cost: MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Staggered Fire Support

advance_feats.description: If a melee attack misses you, you can step aside from immediate range of your attacker. Cost PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Step Aside

advance_feats.description: If you are successfully attacked in melee with a melee weapon, you can use a Reaction to make this weapon stick to your body, disarming the attacker (doesn't work on attackers with Strength 8 and above). Reaction. Cost PP.
advance_feats.name: Stick to Flesh

advance_feats.description: You have sensitive ears, gain +1 bonus to perception rolls for hearing things. You can also make your hearing better and gain +2 bonus instead of +1, but loud sounds can hurt you.
advance_feats.name: Superior Hearing

advance_feats.description:
You trigger an internal blood booster sac, pushing oxygen and synthetic hormones to the limit.  
  
Passive Effect: +1 to resist torture rolls and athletic rolls.  
  
Active Effect: For 3 turns, gain +2 Armor and reduce all incoming damage by 2.  
  
Addiction Risk: After effect ends, roll Constitution vs 14 or become Fatigued (-2 to all rolls) for 1 hour.  
Cost: PP and charge of AH. Action.

--
advance_feats.name: Synthetic Blood Surge

advance_feats.description:
You stabilize allies under fire.  
  
Effect: Choose one ally in the same Zone. You shield them with two of your arms or body, giving them +2 Armor until the start of your next turn. If they’re moved, you may choose to be moved with them.  
Cost: PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Tactical Anchor

advance_feats.description:
The roots and fungus underfoot come alive.  
  
Effect: Choose a Zone with plant life or fungal presence, long range. Anyone entering or starting turn there must roll Dexterity vs 12 or be restrained (can’t move until they succeed a Body vs 10 roll).  
  
Lasts: 3 turns  
  
Cost: MP  
  
Type: Action
advance_feats.name: Tendril Ambush

advance_feats.description:
*You’ve replaced your eye with someone else’s — and it still sees what they feared.*

- **Effect:** Gain a **+2 bonus to Intuition** when detecting lies, traps, or hidden motives for 10 hours.
- Once per rest, you may **recall a flash** of the donor’s final moment — ask the GM for a narrative clue or short vision.
    
    Action. Cost PP.
advance_feats.name: The Eye Remembers

advance_feats.description:
You’ve grown spiny internal growths that pierce those who harm you.  
  
Effect: Whenever you are hit in melee, deal 1d4 damage back to the attacker automatically.  
  
Bonus: If the attacker is a living creature, they also take -1 to further melee attacks against you until the end of this round.  
  
Type: Passive.
advance_feats.name: Thorned Blood

advance_feats.description: Once per combat, you can reroll a failed Save as if you had foreseen the attack. Cost MP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Time’s Favor

advance_feats.description:
You call on the primal guardian spirits of nature.  
  
Effect: Create an ethereal totem in your Zone lasting 3 rounds. It grants allies in the same Zone +1 to saves and 1 Shock healing per round.  
  
Limitation: Cannot summon more than one Totem per Scene.  
  
Cost: MP.  
  
Type: Action.
advance_feats.name: Totemic Pulse

advance_feats.description: You can try to administer a potent toxin by touch; the target rolls Body vs difficulty 11, you can also roll Dexterity to try to administer it unnoticed. It deals 1d6+2 H toxic damage that ignores armor and it lasts 2 rounds. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Toxic Touch

advance_feats.description: Your body has developed complete immunity to all forms of toxic damage. Additionally, you can safely handle and apply toxins without risk of accidental exposure. Req. Toxin resistance feat.
advance_feats.name: Toxin Immunity

advance_feats.description:
You share your senses with an animal companion.  
  
Effect: As long as your familiar is within 1 kilometer, you can see and hear through its eyes at will, and speak through it telepathically.  
  
Bonus: Your familiar can use one of your social or psy powers (choose per 2 hours).  
  
Type: Passive.
advance_feats.name: Twin of Fur or Feather

advance_feats.description:
You gain **+2 to Dexterity checks** to avoid being restrained, disarmed, or knocked prone.  
**Passive.**
advance_feats.name: Twisted Reflexes

advance_feats.description: You can teleport through shadows, moving up to 2 Zones feet to a location within line of sight that is in dim light or darkness. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Cost PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Umbral Step

advance_feats.description:
- Your word is law—enforced by tradition and threat.
- **Effect:** If you swear an oath (or make a deal), breaking it causes the offender to suffer **-2 to all Social rolls** against dwarves until they make amends.
- **Bonus:** You can **sense when someone plans to betray you** (roll Perception vs their Charisma).
advance_feats.name: Unbreakable Contract

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP — Action  
You plant a seed of unreality in a Zone or target.  
  
For 3 rounds, reality bends—surfaces twist, voices echo backward, gravity reverses or fluctuates.  
  
All rolls in the area take -1 penalty, and anyone using technology must roll to avoid malfunction (Intelligence vs 12).  
  
You may force a Willpower save vs your Charisma+2. On failure, targets gain the “Unstable” condi
advance_feats.name: Unreality Bloom

advance_feats.description: When you use Brutal Charge, if your attack hits, the target must roll Body vs difficulty 12 or be knocked prone. Req. Brutal Charge. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Unstoppable Charge

advance_feats.description:
Cost: 2 MP & 2 Health  
Action: Yes  
Plant a parasitic seed in a corpse. After 2 turns, it explodes into a writhing organic bloom.  
Passive: Anyone in Zone receives -2 to Psy resistance  
Active Trigger (1x/combat): You can cause it to unleash a psychic scream: Willpower vs 14 or become Stunned (can't use Actions) for 1 round.
advance_feats.name: Vampiric Bloom

advance_feats.description: Your next successful hacking attempt against a hostile system implants a delay-virus. Target system or drone suffers 1d6 ongoing damage for 3 rounds unless rebooted. Cost: MP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Viral Strike

advance_feats.description:
You emit an aura of primal dominance over natural life.  
  
Effect: All hostile or neutral animals and beasts in medium range must roll Willpower vs your Charisma+3 or become passive.  
  
Bonus: Allies in range gain +1 to rolls involving animal handling, herbalism, or survival.  
  
Cost: PP  
  
Type: Action.
advance_feats.name: Warden of the Wild

advance_feats.description:
Cost: MP — Action  
You focus your eldritch powers into your eyes, forcing anyone who meets your gaze to witness their worst nightmare. You can use a Reaction to change the target of your gaze.  
  
Target must make a Willpower vs your Intellect+3.  
  
On failure, the target suffers hallucinations, giving them a -1 penalty to all rolls for 1 minute. They also attack at random.  
  
Targets who ar
advance_feats.name: Warping Gaze

advance_feats.description:
You unleash a spinning flurry of limb strikes.  
  
Effect: Make up to 4 unarmed or melee weapon attacks against targets in your Zone. Each attack must target a different enemy. Each attack has a -1 penalty to hit.  
Cost: PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Whirlwind Brutality

advance_feats.description: You can speak with plants and animals, gaining basic information about recent events in the area. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Whisper of the Wilds

advance_feats.description:
You hear the All-Mother’s will and act accordingly.  
  
Trigger: An enemy attempts to deceive, lie, or charm you.  
  
Effect (Reaction): You gain insight into their intent.  
  
Gain +3 to resist the effect and can expose the lie to others (+2 bonus to social rolls for 1 turn).  
  
  
Cost: PP  
  
Type: Reaction
advance_feats.name: Whispers from the Womb-Tree

advance_feats.description:
You may whisper to an ally through the psychic bond at any distance. If they are asleep, you can deliver a message or nightmare that gives them **advantage or disadvantage** on their next Willpower roll (your choice).  
**Action. Cost MP. No line of sight needed.**
advance_feats.name: Whispers of the Devil

advance_feats.description: You grow wings, you can fly up to an adjacent Zone. Lasts for 10 minutes. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Wings

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP — Action  
Your flesh reshapes into a soothing or horrifying face.  
  
Gain +2 bonus to the next Persuasion or Intimidation attempt.  
  
Target must make Charisma vs 12 or be distracted, losing their next Reaction.  
  
Lasts 1 minute or until next social interaction ends.
advance_feats.name: Wriggling Mask

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Passive — exploration  
**Effect:** You always know the direction of:

- incoming storms
- electromagnetic disturbances
- malfunctioning tech  
    within **very long range**.  
    You gain +2 to all navigation and tracking checks tied to weather or electricity.
advance_feats.name: ⚡ Stormsense Drift

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Action — social influence  
**Cost:** 2 PP  
**Range:** long  
**Effect:** Your voice becomes booming, crackling with static.  
You can address a large crowd clearly even in rain, chaos, or riot-level noise.  
Crowds are **compelled to silence** for one sentence you speak, then react normally.  
**Narrative:** incredible for speeches, protests, leadership, or threats.  
**Cooldown:** onc
advance_feats.name: ⚡ Thunder Voice

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** *Action*

*Cost MP*  
Unleash a bolt of psionic lightning.

- Hit one target for **1d6+2 Shock and 1d4+2 Health, target must roll Willpower roll vs your Body or Intellect roll**
- Then arc to a second target in *short range* for **2 Shock damage to yourself**
advance_feats.name: ⚡Chain Bolt Arc

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** *Reaction*

*Cost PP*

*Once per round*  
When targeted by a ranged attack:

- Gain **+3 to Dodge attack**
advance_feats.name: ⚡Voltage Reflex

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Action — social contract  
**Cost:** 2 MP  
**Range:** immediate  
**Effect:** You invoke a cold-oath binding.  
Two willing or unwilling targets must roll **Willpower (10+)** or freeze briefly and speak a single secret.  
If both willingly join, both gain +1 to Intellect for 10 minutes (calm clarity).  
**Narrative:** used in diplomacy, hostage negotiations, gang truces.  
**Cooldown:**
advance_feats.name: ❄️ Chill-Bound Oath

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** *Action*

*Cost MP*  
You form temporary ice armor.

- Gain **+3 temporary Armor** for 2 turns.
advance_feats.name: ❄️ Crystal Ward

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Passive — stealth/narration  
**Effect:** You leave **no audible step sounds** on any surface.  
On soft ground (mud, dust) your footprints fade after **5 seconds**, melting then refreezing into smooth patches.  
**Narrative:** highly useful for infiltration but does not help with visual detection directly.
advance_feats.name: ❄️ Frost-Still Footprints

advance_feats.description:
Type: Passive  
Cost: none  
Effect: Your dermal layers partly crystallize. Gain +1 natural armor. Once per encounter, reduce any single incoming damage source by 4.
advance_feats.name: ❄️ Glacial Ward-Skin

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Reaction — when someone challenges your authority in conversation  
**Cost:** 2 MP  
**Effect:** They momentarily see an unsettling mask overlay your face (illusory rot).  
They must roll Willpower (12+) or **fall silent**, granting you narrative leverage.  
**Cooldown:** once per scene.
advance_feats.name: 💀 Rot-Mask Etiquette

advance_feats.description:
Type: Reaction — being struck by metal weapon  
Cost: 2 PP  
Effect: The blade or bullet corrodes on impact. Roll d6: on 1–2 take half damage rounded down, on 3–4 don't take damage, on 5–6 don't take damage and this weapon is unusable till end of combat.  
Cooldown: twice per encounter.
advance_feats.name: 💀 Rustbite Counter

advance_feats.description:
Type: Action  
Cost: 2 MP  
Effect: You raise a dead body; it serves you until the next Rest. This servant has the same stats as the dead body but halved rounded down.  
Cooldown: once per Rest.
advance_feats.name: 💀 Skeletal Echo

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Action — narrative investigation  
**Cost:** 2 MP  
**Range:** short  
**Effect:** You place a hand on an old object (ruin, artifact, corpse-adjacent material).  
You receive a **brief sensory echo of the past**:  
a sound, an emotion, or a 10-second visual flash.  
**Not a full vision**, but enough to guide investigations.  
**Cooldown:** once per hour.
advance_feats.name: 💀 Whisper of Old Bones

advance_feats.description:
Type: Reaction — when someone within **medium range** attacks an ally  
Cost: 2 PP  
Effect: Heat roars off your skin. The attacker suffers −2 to their hit roll and takes 2 Shock from searing feedback.  
Cooldown: once per round.
advance_feats.name: 🔥 Cinder Claim

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Passive — narrative  
**Cost:** —  
**Effect:** You unconsciously emit a faint ember-smell tied to comfort and warmth.  
People from small communities, shelters, and low-status districts instinctively trust you:

- **+2 to social checks** when dealing with frightened civilians, refugees, or children.
- You may defuse a crowd panic once per day without rolling.
advance_feats.name: 🔥 Hearth-Memory Scent

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Action — mobility/combat  
**Cost:** PP  
**Effect:** Leap through a streak of fire up to Very long range.

- Your next melee attack within the same turn deals **+2 fire damage**.
- If you land adjacent to an enemy, they must roll Body (8+) or take **4 fire damage** from residual heat.
advance_feats.name: 🔥 Searing Vault

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** *Reaction*  
When struck by a melee attack:

- Deal **1d4 fire damage** back to the attacker and ignite them, dealing 1d4+1 fire damage at the end of their turn; they must roll Body (13+) to put the fire out.
-
advance_feats.name: 🔥Blazing Reprisal

advance_feats.description:
Type: Passive  
Cost: none  
Effect: Your mind rotates faster. You gain +2 Speed. Once per encounter, reroll any failed Intuition test (take the second result).
advance_feats.name: 🧠 Dreamwheel Acceleration

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Action — social/narration  
**Cost:** 2 MP  
**Range:** immediate  
**Effect:** You touch an object or surface and receive a **small emotional residue** of the last person who touched it.

- anger, fear, calm, desire, curiosity.  
    No facts, just emotional imprint.  
    **Narrative Use:** picking up mood clues in investigations or interrogations.  
    **Cooldown:** once per scene.
advance_feats.name: 🧠 Memory Step

advance_feats.description:
Type: Action — mental combat  
Cost: 2 MP  
Effect: Target someone within **long range**. You create a psionic tether for 2 rounds. Each time they attack, they roll d6: on 1–3 they attack their target, on 4–6 they attack allies or don't attack.  
Cooldown: once per 2 rounds.
advance_feats.name: 🧠 Mind-Spike Tether

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Passive — group social benefit  
**Effect:** In conversations with groups (2–5 allies), you can subtly align emotional states.  
All allies gain **+1 to persuasion or negotiation** when working together.  
Does not affect hostile NPCs.  
Does not read minds — just emotional synchronization.
advance_feats.name: 🧠 Silent Consensus

advance_feats.description:
Type: Action — social/fear  
Cost: 2 MP  
Effect: Exhale a low-frequency shadow-sound toward one creature in **short range**. They must roll Willpower (13+) or become rattled (−2 to their next two rolls and unable to approach you for 2 rounds).  
Cooldown: once per encounter.
advance_feats.name: 🩶 Black Holler

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Action — clandestine communication  
**Cost:** 2 MP  
**Range:** long  
**Effect:** You whisper a message into a shadow, and one willing target standing inside another shadow hears it.  
The message is silent to all others.  
**Narrative:** perfect for spy craft, undercover ops, stealth teams.  
**Cooldown:** once per 10 minutes.
advance_feats.name: 🩶 Murkmind Exchange

advance_feats.description:
Type: Passive  
Cost: none  
Effect: Your outline blurs subtly. Gain +1 to Stealth. When remaining still for a round, attackers have −1 to hit you until you move again.
advance_feats.name: 🩶 Slip-Skin Distortion

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Action — narrative / utility / combat  
**Cost:** 2 PP  
**Effect:** From any *short range* shadow, you pull out a small tool, weapon, or object stored in darkness (up to dagger size). If it is a rare or imported item, then you must roll your Dexterity.  
**Uses:** twice per session.
advance_feats.name: 🩶 Whisperknife Recall

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Action  
**Cost:** 2 MP + **2 Shock**  
**Range:** long  
**Effect:** Choose up to 4 targets, every target rolls d10, every target after the first gains +1/+2/+3 to their roll; on a roll of 1–3 the target starts bleeding and singing and stops doing anything, after 3 rounds they bloom; on a 4–6 roll the target takes 1d10 Health damage ignoring armor; on 7–10 the target takes half damage r
advance_feats.name: 🩸 Blood Bloom

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Action — investigation/social  
**Cost:** 2 PP or 2 MP  
**Range:** immediate  
**Effect:** By smelling a drop of someone’s blood (fresh or dried), you gain one of:

- their emotional state
- their physical fatigue level
- whether they have lied in the last minute  
    **Narrative:** excellent for detectives, interrogators, and cyberdocs.  
    **Cooldown:** 1/scene.
advance_feats.name: 🩸 Blood-Scent Insight

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Passive  
**Cost:** —  
**Effect:** You can “smell” bloodline kinship.

- Detect familial relation out to **long range** (parents, children, siblings are obvious; cousins or distant kin require a roll).
- Grants **+2 to social checks** when mediating family disputes or negotiating between blood relatives.
advance_feats.name: 🩸 Scent of Lineage

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Action — combat  
**Cost:** 2 PP or 2 Health (your choice)  
**Effect:** You hyper-pressurize your bloodstream.  
For 3 turns:

- +2 to melee hit
- +2 melee damage
- If you kill or incapacitate a target, heal **2 Health**  
      
    **Uses:** once per encounter.
advance_feats.name: 🩸 Vascular Overdrive

advance_feats.description: Once per session, you can enter a heightened state of focus for 3 rounds. During this time, you gain +2 to all physical rolls and attacks but take 1 Shock damage at the end of each round. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Adrenaline Surge

advance_feats.description: You can dual-wield firearms without any penalty. Additionally, you can use two Actions to fire both weapons, gaining +1 to this attack's hit and damage roll. Req. Ambidextrous.
advance_feats.name: Bullet Ballet

advance_feats.description: Gain an additional Reaction per round, usable for dodge.
advance_feats.name: Combat Reflexes

advance_feats.description: Gain +2 MP and +2 Shock. Req. Psy Resistant.
advance_feats.name: Fortified Mind

advance_feats.description: Gain +2 to rolls against mind-control or fear effects.
advance_feats.name: Indomitable Will

advance_feats.description: You now have an additional +1 bonus to a chosen Stat specialization. Req. Jack of Trade.
advance_feats.name: Jack of All Trades, Master of Some
advance_feats.namel: jack of all trades, master of some

advance_feats.description: Your custom drugs now have heightened potency. When creating a drug, you can add one of the following effects: +2 to any stat for 1 hour, recover 5 Health, or resist one condition for 2 rounds. Costs PP. Action. Req. Modern Alchemist.
advance_feats.name: Master Alchemist

advance_feats.description:
You know five additional languages and can identify obscure dialects or ciphers with a roll.
Languages you can take:
Human
Elvish
Runic(Dwarf)
Eldritch(Fae)
Dragonspeak
Old Elvish(Crimson elf)
Machine
advance_feats.name: Master Linguist

advance_feats.description: Integrate an AI companion into your cyberdex. This AI grants a +1 bonus to hacking rolls and can autonomously defend against incoming hacking attempts once per combat. Requires the Cyberdex Creator feat.
advance_feats.name: AI Integration

advance_feats.description: You gain +1/+2/+3/+4 bonus to armor and 0/-1/-2/-3 penalty to dodge for 3 rounds; those bonuses correspond to the rarity of the armor you are wearing: simple/standard/advanced/exceptional. Action. Once per combat.
advance_feats.name: Absolute Fortress

advance_feats.description: Develop learning algorithms that let your drones or programmz adapt during combat. Each successful use of a drone or hacking action grants a cumulative +1 (up to +3) to its rolls until the end of combat. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Adaptive Algorithms

advance_feats.description:
Choose 2 effects from the list below before an attack.

- **+1d6 damage**
- **Ignore 4 Armor**
- **Target cannot use Reactions this round**
- **Target is Blinded for 1 round**. **Cost:** PP. **Reaction.**
advance_feats.name: Adaptive Brutality

advance_feats.description: Leave a mental anchor in your body, allowing you to return instantly from Astral Projection if your body is attacked. Costs MP. Reaction. Requires the Astral Projection feat.
advance_feats.name: Astral Anchor

advance_feats.description: You can try to create a Lambda augment or augment feat. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty This augment has +1 feat slot. Costs MP. Requires Aug Expert.
advance_feats.name: Aug Master

advance_feats.description: Permanently disable an augment on a target. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty This can only be undone by a Cyberdoc of equal or greater skill. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Augment Nullifier

advance_feats.description: Not only can you see auras, but you can also manipulate them to confuse or soothe others. Roll Willpower vs Difficulty. On success, the target's emotions are altered as you choose for 1 minute. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Aura Manipulation

advance_feats.description: You have access to exclusive illegal markets and can acquire rare or restricted items at a 20% discount. Additionally, gain +1 to rolls involving smuggling or negotiating with underground contacts.
advance_feats.name: Black Market Mastermind

advance_feats.description: You make two melee attacks against targets in immediate range. Each attack roll suffers a -2 penalty but deals an extra 2d6+1 damage on a hit. Costs PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Blade Storm

advance_feats.description:
You destroy someone's online credibility in seconds.

- Roll **Intellect vs Difficulty** On success, you fabricate or surface evidence to discredit a public figure or corp rep.
- Target loses all social influence with one faction or community for 24 hours.
- Can only be done once per week.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Cancel Culture Expert

advance_feats.description:
You’re a legend to the working class and fighters alike.

- Once per session, **you can auto-pass a social check** when dealing with fighters, rebels, or civilians.
- You also gain **+2 to social rolls** when giving speeches or leading in chaotic or riotous settings.
advance_feats.name: Champion of the Streets

advance_feats.description:
You emit a psychic burst of collective feeling—fear, awe, sorrow, or unity.

- Everyone in your Zone must roll **Charisma vs your Willpower+3** or adopt the emotion for 1 minute.
- You gain **+2 to all social rolls** with affected targets for that duration.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Collective Pulse

advance_feats.description: When stabilizing an ally, restore 8 Health and 4 Shock instead of the usual amounts. Also removes the Bleeding condition. Costs PP. Reaction. Requires Extended Stabilize feat.
advance_feats.name: Combat Medic

advance_feats.description: You can combine two weapon, armor, augment, or drone feats together. They must be feats of the same type. If those feats have a damage value, take the highest value. Must be done upon Rest. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty Action. Requires Master Craftier.
advance_feats.name: Combo

advance_feats.description:
All allies in your Zone gain:

- **+1 to attack rolls**, **+1 to damage**, and may reroll one failed attack per combat. **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Commanding Presence

advance_feats.description: When an enemy misses you in melee combat, you can immediately counterattack. Roll as normal; if you hit, deal your weapon's critical damage. Costs PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Counterstrike

advance_feats.description: Gain +2 to rolls involving interacting with, repairing, or hacking cybernetics. Additionally, you can identify cybernetic implants at a glance.
advance_feats.name: Cybernetic Affinity

advance_feats.description: Once per combat, you can turn a ranged miss into a hit. Costs MP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Deadeye

advance_feats.description: You deal critical damage with weapons on 9-10 rolls.
advance_feats.name: Deadly Assassin

advance_feats.description:
Requires Hunt Prey feat.

Instead of getting an extra Action and Reaction, you now gain an extra turn right after the Prey was killed.
advance_feats.name: Devour Prey

advance_feats.description:
You are revered in the online space by a movement, cult, or faction.

- Once per session, you may **rally a swarm of supporters** (bots, fans, loyal hackers) to assist you socially or provide a tactical edge (distraction, info leak, digital riot).
- Gain **+3 to all social interactions with followers or digital radicals**.
advance_feats.name: Digital Messiah

advance_feats.description: You can restore a destroyed drone or corrupted programmz to full operational status once per session. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Digital Rebirth

advance_feats.description: When caught in a lie, you can attempt to reverse the situation and accuse the accuser of deception instead. Roll Charisma vs their Intuition. On success, you flip the narrative and they lose credibility.
advance_feats.name: Double Bluff

advance_feats.description: You can leap an incredible distance, landing in up to 2 adjacent Zones and making an immediate attack against a target. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Dragon Leap

advance_feats.description: You enter Dragon Stance; your unarmed attacks deal 1d8+1 damage and an additional 1d8+1 fire damage, but you gain a -1 penalty to armor. Action. Stance.
advance_feats.name: Dragon Stance

advance_feats.description: You summon a swarm of small, disposable drones to disorient and attack enemies in a single zone. All enemies roll with a -2 penalty to hit and take 1d6 damage per round for 3 rounds. Requires two drones to be sacrificed. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Drone Swarm Protocol

advance_feats.description: Your EMP blasts now affect only targeted electronics, leaving allies and their systems unaffected. Additionally, the damage increases to 1d8+3 Shock. Costs MP. Action. Requires EMP Blast feat.
advance_feats.name: EMP Precision

advance_feats.description: Use your cyberdex to generate an electromagnetic pulse in the current zone. All electronics, including enemy drones and augments, must roll against your Intellect or be disabled for 2 rounds. Costs MP and PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: EMP Pulse

advance_feats.description: You strike so quickly that your punch creates a force wave. Your unarmed attack becomes a ranged attack within long distance and deals 1d8+1 damage. Costs PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Echo Punch

advance_feats.description:
You subtly implant a short thought or desire in a target’s mind.

- Roll **Willpower vs Willpower**. On success, target believes the idea came from them (e.g., “maybe I should trust her”).
- Only works if the idea isn’t extreme or wildly out of character.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Echo Thought

advance_feats.description:
You can hack someone's nervous system with a handshake or stare.

- Once per Rest, roll **Intellect+3 vs target's Willpower**. On success, the target becomes **calm, compliant, or pliable** for the next 2 interactions.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Experimental Persuasion

advance_feats.description: Gain 2 Arcanist psy powers of Rank 3.
advance_feats.name: Expert Arcanist Spells

advance_feats.description: You can try to create an advanced armor, advanced weapon, armor feat, or weapon feat. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. If it's armor or weapon, it has 3 feat slots. Costs MP. Requires Amateur Craftier
advance_feats.name: Expert Craftier

advance_feats.description: Gain 2 Curser psy powers of Rank 3.
advance_feats.name: Expert Curser Spells

advance_feats.description: Gain 2 Yellow Priest psy powers of Rank 3.
advance_feats.name: Expert Yellow Priest Spells

advance_feats.description: You gain a +2 bonus to crafting and disarming explosives. Additionally, grenades you craft have a +3 damage bonus.
advance_feats.name: Explosive Expert

advance_feats.description:
You give a brutal, punchy speech that ignites your allies.

- All allies within hearing gain:
    
    
    - **+2 to hit rolls**
    - **+1 to damage**
    - **+2 to Willpower saves**
    - Lasts 3 rounds.  
        **Cost:** MP. **Action.** Once per combat.
advance_feats.name: Fight Speech

advance_feats.description:
Req. Deadman’s Push feat.

Once per combat, when reduced to 0 HP, instead of falling:

- **You remain active for 1 more turn**, immune to death and debuffs.
- On that turn, you gain **+2 to all rolls**, and **+2d4 damage** on all attacks.  
    **After turn ends**, you fall unconscious.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Reaction (at 0 HP).**
advance_feats.name: Final Word

advance_feats.description:
Your presence can hijack and dominate any digital environment.

- You can appear across all screens, comms, and feeds in a Zone to speak or threaten.
- All NPCs must roll **Willpower vs Intellect** or suffer **-2 to next action** due to disorientation or fear.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Ghost in the Feed

advance_feats.description: You can run seemingly on thin air. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Gravity Defier

advance_feats.description:
Once per round, you can **automatically dodge** an incoming attack.

- **Cost:** PP. **Reaction. Once per round.**
advance_feats.name: Hardened Reflex

advance_feats.description:
Requires Craft Grenade feat.

You throw a custom explosive that releases shrapnel and fire. Long range.

- Targets in the blast (Zone) take **2d6+3 damage**, and **bleed 1d6 per turn** for 2 rounds.
- Area becomes **hazardous** for 1 round (burns anyone who moves through it dealing 1d6 fire damage).  
    **Cost:** PP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Hell Grenade

advance_feats.description: Your web of contacts and false identities is so vast that you can call on anyone for help. You can access information, resources, or assistance from your network. Roll Charisma vs Difficulty. On success, you gain valuable support or intelligence that can aid you in a mission or negotiation. Costs PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Hidden Network

advance_feats.description: Your cyberdex synchronizes perfectly with your neural interface, granting a +2 bonus to all hacking rolls and a +1 to drone effectiveness while active. Lasts 10 minutes. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Hyper-Synchronization

advance_feats.description: You project an AR hologram of yourself, creating a decoy. Enemies must roll Intuition vs your Charisma to distinguish between you and the decoy. The decoy lasts for 3 rounds or until attacked. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Illusory Persona

advance_feats.description: Once per combat, when reduced to 0 Health, you can stand back up with 5 Health and 3 Shock. Costs MP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Indomitable Spirit

advance_feats.description: You enter Iron Fist Stance and your unarmed attacks deal 1d12+1 damage, and you gain +1 armor, but your movement to an adjacent Zone costs 1 more Action. Action. Stance.
advance_feats.name: Iron Fist Stance

advance_feats.description: Reduce incoming damage by 3 for the next 3 rounds. This can stack with armor. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Iron Resolve

advance_feats.description: When hit by an enemy attack, you can use the momentum to propel yourself forward, moving up to a medium distance and gaining +2 to your next attack roll. Costs PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Kinetic Rebound

advance_feats.description: If you successfully dodge an attack, you gain +1 to your next attack roll and +1 to dodge until your next turn. Req. Flowing Strike feat.
advance_feats.name: Lightning Reflexes

advance_feats.description:
Your name inspires awe, fear, or admiration.

- Once per session, you can **auto-succeed on a social interaction** where your fame/reputation matters.
- Additionally, you gain **+2 to all Charisma-based rolls** when interacting with anyone who knows your deeds.
advance_feats.name: Living Legend

advance_feats.description: Spend all your remaining Luck Points to turn any failed roll into an automatic critical success. This feat can only be used once per session. Action.
advance_feats.name: Lucky Gambit

advance_feats.description: You can link the minds of multiple individuals and communicate telepathically. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. On success, you can communicate with up to 5 people at once, and they can reply mentally. This link lasts for 60 minutes. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Mass Telepathy

advance_feats.description: You can try to create an exceptional armor, exceptional weapon, armor feat, or weapon feat. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. If it's armor or weapon, it has 4 feat slots. Costs MP. Requires Expert Craftier
advance_feats.name: Master Craftier

advance_feats.description:
You can play two sides against each other with ease.

- Once per session, you may **convince two hostile groups to distrust each other instead of you**, even temporarily.
- Requires at least **one minute of dialogue** with each side.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Master Manipulator

advance_feats.description:
Your personas are so perfect, they pass legal and digital scrutiny.

- Gain **+3 to rolls involving false identities**.
- Once per session, you may **instantly activate a new identity**, complete with digital footprint and voiceprint.
- You count as a different person to facial and biometric scanners.
advance_feats.name: Master of Masks

advance_feats.description: At the start of combat, you can coordinate multiple allies via your cyberdex, granting all allies in your zone +2 to Speed and +1 to all actions for the next 5 rounds. Costs PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Mastermind Protocol

advance_feats.description: You combine your weapon augment and one of your Stances. This combines the effects that the augment and Stance give you and you choose damage of augment or Stance. Requires you to have a minimum of 3 Stances. Lasts while you are in the chosen stance. Costs PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Metal Monk

advance_feats.description: You can fully control a person’s mind, bending them to your will for a limited time. Roll Willpower vs Difficulty. On success, you control the target’s actions for 10 minutes, or 1d4 rounds if in battle. The target may resist with a Willpower roll once every 10 seconds, or every round if in battle. Costs MP and Shock. Action.
advance_feats.name: Mind Domination

advance_feats.description:
You’ve turned enhancement into a movement.

- Gain a **follower faction** (fanatics, clients, test subjects, or believers) who idolize you and your augment philosophy.
- Once per session, you can **rally them** to provide aid, distraction, or protection.
- Gain **+2 to persuasion and intimidation** rolls when referencing your "followers" or philosophy.
advance_feats.name: Mod Cult Leader

advance_feats.description: After striking a target, you can dash to another Zone as part of the same action.
advance_feats.name: Momentum Dash

advance_feats.description: Deploy nanobots that repair allied cybernetics and heal minor wounds in a Zone. Restores 5 Health or Shock to all allies with cybernetics. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Nanobot Deployment

advance_feats.description: You can simultaneously control up to three drones, each performing separate tasks. All drones gain +1 to hit or effectiveness during their actions. Lasts 1 hour. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Omni-Control

advance_feats.description: Once per Rest, if you land a critical hit with a firearm, the target must roll a Body check (DC 15) or be instantly incapacitated. Does not work on bosses; instead, they take a bonus d10+2 damage. Reaction. Costs PP.
advance_feats.name: One Shot, One Kill

advance_feats.description: Push your cyberdex or drones to their absolute limits. For the next 3 rounds, all rolls made using your cyberdex or drones gain a +3 bonus, but you take 1 Shock per round due to system strain. Costs MP and is an Action.
advance_feats.name: Overclock

advance_feats.description: You prepare for enemy movement. Choose a Zone to watch; if an enemy enters or acts within that area, you can shoot them as a Reaction. Roll as normal to hit. Costs PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Overwatch

advance_feats.description: When an enemy in immediate range makes an attack, you can attempt to counter it before they act. Roll Dexterity vs their attack roll; on success, you interrupt their action and deal 1d6 damage. Costs PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Perfect Reflexes

advance_feats.description: Your unarmed attack ignores half armor rounded down. Additionally, once per combat, you can strike with such precision that the target is stunned for 1 round. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Phantom Strike

advance_feats.description: You’ve rigged your gear with hidden compartments and cloaking technology, allowing you to carry extra items (up to 10kg) undetectable to standard scans. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Pocket Dimension

advance_feats.description: You can unleash all your psychic energy in a single burst, dealing 1d12+1 S damage to all enemies in a Zone and stunning them for 1 round. You take 1d6+1 Shock damage as a backlash. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Psionic Overload

advance_feats.description: In a moment of extreme psychic focus, you can restore 50% of your lost Health or Shock (rounded down). This process is physically and mentally taxing. Roll Willpower vs Difficulty. On success, you restore Health or Shock equal to half your maximum total. Costs all your MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Psionic Reconstitution

advance_feats.description:
Your aura is unnaturally commanding or disturbing.

- Gain **+3 to all social rolls** made during direct interaction, but only while concentrating; if you get distracted, you lose concentration.
- Targets with lower Willpower or Intuition may become anxious or awestruck automatically.
advance_feats.name: Psychic Presence

advance_feats.description: You install an impenetrable firewall on your cyberdex, granting a +2 bonus to all defensive rolls against the hacking attempts. Lasts for 10 minutes. Costs MP and is an Action.
advance_feats.name: Quantum Firewall

advance_feats.description:
If a con starts to fall apart, you pivot the story entirely.

- When a social plan fails, you can **instantly change the lie's angle or objective**.
- Roll **Charisma+2 vs Intuition** of the listener. On success, you turn a failed lie into a plausible new one.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Reaction.**
advance_feats.name: Rewrite the Narrative

advance_feats.description:
You’re a living legend among medics, patients, or black-market surgeons.

- Once per session, when your name is recognized, you gain **+3 to all social rolls** for the rest of the scene.
- Also, you gain **one free use of a social feat** when dealing with fans, desperate patients, or rival docs.
advance_feats.name: Sawbones Celebrity

advance_feats.description: You can modify your own body to include one temporary augment of your design. This augment lasts for 1 hour and grants a specific bonus of your choice (subject to GM approval). Roll Intellect vs Difficulty Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Self-Modder

advance_feats.description: You can hit the ground with such force that all enemies in immediate range must roll Dexterity vs your Body. On failure, they fall prone and take 1d6+2 damage. Costs PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Shockwave Smash

advance_feats.description: Once per session, you can convince an NPC to act completely against their own interests for one turn or to reveal a critical piece of information without realizing they’ve done so. Roll Charisma vs their Intuition. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Silver Tongue

advance_feats.description:
Your performance is hypnotic.

- You may use **Charisma** to **control a crowd’s mood**.
- Roll Charisma vs Difficulty. On success, you sway the crowd to awe, fear, or support.
- Affects all NPCs in the Zone for 3 rounds or 10 minutes if outside of combat.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Stage Presence

advance_feats.description: Once per combat, you can direct an ally to take an Action out of turn. They gain a +2 bonus to their roll. Costs MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Tactical Mastermind

advance_feats.description:
You and 2 allies gain:

- **+2 to hit**, **+2 Action you can spend only on moving,** and can use **Reaction even if they've already used this round**. **Cost:** MP. **Action. Once per rest.**
advance_feats.name: Tactical Override

advance_feats.description: You can break through simple, standard, advanced and exceptional walls. If you break through an exceptional wall, roll Body vs Difficulty. Cost PP. Action. Requires the Heavy Breaker feat.
advance_feats.name: Thunder Breaker

advance_feats.description: You can create your own augmentations, weapons, and armor. Requires Master Craftier and Aug Master.
advance_feats.name: Ultimate Creator

advance_feats.description: You can convince anyone of anything, no matter how unbelievable, using the sheer force of your charm and cunning. Roll Charisma vs target’s Willpower. On success, you convince the target to follow your request or order without question, even if it goes against their best interests. Costs MP and Shock. Action.
advance_feats.name: Ultimate Persuasion

advance_feats.description:
Requires Living Legend feat.

You've seen too much to crack.

- Immune to fear, charm, or social debuffs unless from supernatural or divine origin.
- Gain **+2 to all resistance rolls vs mind control or telepathy.**
advance_feats.name: Unbreakable Will

advance_feats.description: You can disappear in a cloud of smoke, holographic distortion, or other misdirection. Roll **Dexterity vs Difficulty**. On success, you escape combat or pursuit and reappear in a hidden or safe location within **30 meters**. Costs **PP**. Action.
advance_feats.name: Vanishing Act

advance_feats.description:
Your words hit like fists.

- When you insult, threaten, or shame an enemy, roll **Dexterity + Strength vs Willpower**.
- On success, they take **1d6 mental damage** and suffer **-2 to their next action**.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Verbal Uppercut

advance_feats.description:
You say just the right words to shift a scene.

- You can use this feat to **convince a hostile or neutral NPC** to talk or walk away with you from a tense situation.
- Roll **Charisma+2 vs Difficulty**. On success, they follow you out of the scene for at least 1 minute.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.** Once per session.
advance_feats.name: Walk With Me

advance_feats.description:
Leap to a target in an adjacent Zone and strike with both weapons.

- Roll twice, each hit deals weapon damage +1d6.
- You gain **+2 to dodge** until start of your next turn.  
    **Cost:** PP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Zero Gap Elimination

advance_feats.description:
- Your true form breaks minds.
- **Effect:** When revealed, all witnesses roll **Willpower vs 18**—on failure, they **worship you** for the next 10 minutes, in combat it lasts for the next 4 rounds.
    
    Cost MP, PP, Health and Shock.
advance_feats.name: "I Am Your God Now"

advance_feats.description:
- Plants scream your words.
- **Effect:** Once per session, **issue a command all flora/animals in a Zone must obey** (e.g., *"Strangle them"*).
- **Cost:** MP
advance_feats.name: "I Am the Forest’s Tongue"

advance_feats.description:
- Your terms are non-negotiable.
- **Effect:** **Auto-succeed** on an Intimidation roll to **end a parley violently**.
- **Drawback:** Future diplomacy with this faction **starts at -3**.
advance_feats.name: "I Don’t Negotiate."

advance_feats.description:
- Your ultimatum breaks armies.
- **Effect:** Once per session, **demand surrender**—all enemies must roll **Willpower vs 16** or **drop their weapons**.
- **Cost:** AH charge.
advance_feats.name: "Kneel or Bleed."

advance_feats.description:
- Your mercy is a weapon.
- **Effect:** When sparing a foe, they **owe you a life debt** (breaking it deals **2d6 Shock damage**).
advance_feats.name: "Last Chance. Walk Away."

advance_feats.description:
- You unravel a target’s sanity.
- **Effect:** Roll **Intellect vs Willpower**—on success, they **perceive the world as an illusion and go crazy** (-2 to all rolls for **1 hour**).
advance_feats.name: "Nothing Is Real"

advance_feats.description:
- You turn a Zone into a haunted circuit.
- **Effect:** All electronics in the area **shriek your words**, forcing **Willpower 15** rolls or **panic**.
- **Cost:** MP + Shock.
advance_feats.name: "The Walls Are Screaming"

advance_feats.description:
- You speak with a thousand voices.
- **Effect:** Once per Rest, **everyone in a Zone hears their own voice** screaming commands (Willpower 16 or **attack allies** for 2 rounds). Reaction.
advance_feats.name: "We Are Legion"

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP, Health — Action  
You forcibly fuse two unwilling targets into a grotesque being.  
Effect:  
  
Roll Strength vs each target’s Body. If both fail, they merge into a single twisted creature for 1d4+2 rounds.  
  
The resulting being acts randomly each round: attacking, fleeing, or screaming in agony (GM decides).  
  
When it ends, both targets take 2d8 damage and suffer -2 to all action
advance_feats.name: Aberrant Amalgam

advance_feats.description: You trigger all of your mental diseases for 10 minutes. For each disease you have, you gain +1 to your Mental and Physical Stats for 10 minutes. Action. Cost MP.
advance_feats.name: Activate Madness

advance_feats.description:
Your body shifts in response to incoming tactics.  
  
Effect: After being hit by an attack, you gain +3 Armor against that damage type for 2 turns (ballistic, fire, shock, etc.).  
  
Trigger: Can be used once per round as a Reaction.  
  
Cost: PP.  
  
Type: Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Adaptive Countermeasures

advance_feats.description: Once per combat, you can reduce incoming melee or ranged damage by half by contorting your flesh at the point of impact. Cost PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Adaptive Flesh

advance_feats.description:
You adapt to enemy armor and tactics with precision.  
  
Effect: Choose one enemy. Until end of combat:  
  
You gain +2 to hit and ignore 3 Armor against them  
  
Action: Action  
  
Cost: PP
advance_feats.name: Adaptive Weapon Integration

advance_feats.description:
**Cost:** PP  
**Effect:** Instantly take **2 additional Actions** this turn.

- You suffer **1d6 Health damage** after using this ability.
- If you're at or below 0 Health, this ability **ignores the damage penalty** and stabilizes you at -1 HP.
- Can only be used **once per Combat**.
advance_feats.name: Adrenal Surge

advance_feats.description: Your slime body can now shapeshift into any humanoid form or seamlessly pass through barriers. While in this form, you gain +2 to Stealth and can mimic voices. Lasts up to 1 hour. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Amorphous Form

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Reaction — foresight / defense  
**Cost:** 3 MP + 3 Shock  
**Range:** Self  
**Trigger:** You are targeted by any attack or harmful effect.  
**Effect:** A holographic echo of your donor dragon shows you a glimpse of the immediate future.

Choose one:

- **Completely negate the attack**, regardless of type
- **Teleport (Short range)** and force the attack to strike another valid target
advance_feats.name: Ancestral Warning

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Action — combat / transformation  
**Cost:** 3 PP + 3 Health  
**Range:** Self  
**Effect:** You partially assume your progenitor dragon’s true form.

For **2 rounds**:

- Gain **+2 Strength**, **+2 Body**, and **+2 Armor**
- Your unarmed attacks deal **+2d6 elemental damage** (matching your bloodline)
advance_feats.name: Apex Dragon Form

advance_feats.description:
When you enter a room or battlefield, you dominate the vibe.

- Once per session, declare your presence. All NPCs in the scene must roll **Willpower vs your Body**.
- On failure, they are **either silenced, cautious, or respectful**, depending on context.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Apex Presence

advance_feats.description:
You seem like someone destined for greatness.

- While in a negotiation or tense moment, enemies or rivals suffer **-1 to resist** your Persuasion or Intimidation.
- Once per session, someone of importance will choose to **side with or assist you** even against logic.  
    **Passive.**
advance_feats.name: Aura of Inevitability

advance_feats.description:
You fully unleash your spirit, separating briefly from your machine body.  
  
Effect:  
  
Become incorporeal for 3 rounds: cannot be targeted by physical attacks  
  
You may fly and pass through barriers  
  
Your voice causes targets in medium range to roll Willpower vs Charisma+3 or flee from current Zone  
  
  
Action: Action  
  
Cost: PP
advance_feats.name: Banshee Ascendant

advance_feats.description: When you take damage, you can reduce it by half (rounded down, minimum 1) once per combat. Cost PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Battle Hardened

advance_feats.description:
You call the beasts of the undercity and wild edges to fight at your side.  
  
Effect: Summon 1d4 small animal allies (mutated rats, crows, fungal wolves, etc.)  
  
Each has 6 HP, 3 PS and MS, 1 Action  
  
On hit, they deal 1d4+1 and distract (-1 to target's next action)  
  
They last 6 rounds or until killed  
  
Cost: PP  
  
Type: Action
advance_feats.name: Beastborn Army

advance_feats.description: You’ve erased your origin completely. Corps can no longer auto-track or legally claim you. Once per session, you may spoof another Advent AI’s tag to mislead enemies. You gain advantage on rolls to infiltrate or sabotage corp AI systems. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Beyond the Corp Tag

advance_feats.description:
Cost: MP — Action  
You shift your body to become partially transparent and silent.  
Effect:  
  
Gain +2 to Stealth rolls for 5 minutes.  
  
Gain +1 to hit on first strike while veiled.  
  
Cameras and basic sensors ignore you
advance_feats.name: Bio-Phantom Veil

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP — Reaction  
Your instincts warp causality.  
  
When hit by an attack, instead of taking damage, you disappear, reappearing in another adjacent Zone and taking no damage.  
  
Additionally, that attacker rerolls their next two actions and takes the worse result.  
  
Visual effects include a collapsing singularity or flash of negated light.
advance_feats.name: Black Star Instinct

advance_feats.description:
You unleash a chaotic surge of glitching energy and psychic noise.  
  
Effect: Everyone in a large radius must roll Intellect vs your Charisma+3.  
  
On a failure:

Cybernetic targets are blinded and stunned for 1 turn.  
  
Organic targets take 1d6 psychic damage and are deafened for 2 turns.  
  
  
  
Action: Action  
  
Cost: MP
advance_feats.name: Black Static Storm

advance_feats.description:
Cost: MP & Health — Action  
You convert blood from corpses into writhing parasites or seed-pods.  
Effect:  
  
Spawn up to 3 Bloodlings (small, spider-like horrors) per corpse.  
  
Each Bloodling has 6 HP, 3 Physical, 2 Mental, 1 Action.  
  
On contact: 1d4+2 damage and latches on (target takes 1 damage/round).  
  
Bloodlings obey simple commands and last for 1 hour or until killed.
advance_feats.name: Blood Bloom Hive

advance_feats.description:
Cost: MP, Health — Action  
Your blood can hack machines.  
Effect:  
  
Touch a locked terminal, drone, or door—roll Intellect vs Difficulty.  
  
On success, you control it for 1d4 rounds (doors open, drones obey, systems unlock).  
  
On critical success, the control lasts for 1 hour.  
  
Machines touched now recognize you as "authorized" for 1 hour.
advance_feats.name: Bloodkey Interface

advance_feats.description:
*You know how to attach what was never yours.*

- **Effect:** As an **Action**, you may harvest a recently dead humanoid body part that includes a **bio-augment or mechanical augment**. You may stitch this part onto yourself over 1 minute.
- You gain **+1** to a relevant Physical Stat (determined by the GM) for the rest of the day.
- You cannot stitch more than **3 parts at a time** this way. Addi
advance_feats.name: Borrowed Fleshes

advance_feats.description: When you reduce a creature to 0 HP, you can immediately make a free attack against another enemy within melee range. Cost PP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Carnage Frenzy

advance_feats.description: You can spontaneously develop temporary adaptations (e.g., gills, claws, hardened skin) based on your environment. Each adaptation provides a +2 bonus to a relevant roll for 10 minutes. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Chimeric Evolution

advance_feats.description: You can cause a single target within your zone to skip their next turn. Roll Charisma vs the target's difficulty. On success, they lose one turn. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Chrono Displacement

advance_feats.description:
You slightly delay or extend your presence in someone's perception.

- Roll **Charisma vs Intuition**. On success, the target loses track of how long you've been talking and becomes easier to sway:
    
    
    - You gain **+2 to Persuasion** for 10 minutes.  
        **Cost:** MP. **Action.**
advance_feats.name: Chrono-Charm

advance_feats.description: You can become completely invisible in total darkness or low light for 1 minute. While invisible, your attacks gain +2 to hit, and you cannot be detected unless you attack or make noise. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Cloak of the Abyss

advance_feats.description:
You unlock hidden military protocols designed for mass combat.  
  
Effect: For 4 rounds:  
  
Gain +1 Action per turn  
  
All your movement actions cost Reaction  
  
Gain +1 damage on all attacks  
  
  
Action: Action  
  
Cost: PP
advance_feats.name: Combat Integration Mode

advance_feats.description: You can link up to 3 contracts simultaneously. Each contractor gains +1 to all rolls while abiding by the contract, and you can sense their location and emotional state within long range. Cost MP. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Contract Nexus

advance_feats.description: You create a copy of yourself; it has half of your Mental Stats (rounded down). It has one Action and one Reaction. It has all your feats and abilities. It is fully autonomous. If you are erased, then you play as the copy (using the copy's stats). If it is destroyed, you can create a new one while Resting by spending half of your Shock (rounded down). Action.
advance_feats.name: Copy of Self

advance_feats.description:
You execute a total system refresh in mid-battle.  
  
Effect: Remove all negative status effects and restore 1d8+3 Health and 1d4+3 Shock.  
  
For the next round, you take -1 to all rolls (reboot lag).  
  
  
Action: Free (usable once per rest)  
  
Cost: PP
advance_feats.name: Core Reboot Protocol

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP — Action  
You create a writhing organic tower that drains vitality.  
  
Appears in your Zone for 5 turns.  
  
All enemies in current and adjacent Zones lose 2 HP per round.  
  
You and your allies in range regain 1d4 HP per turn.  
  
The spire can be attacked (Health: 20, Armor: 2).
advance_feats.name: Corpus Siphon Spire

advance_feats.description:
Plants grow from your wounds, transforming pain into nature’s weapon.  
  
Passive Effect: When you're hit by a melee attack:  
  
Spawn a thorn bloom at attacker’s feet (deals 1d4 next time they move or act)  
  
You regain 1 HP once per round if in sunlight or greenery  
  
  
Active Effect (Reaction): You explode in a mass of vines, pushing all enemies in Close Range to Adjacent Zones (Strength
advance_feats.name: Creeping Bloom

advance_feats.description:
- Speak through every blood-bound simultaneously
- *Effect:* Your voice issues from all thralls in a district
- *Bonus:* Terrified witnesses take 1d6 Shock
    
    Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Crimson Chorus

advance_feats.description:
- You bend minds with sheer presence.
- **Effect:** Once per session, **declare a statement as absolute truth**. All who hear it must roll **Willpower vs 16** or believe it for **1 hour**.
advance_feats.name: Crown of the Dreaming King

advance_feats.description:
Cost: MP — Action  
You implant a metaphysical seed in a target’s soul.  
  
Roll Charisma vs Willpower+3.  
  
On failure, for 5 turns, each time they use an Action or Reaction, they take 1d6 internal damage.
advance_feats.name: Curse of the Root-Womb

advance_feats.description: You upload a malicious Daemon into an enemy system. Roll Intellect vs target’s difficulty. On success, choose one: Control target for 2 rounds. Disable all weapons or powers for 3 rounds. Corrupt Memory (confused, loses 1 action) for 4 rounds. Cost: MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Daemon Uplink

advance_feats.description:
Your name is whispered in fear or awe.

- Once per session, when you **introduce yourself or are recognized**, you may choose a **+2 to Intimidation** OR cause a target to hesitate, taking no action for 1 round.  
    **Passive.**
advance_feats.name: Dark Reputation

advance_feats.description: You are very versed in legal matters. Gain +1 to rolls for Legal Lore.
advance_feats.name: Devil advocate

advance_feats.description: You can propose a devilish deal to a target. Roll Intellect vs their Willpower; on success, they must agree to your terms. Breaking the deal deals 1d6+2 Shock damage to the breaker. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Devil's Bargain

advance_feats.description:
You briefly cloak an ally in your demonic aura. That ally **gains resistance to one damage type (takes half damage rounded down) chosen by you** and deals +2 damage for 2 rounds. They become terrifying to normal enemies (Intimidation advantage).  
**Action. Cost MP.**
advance_feats.name: Devil’s Mantle

advance_feats.description: You create a temporary backup of your consciousness in a secondary Husk. If you are destroyed or ejected, you automatically reappear in this Husk with full MP and 1 Shock. Clone lasts 10 minutes. Cost: MP and Shock. Setup: Action. Trigger: Passive. 1/Rest.
advance_feats.name: Digital Clone Body

advance_feats.description: Your name has spread through the digital underworld. You are a ghost, a legend, a warning. Gain +2 to all social rolls with hackers, rogue AIs, and anti-corp factions. You may automatically inspire fear or awe when you reveal your identity. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Digital Myth

advance_feats.description: You can teleport to any Zone within your line of sight. After teleporting, you gain +2 to Dodge rolls until the start of your next turn. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Dimensional Blink

advance_feats.description:
Your third eye pulses with a low whisper. One ally in short range gains **advantage on their next mental resistance roll** (Willpower or Intuition).  
**Cost MP. Reaction.**
advance_feats.name: Dissonant Whispers

advance_feats.description:
Req. Primal Hover

Action

Cost PP

You can hover as much as you like and also can ascend as high as you like.
advance_feats.name: Dragon Fly

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Action — combat AOE  
**Cost:** 3 PP  
**Range:** current Zone  
**Effect:** You unleash a shockwave of raw draconic energy.

All enemies in Immediate must roll:

- **Dexterity (12+)** or take 2d**8+3 damage** of your bloodline element and be pushed **to an adjacent Zone**
- On success: take **1d8+3 damage** and are not pushed
- 

**Uses:** once per encounter.
advance_feats.name: Dragon Pulse Nova

advance_feats.description:
- Your bloodline answers your call
- *Effect:* All blood-bound in the city receive one command (Willpower vs 15 resists)
- *Cost:* MP + Health
advance_feats.name: Dynastic Overlord

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP — Reaction  
You devour a future moment.  
  
When a target declares an action, you remove it from the timeline.  
  
That action never happens. They lose their turn.  
  
  
Costs 1 Reaction. You may only use this once per 2 turns.
advance_feats.name: Eater of Sequence

advance_feats.description:
**Type:** Reaction — mental safeguard  
**Cost:** 3 MP  
**Trigger:** You fail a roll involving Intuition, Insight, Investigation, or Willpower.  
**Effect:** You momentarily access a dragon’s near-eternal patience.

- **Reroll the check with advantage (roll 1d4 and add it to d10 roll).**
- If the new roll succeeds, regain **1 Shock**.

**Uses:** twice per Rest.
advance_feats.name: Echo of Infinite Patience

advance_feats.description: You can turn partially invisible for 1 minute, granting +2 to stealth and making you harder to hit (-1 penalty to enemy attack rolls). Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Eclipse Veil

advance_feats.description: You gain +2 to persuasion or diplomacy rolls, and once per session, you can force a reroll on an NPC's opposed roll.
advance_feats.name: Empathic Negotiator

advance_feats.description: Your Fire Breath ability now deals 2d6+1 H fire damage and applies Burn for 3 rounds. Additionally, you can use it twice per combat. Req. Fire Breath. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Eternal Flame

advance_feats.description: You can create an area of supernatural darkness in the current zone. Within this area, all enemies suffer -1 penalty on perception-based rolls, and you gain +1 to Stealth and attack rolls. Lasts 3 rounds. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Eternal Night

advance_feats.description: Enemies within your zone suffer a -1 penalty to attack rolls against you, as your presence seems otherworldly and distracting.
advance_feats.name: Ethereal Presence

advance_feats.description:
Cost: MP — Action  
You trigger a ripple through cause and effect.  
  
Choose one Action you or an ally took in the previous round. That Action repeats as if taken again.  
  
The target doesn’t spend PP, MP, or Actions — the world simply echoes the choice.  
  
You cannot repeat Actions that caused area destruction or time travel.  
  
May only be used once per 3 rounds.
advance_feats.name: Event Spiral

advance_feats.description: Your additional arms or legs now allow you to perform advanced combat maneuvers. You can attack twice in a single Action, or hold and fire two ranged weapons simultaneously without penalty.
advance_feats.name: Extra Limb Mastery

advance_feats.description: You gain the ability to temporarily merge with another willing creature, granting both of you +1 to all rolls and the ability to share sensory input. This lasts for 10 minutes. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Fae Symbiosis

advance_feats.description:
Cost: MP — Action  
You create a non-Euclidean angle between two Zones.  
  
For the next 3 rounds, you or anyone else can move from Zone A to Zone B using only 1 Action, ignoring intervening Zones.  
  
Anyone moving through this path must roll Body vs 8 or be stunned for 1 round due to spatial vertigo.  
  
You may collapse the fold at will as a Reaction.
advance_feats.name: False Geometry

advance_feats.description:
Your legend spreads faster than you do.

- You gain **+2 to all Intimidation and Reputation-based rolls** in any zone where your deeds are known.
- Once per session, an NPC may **refuse to act against you out of fear**, even if they outmatch you.  
    **Passive.**
advance_feats.name: Fear Incarnate

advance_feats.description: Allies within your zone gain +1 to their attack rolls and saving throws when they can see or hear you. Lasts until end of combat. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Fearless Leader

advance_feats.description:
- Imprint a last command in dying blood
- *Effect:* Slain enemies' final words serve your agenda
- *Duration:* Their corpse speaks for 1d4 days
advance_feats.name: Final Decree

advance_feats.description:
- Your last words curse a target forever.
- **Effect:** If your body is destroyed, **haunt one enemy’s devices** (persistent **-1 to rolls** until exorcised).
advance_feats.name: Final Transmission

advance_feats.description:
**Cost:** PP  
**Effect:** You can temporarily attach **two body parts** from a corpse to yourself. Action.

- Choose effects: new arms grant dual wielding, legs increase movement, or sensory organ gives special perception (thermal, sonar, etc.)
- Lasts for **60 minutes** or until severed.
- Side effect: You take **2 Shock** damage from disturbing feedback.
advance_feats.name: Flesh Architect

advance_feats.description:
Cost: MP — Action  
By tasting blood or touching recently-dead tissue, you extract useful data.  
Effect:  
  
Learn one of the following:  
  
Last memory before death (vague image/sensation)  
  
Name, role, or allegiance of victim  
  
Passwords, codes, or habits  
  
  
You may store up to 3 “echoes” in your body, accessible at will.
advance_feats.name: Flesh Echo Memory

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP, Health — Action  
You graft a living part of a creature onto another.  
Effect:  
  
Choose two adjacent creatures (one may be you). One part of the donor (limb, eye, organ) is merged into the host.  
  
For the next hour, the host gains a random ability from the donor: +1 Stat, Darkvision, additional limb attack (1d6), or one of its passive traits (GM's discretion).  
  
After 1 hour, b
advance_feats.name: Flesh Fusion Ritual

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP — Passive Activation  
Your body constantly absorbs ambient bio-energy and reshapes to resist trauma.  
Effect:  
  
Once per turn, reduce incoming physical damage by 4.  
  
If an attack would kill you, you instead auto-trigger a mutation burst:  
  
Heal 2d6 HP  
  
Gain +2 Body until end of combat  
  
Grow a temporary limb that can attack (1d8+4 damage) for 3 rounds.
advance_feats.name: Flesh Shift Reactor

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP, Health — Action  
You temporarily stitch together wounded creatures.  
Effect:  
  
Touch a target (can't be self). They regain 1d6+2 HP and gain +1 to physical saves for 1 minute.  
  
If target has missing limb or damage to organs, it is functionally patched together for 10 minutes (no penalties, but visibly grotesque).  
  
Cannot be used on constructs or machines.
advance_feats.name: Flesh Stitcher

advance_feats.description: You can split your form momentarily, allowing you to make an attack from two different angles at once. This grants you two attacks against a single target within range. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Flickering Shadows

advance_feats.description:
You blossom with radiant and terrifying beauty, becoming a conduit of nature's wrath.  
  
Effect (3 rounds):  
  
Enemies within Short Range take 1d4 Shock at start of their turn  
  
Allies heal 1 Health per turn  
  
You can stretch vines to an Adjacent Zone once per turn to Pull a target (Dexterity vs Strength) as Reaction.  
  
Bonus: You are immune to Blind.  
  
Cost: MP  
  
Type: Action
advance_feats.name: Floral Avatar

advance_feats.description:
You inject a neural enhancer that sharpens the world.  
  
Effect: You gain +3 to all ranged attacks and perception-based tasks for 3 turns.  
  
Side Effect: You cannot benefit from cover or invisibility during this effect.  
  
Cost: PP  
  
Type: Action.
advance_feats.name: Focus Spike

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP — Action  
You exist in two overlapping positions at once.  
  
For the next 3 rounds, you occupy two Zones at the same time.  
  
You can interact, attack, and defend in both Zones simultaneously, choosing the better roll between both positions for dodging.  
  
Melee attackers have disadvantage (roll twice, take worse) to hit you.  
  
When effect ends, choose which zone you fully retur
advance_feats.name: Folded Self

advance_feats.description: When you succeed on a dodge roll, you can take an immediate movement action. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
advance_feats.name: Foresight Reflexes

advance_feats.description:
**Cost:** MP  
**Effect:** You predict an enemy’s movement before it happens.

- **Interrupt** any action targeting you or an ally.
- You may either:
    
    
    - Force the attacker to reroll, or
    - Move you or an ally to an adjacent Zone out of harm’s way.
- Usable once per Round.
advance_feats.name: Ghost Reflex

advance_feats.description: Once per session, you can ask the GM a yes/no question about a possible future event. If the answer is unclear, you gain +2 to a related roll instead. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Glimpse Beyond

advance_feats.description: When controlling a Husk, you may override its limitations, gaining temporary perfection. For 6 rounds, the Husk gains: +3 to all Physical Stats 10 Temporary Health +2 to all damage rolls At the end, the Husk is disabled (can be fixed during Rest) and ejects you. Cost: MP and Shock. Action. 1/Rest.
advance_feats.name: Godshell Override

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP , Health — while Resting  
You permanently create a horrific assistant using parts from multiple creatures.  
Effect:  
  
Build a minion with 10 HP and three traits from other creatures (e.g., wings, sonar sense, poison spit, extra arms).  
  
It follows simple commands and may sacrifice itself to take an attack in your place once per day.  
  
You can only have one grafted minion at a t
advance_feats.name: Grafted Minion

advance_feats.description:
Requires Familiar feat.  
  
Your Familiar now has these Stats: 20 HP, 10 Shock, 5 PS, 6 MS, 2 Actions, 2 Reactions.

It can now make a melee attack dealing 1d4+2 damage using Dexterity.

If you have the Cast Through Familiar feat, then your familiar can now cast all of your Psy Powers on its own; it has 12 MP and 12 PP for this.
advance_feats.name: Greater Familiar

advance_feats.description: Your devilish hair can now extend up to 10 meters and manipulate objects with finesse. It can grapple enemies, deal 1d6 H damage per round, or wield light weapons. Req. Devilish Hair.
advance_feats.name: Hair of the Abyss

advance_feats.description:
You infect a local network with your ghost-code.  
  
Effect: For the next hour:  
  
Cameras, turrets, alarms, or comms in the local area (up to 3 systems) are under your subtle control  
  
You may disable them or reroute information once per turn  
  
  
Action: Action  
  
Cost: MP
advance_feats.name: Haunt the System

advance_feats.description:
Cost: MP — Action  
You pulse a psychic blood signal that targets biological hearts.  
Effect:  
  
All enemies in Zone roll Willpower vs your Body+4 or take 2d8 damage and lose their next Reaction.  
  
If at least one fails, you regain 1d8 HP.
advance_feats.name: Heart Leech Pulse

advance_feats.description: When reduced to 0 Health, you can remain conscious for 1 additional round and perform actions. Cost MP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Heart of Stone

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP, Health — Action  
You convert your own heart’s blood into burning plasma.  
Effect:  
  
Launch a heart-burst bolt in straight line through Zones. It has very long range.  
  
Targets in path take 2d10+2 Energy damage, bypassing 3 Armor.  
  
Any target killed by this attack explodes in gore, causing 1d6 splash damage in its Zone.
advance_feats.name: Heartforge Cannon

advance_feats.description: Req. Devilish Tail. Your tail now deals 2d10+2 damage and ignores 2 points of armor. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Hell Tail

advance_feats.description: You emit an aura of hellfire for 3 rounds, dealing 1d6+2 H fire damage to all enemies in immediate range at the start of their turn. Allies within the aura gain +1 to attack rolls. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Hellfire Aura

advance_feats.description: You summon a wave of hellfire, targeting up to 3 enemies within medium range. Roll Intellect vs each target's difficulty; on success, deal 1d8+2 H fire damage that ignores armor. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Hellfire Barrage

advance_feats.description: You gain complete immunity to fire damage and resistance to cold damage, taking only half damage from it.
advance_feats.name: Hellish Resistance

advance_feats.description:
- You judge disputes with infernal fairness.
- **Effect:** When mediating, **both parties must abide by your ruling** or suffer **1d8 Shock damage per violation**.
advance_feats.name: Hell’s Arbitration

advance_feats.description:
Cost: MP — Passive, lasts until deactivated  
You leave behind drops of your blood as sensors.  
Effect:  
  
You can see and hear through any blood spot.  
  
Max 3 blood nodes at once.  
  
You may teleport sight instantly between them as a free action.  
  
If a node is stepped on or destroyed, you are alerted mentally.
advance_feats.name: Hemovision Network

advance_feats.description: Req. Road to Perfection feat. When your Shock drops to 0 or below, now you can delay start of your mental breakdown for 1 minute. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Highway to Perfection

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP — Action  
Your body erupts with dozens of floating, blinking eyes.  
  
You gain 360° vision, cannot be flanked or surprised, and all Perception-related rolls gain +3 bonus.  
  
For 3 turns, you may perform a Free Action each turn to make a Gaze Attack:  
  
Choose a target: Willpower vs your Intelligence+5.  
  
On failure, they become Blinded, Panicked, or Frightened (choose one).
advance_feats.name: Hive of Eyes

advance_feats.description: Create a perfect illusion of yourself in another location within your line of sight. This illusion can interact with the environment, deceive enemies, and draw attention, but it cannot deal damage. It lasts for 1 minute. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Illusory Doppelganger

advance_feats.description: Your wings grow stronger, allowing you to fly indefinitely. You gain +1 to all Dexterity-based rolls while flying. Additionally, once per session, you can perform a high-speed dive attack, dealing 2d6 H damage to a target in short range. Req. Awaken Wings. Cost PP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Infernal Ascension

advance_feats.description: You exude an irresistible aura of power and charm. Gain +2 to rolls for deception, intimidation, or persuasion for 10 minutes. Additionally, enemies within your immediate vicinity must roll Willpower vs your Intellect or suffer -1 to attack rolls. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Infernal Glamour

advance_feats.description: When you deal fire damage, you regain 1 PP or 1 MP (your choice) per attack. This effect can trigger up to 3 times per combat. Passive.
advance_feats.name: Infernal Rejuvenation

advance_feats.description: You may split your consciousness into a swarm of 3 drones or devices within the same Zone. You may act with all three in one round, but only one may perform an action. You can shift your focus between them as a Free Action. Cost: MP. Duration: 5 minutes or until all are destroyed.
advance_feats.name: Inhabit Swarm

advance_feats.description:
Cost: MP — Action  
You reverse the entropy of a single Zone for a moment.  
  
Choose one of the following effects:  
  
Restore a destroyed object to its prior state (last 10 minutes only)  
  
Heal a downed character by 2d6 HP  
  
Undo one failed roll made in the previous round (make it again)  
  
  
Using this feat causes a 1d6 Shock backlash to you from paradox stress.
advance_feats.name: Inverse Cascade

advance_feats.description:
**Cost:** PP  
**Effect:** You reduce incoming damage by half rounded down for the next 3 turns.
advance_feats.name: Ironbound

advance_feats.description:
You embed a ghost-mark in your target’s hardware or aura, counting down to doom.  
  
Effect: Target must roll Body vs your Intellect+2.  
  
On a failure, in 3 rounds they take 2d6+2 unavoidable damage as their system collapses.  
  
If they die from this, their body becomes a haunted drone for 1 round.  
  
  
Action: Action  
  
Cost: MP
advance_feats.name: Kill-Switch Soul

advance_feats.description: When you are reduced to 0 HP, you can make one final attack before falling unconscious. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Last Stand

advance_feats.description:
- Your name alone opens doors.
- **Effect:** **Auto-succeed** on a Social roll when invoking your rep.
- **Bonus:** Once per session, **summon backup** (gang, corp sec, or mercs) based on your influence.
advance_feats.name: Legendary Reputation

advance_feats.description: Your body grows a flexible organic armor that grants +2 to Armor and reflects 1d6 damage back to attackers when struck in melee. Lasts for 10 minutes. Cost MP. Action.
advance_feats.name: Living Armor

advance_feats.description:
Cost: PP — Action  
You fuse a corpse into a mobile throne of bone and flesh.  
Effect:  
  
Grants +2 to all Leadership or Domination rolls.  
  
While seated, you gain +2 Armor and immune to being shoved/prone.  
  
Once per combat, it can shield you, absorbing 2d8 damage.
advance_feats.name: Living Throne

advance_feats.description: Your natural weapons (claws, teeth) now deal 2d6+1 H damage. Additionally, they ignore 2 points of armor. Req. Razor-sharp Teeth/Claws.
advance_feats.name: Living Weapon

advance_feats.description: Once per combat, you can negate the effects of a debuff or mind-altering ability targeting you or an ally within your zone. Cost MP. Reaction.- Timeless Beauty: You appear so captivating that enemies are hesitant to attack you directly. Once per combat, force an enemy to reroll a successful attack against you. Cost MP. Reaction.
advance_feats.name: Luminous Will

advance_feats.description: When gambling, you can reroll once per session and gain an additional +4 to the roll. Req. Lucky.
advance_feats.name: Master Gambler
