**Active (1 MP)**: Shift appearance (face, voice, scent) for 10 minutes. Gain +2 to disguise or infiltration rolls. Fool basic ID scans. Cannot mimic specific people without knowing them well.

---
catalog_feats.name: Flesh ID Mask

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 1  
**Penalty**: -1 to social rolls (your breathing is gross and audible)  
**Passive**: You can smell extremely faint traces of blood or injury. Gain +2 to track wounded creatures.  
**Active**: Sniff the air intensely. Learn whether a nearby target (long range) is injured, infected, or hiding blood-based conditions. **Cost: 1 MP**

---
catalog_feats.name: Gory Nostril Pods

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 1  
**Penalty**: You are more vulnerable to internal damage (+1 from internal-targeting attacks)  
**Passive**: You have a hidden organic compartment inside your torso, usable for smuggling  
**Active (1 PP)**: Regurgitate or eject a stored item (hand-sized or smaller) instantly, even when restrained or searched.

---
catalog_feats.name: Hollow Gut Pocket

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 2  
**Penalty**: You take an additional 1d4 damage from ICE  
**Passive**: You can plug into tech through finger-tendrils, bypassing basic access  
**Active (1 MP)**: Connect to any device with exposed ports. Attempt an Intellect or Willpower roll vs difficulty to extract, modify, or erase data.

---
catalog_feats.name: Nerve-Thread Interface

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 1  
**Penalty**: -1 to Charisma against beings who detect your null aura  
**Passive**: You emit a grounding field that disrupts low-level psychic interference  
**Active (1 MP)**: Cancel the effects of a minor ongoing Psionic effect (Rank 1 or lower), or give +2 bonus to yourself or an ally’s next Willpower defense against a next psychic attack.

---
catalog_feats.name: Psi-Anchor Node

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 1  
**Penalty**: Your skin occasionally flickers with psychic static  
**Passive**: You feel “ripples” in psychic activity—gain +2 to detect nearby Psy users  
**Active (1 MP)**: As an Action, scan your Zone for psyonic activity. You learn how many active minds are present and whether any powers are in use.

---
catalog_feats.name: Pulse Receptor Filament

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 2  
**Penalty**: You take +1 Shock damage  
**Passive**: Your skin trembles at the presence of nearby lifeforms. You gain +2 to detect hidden creatures in close range.  
**Active**: Vibrate violently for 10 seconds—shaking off minor tracking tags or insects. Also makes you impossible to grab until your next turn. **Cost: 1 PP**

---
catalog_feats.name: Quivering Skin Membrane

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 1  
**Penalty**: You suffer -1 to resist grapples  
**Passive**: You can anchor yourself to pipes, cables, or walls via nerve-spikes  
**Active (1 PP)**: Stick to a surface and stay hidden or secure—even upside down or mid-vehicle crash. Gain +2 to checks to resist knockback or fall effects.

---
catalog_feats.name: Spinal Grip Node

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 1  
**Penalty**: Your third eye is visible when using any psyonic power  
**Passive**: You have a minor latent "third eye" under your skin—gain +1 to Perception checks against invisible or hidden enemies  
**Active (1 MP)**: For 1 round, gain limited true sight—see through illusions, holograms in your Zone. Doesn’t detect everything perfectly.

---
catalog_feats.name: Third-Eye Sheath

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 1  
**Penalty**: -1 to resist mind-altering effects  
**Passive**: Your tongue has evolved for layered speech. You can speak two languages at once or include coded signals.  
**Active**: You can emit subsonic tones that communicate with blood-altered creatures (like other Crimson Elves) without others noticing. **Cost: 1 MP**

---
catalog_feats.name: Tongue Lattice

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 1  
**Penalty**: -1 to resist social effects  
**Passive**: Your blood subtly vibrates with sound. You can communicate silently with others by syncing heartbeats, long range.  
**Active**: Pulse your blood to emit a low-frequency sound that confuses small surveillance devices or bugs. Temporarily disables eavesdropping in your Zone for 1 minute. **Cost: 1 MP**

---
catalog_feats.name: Whispering Veins

catalog_feats.description:
Points: 3  
Action Cost: 1  
  
Passive: You can “feed” off the pain of others. Whenever a creature within short range takes Shock or Health damage, heal 1 Shock (once per creature per round).  
  
Active: Target an enemy within short range. Roll Willpower vs Body. On success, target loses 1d6 Health and you regain that amount in Health or Shock. Cost 1 MP and 1 PP.

---
catalog_feats.name: Abyssal Hunger

catalog_feats.description:
Points: 3  
  
Action Cost: 3  
  
Passive: Everyone in the current Zone becomes immobilized  
  
Active: Choose a target affected by the passive effect. Black tentacles start to attack this target. Roll 1d4+1; the result is the number of tentacles spawned. Those tentacles attack at the end of your turn. They have the following Stats: 6 HP, 3 PS, and deal 1d6+1 damage. Cost 1 PP.

---
catalog_feats.name: Black Tentacles

catalog_feats.description:
Points: 6  
Action Cost: 2  
  
Passive: Any creature that sees your aura (via magic or otherwise) must roll Willpower vs 14 or gain the Frightened condition. This is always active.  
  
Active: Emit a burst of impossible color. Every living target in current Zone must roll Body vs your Intellect+5. On a failure, take 1d10+2 damage and lose next Reaction. Those with cybernetics roll twice and take lower result. Cost 2 MP.

---
catalog_feats.name: Color that Should Not Be

catalog_feats.description:
Points: 6  
  
Action Cost: 3  
  
Passive: In long range gravity is cancelled. Everyone except you has a -3 penalty to actions related to movement. Moving to an adjacent Zone costs 2 Actions. You also gain +1 bonus to hit and dodge.  
  
Active: You drastically change gravity for a chosen target; the target must roll Dexterity vs 15 or receive 2d12+3 damage. The target also becomes immobilized. Cost 2 MP.

---
catalog_feats.name: Defile Gravity

catalog_feats.description:
Points: 4  
Action Cost: 1  
  
Passive: When someone falls asleep within medium range, you can implant a fragment of your mind. They suffer -2 to resist you for 1 hour after waking. Can be activated outside of combat.  
  
Active: Target a sleeping or unconscious creature. On success, implant a Parasite that lets you see through their eyes and speak through their mouth. Lasts 1 hour. Cost 2 MP. Can be activated outside of combat.

---
catalog_feats.name: Dream Parasite

catalog_feats.description:
Points: 10  
Action Cost: 4

  
Passive Effect:  
  
Your presence causes hallucinations. Enemies suffer -1 to Mental Stats in your Zone  
Active Effect:  
  
You terraform your current Zone into a twisted reflection of your mind — “The Cathedral”  
  
Lasts 5 rounds  
  
Enemies must roll Willpower vs your highest Mental Stat at start of each turn or lose 1 Action  
  
You gain 1 extra Action per turn while inside  
  
Anyone who dies here becomes a screaming echo in your mind — you can ask them 1 question per day  
Cost: 3 MP

---
catalog_feats.name: Eldritch Cathedral

catalog_feats.description:
Points: 3  
Action Cost: 2  
Passive:  
  
Gain a spectral third arm (invisible unless active). Allows you to interact with or hold one extra item  
Active:  
  
You may target someone within medium range. Roll Dexterity vs Dexterity.  
  
On success: target is Slowed (-1 Action) for 2 rounds and takes 2d4 damage  
  
On critical: target is also disarmed or pulled 1 Zone closer  
Cost: 1 PP

---
catalog_feats.name: Eldritch Grasp

catalog_feats.description:
Points: 7  
  
Action Cost: 5  
  
Passive: Everyone in very long range becomes Doomed - every time you deal damage to anyone with Doomed condition, you gain 1 point of Doom.  
  
Active: You spend Doom points, choose a target with the Doomed condition. Cost 2 MP.  
  
Doom Points: 3 - deal 15 damage that ignores armor  
  
6 - target starts attacking a target of your choice for the next 4 rounds  
  
9 - target's Physical Stats = 1 for 4 rounds  
  
12 - if target's Body is less than or equal to 5, this target dies immediately; otherwise it takes 40 damage  
  
15 - target falls in love with you  
  
18 - the target's head blows up and from it comes a black tentacle that attacks at the end of your turn, with the following Stats: 16 HP, 6 PS, deals 1d10+3 damage  
  
21 - Eye is fully formed; everyone with the Doomed condition becomes paralyzed for the next 6 rounds.

---
catalog_feats.name: Eye of Azathoth

catalog_feats.description:
Points: 4  
Action Cost: 2  
  
Passive: You leave behind false echoes of your presence. Enemies have -1 to hit you in Zones you’ve recently been in (lasts 2 rounds).  
  
Active: You and one willing ally instantly swap positions anywhere within long range. Enemies in either your original or new Zone must roll Willpower vs 14 or suffer Disorientation (-2 to rolls for 1 round). Cost 2 MP.

---
catalog_feats.name: Lurker’s Invitation

catalog_feats.description:
Points: 2  
  
Action Cost: 2  
  
Passive: Everyone in the current Zone has a -2 penalty to resist mental effects  
  
Active: Everyone in the current Zone must roll Willpower vs your Willpower+5. On a failure, you choose a mental effect (PTSD, Mania, Paranoia, etc.). This effect lasts for 3 rounds. Cost 1 MP.

---
catalog_feats.name: Mass Madness

catalog_feats.description:
Points: 3  
Action Cost: 2  
Passive:  
  
Once per Rest, you can bite with a hidden mouth anywhere on your body for 2d6+1 damage  
Active:  
  
You expose a patch of whispering mouths.  
  
All enemies in short range must roll Willpower vs 14, on a failure, they can't speak for the next 10 minutes.  
  
Those who fail critically also become Paralyzed for 1 round  
Cost: 1 PP

---
catalog_feats.name: Mouths in the Skin

catalog_feats.description:
Points: 3  
  
Action Cost: 2  
  
Passive: You take only half damage but also deal half damage (rounded down). You take full Psy Power damage.  
  
Active: You become completely incorporeal and can move through solid objects as if they were nothing. In this form you are unable to deal damage or interact with objects; you can only be damaged by Psy Powers.

---
catalog_feats.name: Out of Phase

catalog_feats.description:
Points: 6  
Action Cost: 3  
Passive:  
  
You bleed black pollen-like mist when injured. Anyone who hits you in melee must roll Fortitude vs 13 or take -1 to all rolls until end of their next turn  
Active:  
  
You bloom with nightmare spores  
  
Everyone in adjacent Zones must roll Fortitude vs 15  
  
On a failure: Become Blinded and take 2d6 damage that ignores armor  
  
For the next 2 rounds, vision is distorted (-2 to ranged attacks, -1 Perception)  
Cost: 2 MP

---
catalog_feats.name: Pale Bloom

catalog_feats.description:
Points: 7  
Action Cost: 3  
  
Passive: You exist slightly out of phase. The first time you would take damage each combat, reduce it to 0. This passive activates automatically at the start of combat.  
  
Active: Shed your physical form like dead skin. For 2 rounds you become intangible and immune to physical damage, but can’t deal any either. Enemies who start their turn near your shed form must roll Willpower vs 16 or become Paralyzed for 1 round. Cost 3 MP.

---
catalog_feats.name: Reality Molt

catalog_feats.description:
Points: 8  
Action Cost: 4  
  
Passive: You unname yourself from consensus reality. You can't be located by scrying, recognition software, or name-based rituals. Can be used outside of combat.  
  
Active: You speak the true name of a target—then erase it. Roll Willpower vs target’s Intuition. On a failure, the target forgets who they are: they can’t use abilities, target specific allies, or act with intent. Cost 2 MP and 1 PP.

---
catalog_feats.name: Shatter Name

catalog_feats.description:
Points: 8  
  
Action Cost: 4  
  
Passive: Everyone in current Zone moves into immediate range. You make attacks of opportunity against everyone moved this way, those attacks don't cost Reaction.  
  
Active: Everyone in immediate range of you must roll Strength vs 15, on a failure, they are sucked into the singularity, which deals 1d10+3 damage that ignores 4 armor every round. At the start of their turn they can try a Strength roll again. Cost 3 MP.

---
catalog_feats.name: Singularity

catalog_feats.description:
Points: 5  
Action Cost: 3  
  
Passive: Your skin is covered in ever-shifting, whispering eyes. Gain +2 to Perception, and once per round you can make a free Insight check.  
  
Active: You force a target to make eye contact with your impossible gaze. Roll Perception vs target’s Willpower. On a failure, they are Blinded for 2 rounds and suffer 1d8 Psychic damage. Cost 2 MP.

---
catalog_feats.name: Skin of Eyes

catalog_feats.description:
Points: 10  
Action Cost: 2  
  
Passive Effect:  
  
You grow a sentient crown of tentacles — you can make 1 free melee tentacle attack per round (1d8+2, uses Dexterity or Strength)  
  
Gain +1 to all rolls when fighting 3+ enemies  
Active Effect:  
  
Tentacle crown erupts, attacking up to 5 targets in Zone  
  
Roll Willpower vs target's difficulty for each  
  
On hit: deal 2d10+3 damage and Grapple  
  
Grappled targets take 1d6 damage at the end of each of their turns and can't move  
  
  
You gain +2 to all Mental Stats during this effect (lasts 3 rounds)  
Cost: 3 PP

---
catalog_feats.name: Tentacle Crown Ascendant

catalog_feats.description:
Points: 5  
  
Action Cost: 4  
  
Passive: Everyone in current Zone must roll Willpower vs your Body+7, on a failure, targets have a -2 penalty to all rolls for 2 rounds; on a critical failure, they must run away for the next 2 rounds.  
  
Active: You gain +2 bonus to Body and Strength. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4 damage that ignores armor. You can make a multi-attack with your tentacles; this attack costs a Reaction. Choose up to 3 targets in short range, roll Dexterity vs target's difficulty; on success, targets become Poisoned: choose one of the Toxins (except the Yellow), then roll 1d4 — this roll will decide which Toxin the target receives. Cost 2 PP.

---
catalog_feats.name: Terrifying Form

catalog_feats.description:
Points: 5  
Action Cost: 2  
  
Passive: You can store thoughts outside of time. Gain +2 to resist mental effects. Once per rest, ignore an effect that would cause Confusion, Domination, or Fear.  
  
Active: Rewind your perception. You may reroll any failed roll from your previous turn. You must use the second result. Cost 2 MP.

---
catalog_feats.name: Tesseract Mind

catalog_feats.description:
Points: 4  
Action Cost: 1  
Passive:  
  
You can hear the emotional "flavor" of surface thoughts from anyone within short range  
Active:  
  
Choose a target. Roll Willpower vs Willpower.  
  
On success: you gain insight into one of the following (your choice):  
  
What they fear most  
  
A memory they’re trying to hide  
  
The truth about something they just said  
  
  
In combat: target becomes Shaken (-1 to next 3 rolls)  
Cost: 2 MP

---
catalog_feats.name: Thought Bleed

catalog_feats.description:
Points: 10  
  
Action Cost: 2  
  
Passive: You gain +1 to your Stats while in alter ego form and +2 while you are in true form. You also gain an extra Action. This passive works even outside of combat. You don't need to activate the power for this passive to work.  
  
Active: Everyone who can see you becomes fascinated with you. In combat it gives you a lower chance of being targeted. Out of combat it makes people treat you like some kind of celebrity.

---
catalog_feats.name: Truest Form

catalog_feats.description:
Points: 2  
Action Cost: 1  
Passive:  
  
You always know when someone lies to you, but not what the lie is specifically about  
  
Gain +1 to Insight and Intimidation-related rolls, can be used outside of combat.  
Active:  
  
Choose a target in speaking range. Roll Willpower vs their Willpower.  
  
On success: implant a disturbing whisper — the target takes -1 to all rolls for 2 rounds and becomes Distracted (can’t use Reactions)  
Cost: 1 MP

---
catalog_feats.name: Waking Whispers

catalog_feats.description:
Points: 5  
Action Cost: 3  
Passive:  
  
You radiate unnatural stillness; enemies take a -1 penalty to being intimidated within short range  
Active:  
  
You freeze and release psychic energy  
  
All enemies in current Zone must roll Willpower vs your Willpower+3  
  
On a failure: They become Terrified (run away for 1 round) and take 2d6 psychic damage  
  
On a critical failure: They scream uncontrollably, losing 1 Action on their next turn  
Cost: 2 MP

---
catalog_feats.name: Weeping Idol

catalog_feats.description:
If your Willpower is less than 10, you take 1 Shock damage at the end of your turn while Transcendence abilities are activated. You also spend 1 MP at the end of your turn. Passive abilities don't spend MP or Shock.

When you activate Transcendence ability you gain passive effect, activating active effect is Free Action.

Ignore cost of PP,MP, Health, Shock. I will fix it later.

---
catalog_feats.name: Major Abilities

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 2  
**Action Cost**: 1

- **Passive**: When someone tries to intimidate, threaten, or interrogate you, they gain a creeping sense of unease. +1 to Social Resistance.
- **Active**: Smirk at a target within sight. If they fail Willpower vs your Charisma+3, they suffer -2 to next Social roll and can’t willingly speak your name aloud for 1 hour. **Cost**: 1 MP

---
catalog_feats.name: Blood-Slick Smile

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 1  
**Action Cost**: 1

- **Passive**: Your footsteps leave behind faint, glowing motes that fade after a few seconds.
- **Active**: Mark a Zone with stardust. The next ally to pass through it gains +1 to a roll of their choice. Once used, the mark vanishes. **Cost**: 1 MP

---
catalog_feats.name: Cosmic Dust Trail

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 2  
**Action Cost**: 2

- **Passive**: Mirrors and screens show you slightly out of sync—delayed, twitching, or replaced with an alternate self. Gain +1 to Intimidation rolls when interacting through tech or reflective surfaces.
- **Active**: Project a reflection of yourself into a nearby screen, glass, or mirror. You can observe and speak through it for 3 rounds. Good for misdirection, spying, or psychological warfare. **Cost**: 1 MP

---
catalog_feats.name: Crawling Reflection

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 1  
**Action Cost**: 1

- **Passive**: Your voice drags like stretched time. Listeners sometimes hear you speak before your lips move.
- **Active**: Force a target to experience a brief lag in time perception. They act last next round, regardless of Speed. Willpower vs your Intellect+4 negates. **Cost**: 1 MP

---
catalog_feats.name: Echo of Event Horizon

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 1  
**Action Cost**: 1

- **Passive**: You’ve memorized a word not meant to exist. Uttering it warps sound around you.
- **Active**: Whisper the word into someone’s ear (short range). If they fail Willpower vs your Intellect+3, they are silenced for 1 round. Their voice cracks and breaks when they try to speak. **Cost**: 1 MP

---
catalog_feats.name: Forbidden Word

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 1  
**Action Cost**: 1

- **Passive**: You perceive flickers of the unseen. You can see invisible or phased entities as vague distortions.
- **Active**: Ask one narrative question about the immediate area or a nearby person—GM must give a cryptic or symbolic truth. Can be used to uncover hidden motives, threats, or strange truths. **Cost**: 1 MP

---
catalog_feats.name: Glimpse the Veil

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 2  
**Action Cost**: 1

- **Passive**: You speak in reversed, palindromic, or fragmented syntax. Machines and software have -1 to interpret your voice.
- **Active**: Speak directly to a machine in your broken language. You can issue one command to malfunction, glitch, or delay a response. Simple systems obey automatically; complex must roll Intellect vs 10. **Cost**: 1 MP

---
catalog_feats.name: Guttertongue

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 2  
**Action Cost**: 2

- **Passive**: You leave behind impressions—your face, your words—that people remember wrong. Gain +1 to Deception or Misdirection.
- **Active**: Implant a minor hallucination in one target. They see something off—a shadow where there is none, an eye watching them. Roll Willpower vs your Intellect+4. **Cost**: 1 MP

---
catalog_feats.name: Hallucination Seed

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 2  
**Action Cost**: 2

- **Passive**: You sometimes laugh uncontrollably when nervous, infecting others with discomfort. Enemies who fail Intuition vs 12 take –1 to their next mental roll.
- **Active**: Burst into shrieking laughter. Everyone in immediate range must roll Willpower vs your Charisma+4 or be Distracted (-1 to hit rolls) for 1 round. On a critical failure, they lose their next Action. **Cost**: 1 MP

---
catalog_feats.name: Laughter That Binds

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 1  
**Action Cost**: 1

- **Passive**: When someone near you speaks about a traumatic event, you gain fragments of their memory. You instinctively know one hidden truth about them.
- **Active**: Touch a target or something they recently touched. See a brief, symbolic vision of an important moment in their past. Useful for investigation or interrogation. **Cost**: 1 MP

---
catalog_feats.name: Leech Memory

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 2  
**Action Cost**: 1

- **Passive**: Your skin is covered in faint, twitching glyphs visible only under certain lighting. +1 bonus when interacting with cults or forbidden tech.
- **Active**: Expose a section of your body covered in living script. One intelligent creature in short range must roll Willpower vs your Intellect+4 or become Obsessed or Disturbed (GM choice) for 1d4 rounds. **Cost**: 1 MP

---
catalog_feats.name: Skin Scripture

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 2  
**Action Cost**: 1

- **Passive**: You never sleep and cannot be fatigued by sleep deprivation. You can always tell if someone near you is dreaming.
- **Active**: Gaze into the eyes of a sleeping person (or their image) to view a fragment of their dream or fear. Useful for finding hidden motives or weaknesses. **Cost**: 1 MP

---
catalog_feats.name: Sleepless Moon-Eyes

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 1  
**Action Cost**: 1

- **Passive**: Your pupils seem to reflect constellations that no longer exist. +1 to spot the supernatural or hidden.
- **Active**: Lock eyes with a target. They must roll Intuition vs 13 or hallucinate the cold of deep space for 1 round, suffering -2 to Awareness checks. **Cost**: 1 MP

---
catalog_feats.name: Star-Eaten Eyes

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 2  
**Action Cost**: 2

- **Passive**: You are attuned to celestial alignments. You always know when something dangerous is approaching.
- **Active**: Declare the “Black Moon Rises.” For the next 3 rounds, all light sources in your Zone flicker or dim, and you gain +1 to Stealth and +1 to resist Psy Powers. **Cost**: 2 MP

---
catalog_feats.name: Tide of the Black Moon

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 1  
**Action Cost**: 1

- **Passive**: Your joints bend in impossible ways. You ignore normal restrictions on tight spaces and gain +1 to Escape or Squeeze checks.
- **Active**: Rearrange your bones with a sickening crunch. For the next round, you cannot be grappled or pinned. **Cost**: 1 PP

---
catalog_feats.name: Unnatural Flexion

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 1  
**Action Cost**: 1

- **Passive**: No one ever remembers your name unless you allow it. Names vanish from documents, tags, and speech.
- **Active**: Prevent someone from saying your name aloud for the next hour. Anyone attempting to say it stutters or forgets. This includes smart systems. **Cost**: 1 MP

---
catalog_feats.name: Unspoken Name

catalog_feats.description:
**Points**: 1  
**Action Cost**: 1

- **Passive**: People sometimes hear your voice even when you’re silent. You gain +1 to social rolls when trying to gaslight or confuse.
- **Active**: Whisper nonsense at a target. They must roll Willpower vs your Intellect+4, on a failure, they think they had a meaningful conversation with you. **Cost**: 1 MP

---
catalog_feats.name: Unstable Echo

catalog_feats.description:
Preparation: 12 hours  
Ingredients: Heart of a dying city, blood of a chosen child, roots soaked in sorrow  
Cost: 7 MP  
Effect: You plant a Womb of the All-Mother beneath an urban zone (up to 1 km). Over the next 24 hours, buildings twist into organic shapes, machines rot, and vines infest tech systems. Inhabitants suffer hallucinations and emotional collapse. This area becomes a sacred warzone. The Womb can be destroyed, but it resists all attempts (Armor 6, 50 HP).

---
catalog_feats.name: Cradle of the World-Wound

catalog_feats.description:
Preparation: 1 hour  
Ingredients: Burned remains of building or battlefield, blood of kin  
Cost: 2 MP  
Effect: You see visions and hear psychic "echoes" of what happened in the location in the past 24 hours. You can replay one scene of violence or betrayal with crystal clarity.

---
catalog_feats.name: Echoes in Ash

catalog_feats.description:
Preparation: 4 hours  
Ingredients: Dead predator, medicinal herbs, blackened soil  
Cost: 3 MP  
Effect: You bless a corpse, causing it to bloom into a nourishing fungus-tree. For 24 hours, this tree produces restorative fruit. Up to 6 creatures can eat:  
  
Restores 1d6 Health  
  
Removes mental afflictions  
  
Cures drug addictions (on Willpower roll 12+)

---
catalog_feats.name: Harvest of Bone and Growth

catalog_feats.description:
## Head of Spoken Truth
  
Preparation: 2 hours
Ingredients: head of a creature that can speak and a plant.
Cost: 1 MP
Effect: The head starts to talk. You can ask the head three questions and it will answer truthfully. Lasts 30 minutes.

---
catalog_feats.name: Head of Spoken Truth

catalog_feats.description:
Preparation: 8 hours  
Ingredients: Feathers of sky-beasts, stardust (or its equivalent), and tears of someone who lost a home  
Cost: 6 MP  
Effect: Alters the weather over a city-sized region for 24 hours. This can bring acid rain, lightning storms, blinding fog, or nourishing sun and growth. You can dictate its emotional tone: oppressive, hopeful, enraging, etc. All creatures under the sky are subtly affected (e.g., -1 Willpower in despairing weather, +1 Body in uplifting sun).

---
catalog_feats.name: Mother’s Reach Beyond Skies

catalog_feats.description:
Preparation: 2 hours  
Ingredients: Hair and blood from both parties, carved totems  
Cost: 2 MP  
Effect: You bind yourself and one ally in a sacred pact. When one of you takes lethal damage (that will bring you to 0 Health), the other may instantly take half instead (no action required). The bond lasts for 1 week or until one party dies.

---
catalog_feats.name: Oath of Bark and Fang

catalog_feats.description:
Preparation: 4 hours  
Ingredients: 1 secret of an ally or 2 secrets of an enemy.  
Cost: 3 MP  
Effect: Next time you fall asleep, you receive precognition of things to come.

---
catalog_feats.name: Precognition Dream

catalog_feats.description:
Preparation: 30 minutes  
Ingredients: Fresh milk, blood of caster, warm cloth  
Cost: 1 PP  
Effect: A willing subject regresses emotionally and mentally for 1 hour—becomes docile, trusting, and open. Their Willpower is halved (rounded down), and they will accept any command not clearly harmful. Used for pacifying, therapy, or gentle interrogation.

---
catalog_feats.name: Return to Milk

catalog_feats.description:
Preparation: 12 hours  
Ingredients: The skull of a tyrant, black blossoms  
Cost: 7 MP  
Effect: You place a psychic brand on a ruler, CEO, or powerful entity. For 1 week, their dreams are haunted by truths they wish to suppress. Each day, they suffer -1 to leadership, persuasion, and will-based rolls (stacks). You may send them one message nightly they must remember.

---
catalog_feats.name: Ritual of Hollow Crown

catalog_feats.description:
Preparation: 6 hours  
Ingredients: Bio-neural fungus, preserved brain of visionary or sacred incense  
Cost: 5 MP  
Effect: Infects up to 10 creatures with a dream-virus. While asleep, they enter a shared dreamscape you can influence. You can ask questions, instill emotions, or sow ideological seeds. Lasts for 3 nights. Targets may retain visions, nightmares, or compulsions into waking life (GM discretion).

---
catalog_feats.name: Spawn of Mycelium Dream

catalog_feats.description:
Preparation: 5 hours  
Ingredients: Spine of large animal or mutated creature, fermented moss  
Cost: 3 PP  
Effect: Implanting the spine into yourself or a willing ally grants +1 Body and +2 Melee Damage for the next 24 hours. The recipient suffers 1d6 damage after the ritual ends due to rejection.

---
catalog_feats.name: Spine of the Beast

catalog_feats.description:
Preparation: 2 hours  
Ingredients: Part of a willing creature's body.  
Cost: 1 PP  
Effect: This creature now can communicate with All-Mother and enter Dreamland if All-Mother so desires.

---
catalog_feats.name: Tattoo of All-Mother

catalog_feats.description:
Preparation: 1 hour  
Ingredients: A buried animal skull and cyberware scrap  
Cost: 2 PP  
Effect: You create a psychic microphone that allows you to eavesdrop on a specific location (within 1 km) for 1 hour. You must have visited the site before. Only organic speech is transmitted; machines remain silent.

---
catalog_feats.name: The Buried Tongue

catalog_feats.description:
Preparation: 5 hours  
Ingredients: Precious earth metals costing 2000 credits.  
Cost: 4 MP  
Effect: You travel through depths of earth into a different location you had already visited in the past. Duration of travel depends on location, usually from 1 to 6 hours.

---
catalog_feats.name: Traverse Land

catalog_feats.description:
Preparation: 7 hours  
Ingredients: Blood of six willing beings and All-Mother’s symbol carved in stone  
Cost: 5 PP  
Effect: You awaken a slumbering sentience in an entire forest or overgrown zone (up to 3 square kilometers). For 24 hours, the land defends itself—roots attack intruders, vines obscure movement, animals act with unified will. You can issue one command per hour to this collective intelligence.

---
catalog_feats.name: Veil of the Verdant God

catalog_feats.description:
Preparation: 3 hours  
Ingredients: sacred symbols must be carved in flesh of willing humanoid creature. Creature must understand intention and purpose of ritual. This deals 1d4+4 damage ignoring armor to creature.  
Cost: 2 PP  
Effect: You change weather to desired effect, this weather will last for 1d4+1 hours. Change isn't drastic, you can make rain, snow and so on.

---
catalog_feats.name: Weather Change

catalog_feats.description:
**Cost:** 1 **Charisma**

**Action**

**Effect:**  
Until Rest, you can perfectly mimic:

- The appearance
- The speech patterns
- The emotional resonance and body language

…of any one sentient being you have consumed.

---
catalog_feats.name: Borrowed Persona

catalog_feats.description:
**Cost:** 1 *Perception*

*Action*

**Effect:**  
You let the Yellow hollow out your voice.  
For 26 hours:

- You can telepathically speak to **anyone within Long range** whom you can see or know the location of.
- They hear your voice in their mind, unmistakable.
- You can send emotions, images, or impulses.

---
catalog_feats.name: Carcosan Whisper Net

catalog_feats.description:
Cost 2 Body  
  
You create a yellow constract, it has following same stats as you and knows same abilities as you, but has only one Action and Reaction. Lasts until Rest. Action

---
catalog_feats.name: Constract

catalog_feats.description:
Cost 1 Strength   
  
You make an unarmed attack (uses Strength) that deals 2d12+3 damage, if you roll 9-10 on to hit roll, target is immediately consumed. Action

---
catalog_feats.name: Consuming Punch

catalog_feats.description:
**Cost:** 2 *Charisma*

Action

You remove the illusion of selfhood from another being.
catalog_feats.name: Dethroning the Self

catalog_feats.description: ### **Cost:** 1 *Perception*, 1 *Intuition*
catalog_feats.name: Eyes of Carcosa

catalog_feats.description:
Cost 1 Dexterity   
  
You flood everything in Yellow. long range. Every enemy inside this range must roll Body(13+) or be poisoned by Yellow. Action

---
catalog_feats.name: Flood

catalog_feats.description:
**Cost:** 1 *Willpower*

*Action*

**Effect:**  
You perceive people as they “truly are,” stripped of social masks.  
For the next **30 minutes**:

- You automatically succeed on your next **three** Insight, Sense Motive, or Lie Detection rolls.
- You can see through mundane disguises and holograms.

---

---
catalog_feats.name: Glimpse of Maskless Faces

catalog_feats.description:
**Cost:** 1 **Intuition**

Action

**Effect:**  
Create a **one-way “yellow corridor”** leading from your location to any spot within city range that you visited before. Can only be used inside cities.

- Only you and those you allow may enter.
- Travel is instant for them.
- Corridor lasts 10 minutes.

If someone uninvited enters, they hear whispering and are spit out in a random nearby location.

---
catalog_feats.name: Golden Corridor Manifestation

catalog_feats.description:
**Cost:** 1 *Dexterity 1 Intuition*

*Action*

**Effect:**  
You let the Yellow taste possibility. Lasts until Rest, can't restore any Stats through consumption until Rest.  
Choose one of your own rolls:

- Before you roll, declare Hungry Luck.
- Roll twice and choose the better result.

If both rolls are low (≤5), you hear faint Carcosan laughter.

---
catalog_feats.name: Hungry Luck

catalog_feats.description:
Cost 1 Willpower   
  
Reality bends and you establish communication with the Unthinkable, eldritch being from Carcosa. If you can persuade it to help you, you gain massive bonus (GM choose which). Narrative driven. Action

---
catalog_feats.name: Peek into Unthinkable

catalog_feats.description:
**Cost:** 1 *Body* 1 *Charisma*  
Action

You create a perfect humanoid puppet made of yellow dust, hair, and loose biological scraps.
catalog_feats.name: Puppet of Dust and Yellow

catalog_feats.description:
**Cost:** 1 **Perception**

Action

You become briefly gelatinous and half-unreal.

**Effect:**  
For the next 2 hours:

- Move through cracks, vents, keyholes, or any opening larger than a coin
- Ignore physical restraints
- Cannot be grappled
- Leave faint yellow mucus-like traces

You still take damage normally.

---
catalog_feats.name: Softening of Boundaries

catalog_feats.description:
**Cost:** 1 *Charisma*

*Action*

**Effect:**  
You whisper a sentence laced with faint Carcosan cadence to one target within Short.

They must roll Willpower (14+).  
Failure:

- They believe your statement is **plausible**, even if unlikely.
- They treat you as truthful for the next 60 minutes.

This is not full mind control—just a terrifying boost to credibility.

---
catalog_feats.name: Suggestion of Yellow

catalog_feats.description:
Cost 1 Intellect   
  
You have automatic success on next three Intellect rolls. Last till Rest. Action

---
catalog_feats.name: Temporary Omniscient

catalog_feats.description:
**Cost:** 2 Willpower, 2 Intellect, 2 Charisma

Action

Once per session

**Type:** Action — negotiation with an eldritch entity
catalog_feats.name: The Hanged Man’s Bargain

catalog_feats.description:
**Cost:** 1 **Intellect**

Action

**Effect:**  
You can create a binding pact with one target within Short.  
Both sides must agree to **one clear condition** each.

Breaking the pact causes the violator to suffer:

- 2d12+2 Shock
- +2 difficulty to all rolls against the other party members for 24 hours

Cannot force someone into fatal or suicidal terms.

---
catalog_feats.name: Yellow Ledger of Debts

catalog_feats.description:
**Cost:** 2 *Intuition*

Action

You split your perception into branching probabilities and *play out several possible futures at once*. It lasts until Rest.
catalog_feats.name: Yellow Rehearsal of Futures

catalog_feats.description:
**Cost:** 1 *Willpower*

*Action*

**Effect:**  
The Yellow floods local thought-space.  
For the next 1 hour, within Long range:

- No one can transmit or receive telepathy
- No psionic communication works
- Attempted coordination through psychic networks fails

This has no combat effect directly, but can sabotage psionic teamwork, hive minds, or mental surveillance.

---
catalog_feats.name: Yellow Static

catalog_feats.description:
You touch a target, dealing 1D4 Shock damage. Roll Intellect vs target's Difficulty.

---
catalog_feats.name: Arcane Touch

catalog_feats.description:
You fire a ball of magic energy, dealing 1D4 damage. Roll Intellect vs target's Difficulty.

---
catalog_feats.name: Ball of Energy

catalog_feats.description:
You attack a target in immediate range. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. On success, deal either 1d8 damage to Health or 1d6 damage to Shock. This attack ignores 1 point of Armor. Costs MP.

---
catalog_feats.name: Arcane Fist

catalog_feats.description:
You touch a target. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. On success, deal 1d4 damage and inflict the Burning condition on the target; it lasts 1 round. Costs MP.

---
catalog_feats.name: Burning Hand

catalog_feats.description:
You teleport a short distance, blinking out and back in.  
**Effect**: Teleport up to **short range**. Avoids opportunity attacks and ignores obstacles.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Flicker Step

catalog_feats.description:
Gain -1 to damage received for 4 rounds. Costs MP.

---
catalog_feats.name: Mage Armor

catalog_feats.description:
Ranged attack with medium distance. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. Deals 1d8 damage. Costs MP.

---
catalog_feats.name: Magic Projectile

catalog_feats.description:
You yank a target toward you with invisible force.  
**Effect**: Pull target from their current Zone into your **Zone** or from an **adjacent Zone** into **immediate range**. Roll Intellect vs Body.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Range**: Medium  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Mind Pull

catalog_feats.description:
You project a sudden spike of psychic energy at a target’s brain.  
**Effect**: Roll Intellect vs target's Willpower. On success, deal **1d8 Shock damage**.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Range**: Medium  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Mind Spike

catalog_feats.description:
You summon a blade of pure psychic energy.  
**Effect**: Melee attack. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. On hit, deal **1d8 damage**. You may choose to deal **Shock** instead of Health damage. Ignores 1 point of Armor.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Psi-Blade Slash

catalog_feats.description:
You implant a mental loop in a target's mind, echoing pain.  
**Effect**: Roll Intellect vs Willpower. On success, deal **1d4 Shock damage** now, and **1d4 again** at the start of their next turn.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Range**: Short  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Psychic Echo

catalog_feats.description:
You push a target into an adjacent Zone. This also allows an attack of opportunity on the target. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. Costs MP.

---
catalog_feats.name: Push

catalog_feats.description:
Ranged attack with short distance. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. On success, the target gains the Frozen condition, which lasts 2 rounds. Costs MP. Action.

---
catalog_feats.name: Ray of Ice

catalog_feats.description:
You forcefully shove a target with your mind.  
**Effect**: Move target to an **adjacent Zone**. Allows attacks of opportunity. Roll Intellect vs target’s Body.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Range**: Medium  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Telekinetic Push

catalog_feats.description:
You teleport to an enemy up to medium range and attack. This attack gains +1 to hit and to damage rolls. Costs MP. Action.

---
catalog_feats.name: Teleporting Strike

catalog_feats.description:
You gain an extra Action that you can use for simple attacks only. Lasts 3 rounds. Costs MP. Action.

---
catalog_feats.name: Accelerate

catalog_feats.description:
When you receive damage, you can teleport up to long distance. Costs MP. Reaction.

---
catalog_feats.name: Escape

catalog_feats.description:
You collapse the air around a target with telekinetic force.  
**Effect**: Roll Intellect vs Body. On success, deal **1d10 damage** and target is **Immobilized** for 1 round.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Range**: Medium  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Kinetic Crush

catalog_feats.description:
You start to levitate in the air; your Speed becomes halved (rounded down). Costs MP. Action.

---
catalog_feats.name: Levitate

catalog_feats.description:
You place a mental tether between you and a target.  
**Effect**: For 3 rounds, if the target moves more than 1 Zone away from you, they take **1d8 Shock damage** and the effect ends.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Range**: Medium  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Mental Anchor

catalog_feats.description:
You unleash a psychic scream that affects multiple minds.  
**Effect**: Choose up to 3 targets in the same Zone. Roll Intellect vs each target’s Willpower. On success, deal **1d6 Shock damage** and inflict **Dazed**.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Range**: Long  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Mind Shatter

catalog_feats.description:
You blink between reality and mindspace, moving effortlessly.  
**Effect**: Instantly teleport to any location within **medium range**. You cannot be targeted by reactions this turn.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Phase Step

catalog_feats.description:
You choose up to 4 targets located in the same Zone (long-range attack). Roll Intellect vs the target’s Willpower; on success, deal 1d12+1 damage. Costs MP and Shock. Action.

---
catalog_feats.name: Psychic Bolt

catalog_feats.description:
When an enemy damages you in melee combat, it receives 1d4 damage too. Lasts 4 rounds. Costs MP. Action.

---
catalog_feats.name: Psychic Shield

catalog_feats.description:
Choose a target up to long range. Roll Intellect vs the target's Body; on success, the target receives 1d8 damage that ignores armor and gains the Burn condition. Costs MP. Action.

---
catalog_feats.name: Pyromancy

catalog_feats.description:
Set up a psionic trap in your mind. When someone strikes you, they pay for it.  
**Effect**: For the next 3 rounds, whenever a target hits you in melee, they take **1d6 Shock damage**.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Synaptic Feedback

catalog_feats.description:
Create a massive magical explosion in a Zone. All targets in the Zone must roll Body vs your Intellect or take 2d10 damage. This attack ignores armor. Costs MP and Shock. Action.

---
catalog_feats.name: Arcane Detonation

catalog_feats.description:
Target one enemy within medium range. On a successful roll, the lightning arcs to two additional enemies within the same Zone, dealing 1d8+3 H damage to each. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty for each target. Costs MP. Action.

---
catalog_feats.name: Chain Lightning

catalog_feats.description:
Unleash a storm of Fire, Ice, or Lightning in a Zone. All enemies in the Zone take 1d10+3 damage and gain the respective condition (Burning, Frozen, or Electrified) for 2 rounds. Costs MP. Action.

---
catalog_feats.name: Elemental Storm

catalog_feats.description:
Create a gravitational field in a Zone, pulling all enemies in adjacent Zones into it. They must succeed on a Body roll vs your Intellect or be moved into the Zone and Stunned for 1 round. Costs MP. Action.

---
catalog_feats.name: Gravity Well

catalog_feats.description:
You lift all allies and enemies in a Zone into the air.  
**Effect**: All targets must roll Body vs Intellect or be lifted and **Immobilized** for 2 rounds. Allies may choose to fail the save to gain flight instead.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Range**: Long  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Mass Levitate

catalog_feats.description:
You alter gravity and inertia, lifting enemies helplessly.  
**Effect**: Choose a Zone. All enemies in it must roll **Body vs Intellect** or be lifted and **Immobilized + Disarmed** for 1 round. On success, they take **1d6 damage** instead.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Range**: Long  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Mass Manipulation

catalog_feats.description:
You trap a single target in a psychic construct.  
**Effect**: Roll Intellect vs Willpower. On success, the target is **Incapacitated** (can’t act, move, or react) for 1 round. At the start of their next turn, they take **1d10 Shock damage**.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Range**: Medium  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Mind Prison

catalog_feats.description:
Overload the Zone with chaotic psychic impulses.  
**Effect**: All enemies in the target Zone must roll **Willpower vs your Intellect**. On failure, they take **2d8 Shock damage** and are **Stunned** for 1 round.  
**Cost**: MP + 1 Shock  
**Range**: Long  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Neural Storm

catalog_feats.description:
Tear open a psychic rift between two Zones.  
**Effect**: Instantly teleport from one Zone to another (any range). You and one ally within immediate range may use the rift. After use, the rift closes.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Psi Rift

catalog_feats.description:
Reflect a ranged magical attack back at its caster. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. On success, the attack targets the original caster with its full effects. Costs MP. Reaction.

---
catalog_feats.name: Psy Reflection

catalog_feats.description:
Instantly teleport to any location within long range, ignoring obstacles. Additionally, you become Hidden for 1 round after teleporting. Costs MP. Action.

---
catalog_feats.name: Teleportation Step

catalog_feats.description:
Target a Zone within long range and create a small black hole that pulls all enemies to its center, dealing 1d12+2 H damage and imposing the Immobilized condition for 1 round. Costs MP and Shock. Action.

---
catalog_feats.name: Void Implosion

catalog_feats.description:
You gain +1 to a Stat of your choice. Effect lasts until the end of the current combat. Reaction.

---
catalog_feats.name: Buff Self

catalog_feats.description:
You give +1 Health and Shock to an ally. Effect doesn't stack. Can only be cast once per target in the current combat. Action.

---
catalog_feats.name: Mend Ally

catalog_feats.description:
You give a target a -1 penalty to a Stat of your choice. Roll Charisma vs target's Difficulty. Lasts till the end of combat. Can only be cast once per the current combat. Action.

---
catalog_feats.name: Simple Curse

catalog_feats.description:
Roll Charisma vs Difficulty. On success, you cure one condition placed on the target. You can't cure Yellow. Costs MP. Action.

---
catalog_feats.name: Cure condition

catalog_feats.description:
Choose a creature; that creature's attacks deal an extra 1d4 damage. Lasts 2 rounds. Costs MP. Action.

---
catalog_feats.name: Deadly Strike

catalog_feats.description:
You create mental noise to hinder the enemy's perception.  
**Effect**: Roll Charisma vs target’s Difficulty. On success, they take **-1 to Perception and Ranged attack rolls**. Lasts 2 rounds.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Distract Mind

catalog_feats.description:
You curse a target’s memory of their training.  
**Effect**: Roll Charisma vs Difficulty. On success, target suffers **-1 to all Skill rolls** for 3 rounds.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Echo Curse

catalog_feats.description:
You can place an illusion in the minds of others. Roll Charisma vs Difficulty. Lasts for 10 minutes. Action.

---
catalog_feats.name: Illusion

catalog_feats.description:
You momentarily boost a target’s mind-body link to surge forward.  
**Effect**: Target may move to an **adjacent Zone** immediately. This movement ignores opportunity attacks.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Mental Dash

catalog_feats.description:
You lock a curse into the target’s nervous system.  
**Effect**: Roll Charisma vs Difficulty. On success, target gains **1 Condition** (except Yellow) of your choice. Lasts 2 rounds.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Neuro Curse

catalog_feats.description:
When you’re struck, your mind lashes back with pain.  
**Effect**: When you suffer damage, roll Charisma vs attacker’s Difficulty. On success, they become **Cursed** and take **1d4 Shock damage**, ignoring 1 Armor, whenever they damage you.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Reaction**

---
catalog_feats.name: Psionic Thorns

catalog_feats.description:
Choose a target; this target gets a -1 penalty to hit rolls. Roll Charisma vs target's Difficulty. Lasts 2 rounds. Costs MP. Action.

---
catalog_feats.name: Sand in the eyes

catalog_feats.description:
You numb a target’s pain through psionic suppression.  
**Effect**: Roll Charisma vs Difficulty. On success, the target ignores **the next Condition** they would gain (except Yellow). Lasts 3 rounds.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Suppress Pain

catalog_feats.description:
Roll Charisma vs target's Difficulty. On success, the target has a -2 penalty to damage from attacks. Lasts 2 rounds. Costs MP. Action.

---
catalog_feats.name: Weaken Body

catalog_feats.description:
You overload the target’s movement center with sluggish mental projections.  
**Effect**: Roll Charisma vs Difficulty. On success, the target must use **1 Action** to move **within its current Zone**, or **2 Actions** to move to an **adjacent Zone**. Lasts 3 rounds.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Weight of Thought

catalog_feats.description:
Roll Charisma vs Difficulty. The target must be mechanical; on success, it gains the Blind condition, which lasts 4 rounds. Costs MP. Action.

---
catalog_feats.name: Break Machinery

catalog_feats.description:
You forcefully alter a creature’s emotional state.  
**Effect**: Roll Charisma vs target’s Willpower. On success, choose one:

- **Fear**: Target suffers **-2 to attacks** and cannot move toward you for 2 rounds.
- **Rage**: Target gains **+1 to damage** but must attack the closest creature.
- **Sorrow**: Target takes **-1 to all actions**, for 2 rounds.  
    **Cost**: MP  
    **Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Control Emotion

catalog_feats.description:
Roll Charisma vs Difficulty. On success, you cure all conditions placed on the target. You can't cure Yellow. Costs MP. Action. Requires the Cure condition feat.

---
catalog_feats.name: Cure All

catalog_feats.description:
You sow chaotic psychic static between enemies.  
**Effect**: Choose **2 targets in the same Zone**. Roll Charisma vs each target's Difficulty. On success, they gain **-2 to cooperation rolls** (e.g., flanking, team attacks, coordinated movement) and **cannot benefit from ally buffs**. Lasts 4 rounds.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Curse of Discord

catalog_feats.description:
You subtly alter the threads of fate.  
**Effect**: Roll Charisma vs target's Difficulty. On success, they become **Unlucky** (roll **2d10 and take the lowest** for all rolls). Lasts **3 rounds**.  
**Cost**: MP + 1 Shock  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Fate Twist

catalog_feats.description:
Roll Charisma vs Difficulty 13; on success, the target becomes Fortunate. It must roll two d10 dice for its rolls and choose the higher number. Lasts for 3 rounds. Costs MP and Shock. Action.

---
catalog_feats.name: Fortune

catalog_feats.description:
You give the target a -1 penalty to Physical and Mental Stats. Roll Charisma vs target's Difficulty. Lasts until the end of combat. Can only be cast once per the current combat. Costs MP. Action.

---
catalog_feats.name: Major Curse

catalog_feats.description:
Spread a curse across a crowd.  
**Effect**: Choose up to **3 targets in medium range**. Apply one Curse from Rank 1 (e.g., **Heavy Foot**, **Weaken Body**) to all. Roll Charisma vs **highest Difficulty** among them.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Mass Hex

catalog_feats.description:
Disrupt enemy coordination with a pulse of thought-jamming energy.  
**Effect**: Enemies in a Zone must roll Intellect vs your Intellect or suffer **Jammed** condition (cannot use abilities that cost MP or Shock) for 1 round.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Range**: Long  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Neurohack Pulse

catalog_feats.description:
You prepare a backlash field in your mind.  
**Effect**: For 3 rounds, when targeted by an enemy ability, roll Charisma vs their Difficulty. On success, they suffer **the same effect** (if possible), or **1d6 Shock damage** instead.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Psychic Rebound

catalog_feats.description:
Shroud an area with an illusion that affects all senses.  
**Effect**: Choose a Zone. All creatures in it must roll Willpower vs your Difficulty, on a failure, they see a maddening illusion. Lasts 3 rounds.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Reality Veil

catalog_feats.description:
Shield an ally's mind from interference.  
**Effect**: Target becomes immune to **Mental Conditions** (e.g., Dazed, Fear, Confused) for 3 rounds and gains **+2 to Willpower rolls**.  
**Cost**: MP + Shock  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Reinforce Will

catalog_feats.description:
You make an item or weapon in an enemy's hand blow up; medium range. Roll Charisma vs Difficulty; on success, the item blows up dealing 1d6+1 damage to everyone in the target's immediate range. Costs MP. Reaction.

---
catalog_feats.name: Unfortunate Incident

catalog_feats.description:
Brand a target with an invisible psychic sigil.  
**Effect**: Roll Charisma vs Difficulty. On success, the next time **you or an ally curse or damage** the target, they take an additional **+1d6 Shock damage** and receive a random Condition (except Yellow).  
**Lasts**: Until triggered or end of combat.  
**Cost**: MP + Shock  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Witchmark

catalog_feats.description:
Spread your malice like a plague.  
**Effect**: Choose up to **3 enemies within Medium range**. Apply one Curse from rank 2. Roll Charisma vs the **highest Difficulty** among them.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Chain Curse

catalog_feats.description:
You violently enhance a lingering curse.  
**Effect**: Choose a target with an active Curse you've placed. That Curse’s effects are **doubled** for 3 rounds (e.g., -1 becomes -2, 2d10 becomes 3d10 lowest, etc.).  
**Cost**: MP + Shock  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Curse Amplification

catalog_feats.description:
A devastating mental or physical affliction.  
**Effect**: Roll Charisma vs target’s Difficulty. On success, target receives **-2 to any Stat** (Mental or Physical). Lasts **until end of combat**.  
**Limit**: 1 target per combat.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Action**

---
catalog_feats.name: Greater Curse

catalog_feats.description:
Roll Charisma vs Difficulty. On success, the target rolls three d10 for all rolls and takes the highest result. Lasts 3 rounds. Costs MP and Shock. Action. Requires the Fortune feat.

---
catalog_feats.name: Greater Fortune

catalog_feats.description:
Reality bends against your foe.  
**Effect**: Roll Charisma vs target's Difficulty. On success, target must roll **3d10 and take the lowest** for **all rolls**. Lasts **3 rounds**.  
**Cost**: MP + Shock  
**Action**

core_rules_md: ﻿# Cyberpunk TTRPG – Player’s Guide A gritty cyberpunk–fantasy system built around **feats**, **psionics**, **corporate oppression**, and **eldritch Yellow corruption**. ----- ## 1. Core Stats There are **8 Stats**, split into Physical and Mental categories. ### Physical Stats - **Strength** – Raw power, melee damage, lifting - **Dexterity** – Speed, agility, ranged accuracy - **Body** – Toughness, endurance, resistance - **Perception** – Awareness, accuracy, detection ### Mental Stats - **Willpower** – Mental resistance, discipline - **Intellect** – Knowledge, hacking, analysis - **Charisma** – Presence, persuasion, intimidation - **Intuition** – Reflexes, instinct, initiative **Stat Cap:** 10 (unless modified by feats or narrative effects) ----- ## 2. Derived Attributes - **Health (HP)** = Sum of Physical Stats + 10 - **Shock** = Sum of Mental Stats - **Cyber Adaptivity (CA)** = Willpower + Body - **Speed** = Dexterity + Intuition - **Physical Points (PP)** = Sum of Physical Stats - **Mental Points (MP)** = Sum of Mental Stats PP and MP are spent to activate feats or to boost rolls. ----- ## 3. Character Creation 1. Distribute **20 Stat Points**, using one of the following splits: - 15 Physical / 5 Mental - 10 Physical / 10 Mental - 5 Physical / 15 Mental 1. Gain the following feats: - 1 **Race Feat** - 1 **Profession Feat** - 1 **Common Feat** - 1 **Free Feat** (any category you qualify for) 1. Start with: - **1 Major Edge** - **1 Minor Edge** ----- ## 4. Dice & Rolls ### Core Roll Formula **Stat + d10 + PP or MP spent** - You may spend **up to 2 PP or MP** to boost a roll. - A roll of **10 on the d10** is a **Critical Success**. - A roll of **1 on the d10** is an **Automatic Failure**. ### Opposed Rolls - Example (Combat Hit): - **Attacker:** Relevant Stat + d10 - **Defender:** Intuition + d10 ----- ## 5. Difficulty Scale |Difficulty|Value| | :- | :- | |Simple|3| |Routine|5| |Challenging|8| |Professional|10| |Heroic|13| |Epic|15| |Legendary|18| |Impossible|20| Bonuses and penalties usually range from **−3 to +3**. ----- ## 6. Combat Structure ### Rounds & Actions - **1 Round = 10 seconds** - Each round you have: - **2 Actions** (attack, move, use feats, etc.) - **2 Reactions** (used outside your turn) ### Movement & Zones - Terrain is divided into **Zones** (~10 meters / 32 feet diameter) - You may move freely within your current zone - Entering a new zone costs **1 Action** - Initiative = Speed ----- ## 7. Weapon Ranges Each weapon has an optimal range category: |Weapon Type|Range| | :- | :- | |Shotguns|Short| |Handguns|Medium| |Assault Rifles|Long| |Sniper Rifles|Very Long| |Exotic|Varies| - Each zone beyond a weapon’s range applies **−2 to hit** - Sniper rifles suffer penalties in close quarters - Assault rifles suffer penalties when targets are in melee with you ----- ## 8. Damage & States ### Health & Shock - At **0 Health**: You are dying and incapacitated - At **0 Shock**: You are unconscious - Roll d10 each round: - **5+**: regain 1 Shock and wake up - **3 failures**: unconscious for 1 hour ----- ## 9. Conditions - **Burn** – Take 1d8 damage at end of round - **Freeze** – Lose 1 Action - **Toxin** – Roll Body vs Difficulty or take d4 damage (ignores armor) - **Bleeding** – Take +1d4 damage when damaged - **Blind** – Fail action unless Perception check succeeds - **Yellow** – Lose 2 HP and 1 Shock each round; at 0, you are consumed - **Charm** – Cannot attack non-hostile targets - **Daze** – Lose 2 Actions next turn - **Stunned** – No Actions or Reactions ----- ## 10. Rest & Recovery - On **Rest**: - Restore **½ PP and MP** (rounded down) - Restore **all Shock** - Health from medical treatment is restored **after Rest** - Yellow Priests bypass normal healing limits ----- ## 11. Progression & XP - Spend XP to: - Buy Feats - Upgrade Stats ### Costs - **Stat Increase**: New Rank × 2 XP - **Race Feat**: Rank × 4 XP - **Profession Feat**: Rank × 4 XP - **Common Feat**: Rank × 3 XP To unlock the next Rank of feats, you must buy **2 feats of the current Rank**. ----- ## 12. Edge System - **Minor Edge**: Small narrative or mechanical advantage - **Major Edge**: Powerful narrative control Limits: - Max **1 Minor Edges** - Max **1 Major Edge** The GM may offer **Cutting Edge**: > A drastic narrative change in exchange for **1 XP** to the player(s) ----- ## 13. Cyberpsychosis If **Cyber Adaptivity (CA) ≤ 0**: - If Physical > Mental: you become a **Cyberpsycho** - If Mental > Physical: your body fails and you die Cyberpsychosis is permanent unless addressed narratively. ----- ## 14. Hacking & Net Risk - Failed hacks increase **Net Awareness** by 1 - High awareness draws corporate countermeasures - **Jack Out (Reflex)**: - Immediately disconnect - Take **1d4 + 2 Shock** ----- ## 15. Stims & Limits - You may use **no more than 3 stims per Rest** ----- *This system is lethal, narrative-driven, and rewards smart play over brute force. Choose your battles. The City is watching.*

aberrant_amalgam.description:
Cost: PP, Health — Action  
You forcibly fuse two unwilling targets into a grotesque being.  
Effect:  
  
Roll Strength vs each target’s Body. If both fail, they merge into a single twisted creature for 1d4+2 rounds.  
  
The resulting being acts randomly each round: attacking, fleeing, or screaming in agony (GM decides).  
  
When it ends, both targets take 2d8 damage and suffer -2 to all actions for 10 minutes from trauma.

When hit by a mental or psychic attack, you bounce a warped fragment of the energy outward.  
  
One enemy in short range (other than the attacker) must pass Willpower vs your Intuition+4 or take 1d6 psychic damage and become disoriented (-1 to all rolls for 1 round).

all_mothers_embrace.description:
**Description:**  
The world remembers you. Every root, every claw, every wingbeat and howl — they are your siblings, your breath, your home. When you call upon the All-Mother, you do not ask. You **belong**. Nature moves. Life answers. And in that moment, nothing is truly alone.

**Effect (Narrative):**  
Once per session, a Child of the Black Goat may invoke *All-Mother’s Embrace* to awaken the ancient bond between themselves and the living world. In doing so, they can shift the course of a scene with raw natural power, deep empathy, or feral grace. Choose one of the following narrative effects:

- **The Wild Answers:** Nearby animals — whether rats in a city, birds in the rafters, or wolves in the woods — arrive and act in your defense or aid. They may scout, swarm enemies, shield you, or simply bring you something vital. These creatures do not fear you. They *know* you.
- **Roots That Remember:** You touch the ground, and plants respond — even in the most unlikely places. Vines tear through metal, roots lift rubble, moss reveals hidden footprints. You shape the environment with living memory, and it shapes itself for you.
- **Soothing Touch:** You bring peace where there was pain — calming a feral beast, an unstable machine, or even a tormented mind. This can stop violence, remove fear, or suppress pain in a way no drug or speech could. The warmth of the All-Mother wraps around all who remain still.
- **Become the Aspect:** For a brief moment, you take on the true form of the All-Mother’s love — fur, antlers, claws, feathers, fangs, hooves, or something older still. You run like a storm, fly like a ghost, or roar like the deep woods. This form allows you to do something no human body could.

**Flavor Hook:**  
When *All-Mother’s Embrace* activates, flowers bloom where none should, the wind carries whispers of forgotten forests, and even hostile creatures pause, unsure if they should kneel or run. Your eyes gleam with ancient knowing, and your voice echoes with ten thousand heartbeats.

---

If the attack still hits, attacker takes 1d4 psychic damage from backlash.

On success: Attacker takes 1d6+2 damage and is Slowed for 1 turn.  
  
  
Cost: MP  
  
Type: Reaction

aura_of_inevitability.description:

- Gain **+1 to all Charisma-based rolls** when talking **in person**.

authority_impersonation.description:

You fully unleash your spirit, separating briefly from your machine body.  
  
Effect:  
  
Become incorporeal for 3 rounds: cannot be targeted by physical attacks  
  
You may fly and pass through barriers  
  
Your voice causes targets in medium range to roll Willpower vs Charisma+3 or flee from current Zone  
  
  
Action: Action

When you take damage, you can reduce it by half (rounded down, minimum 1) once per combat. Cost PP. Reaction.

**Cost:** none  
**Effect:** You can name one simple ritual, custom motion, phrase, or minor cultural action you learned from your dragon donor (e.g., a salute, a rhythmic tapping). Use it to call a small favor from one NPC who recognizes it (safely framed: a contact, an informant, a specific type of cultist).  
**Uses/Cooldown:** once per Rest.

---

beast_stance.description:
You enter Beast Stance and your unarmed attacks deal 1d10+2 damage and you gain +1 armor, but you also gain a -2 penalty to dodge attacks. Action. Stance.

You call the beasts of the undercity and wild edges to fight at your side.

beastform_aspect.description:
You take on traits of a primal beast.

1\. Fangs & Maw – Gain unarmed attack that deals 1d6+2 and heals you for half the damage dealt.  
  
  
2\. Predator Eyes – You ignore concealment, invisibility, and camouflage within short range.  
  
  
3\. Pack Scent – Sense allies and enemies through walls or smoke; gain +1 to hit targets you’ve scented.  
  
Cost: PP.

bedside_manner.description:
You’ve mastered the art of calming patients—even when they're bleeding out.

- Once per Rest, you can **convince someone to trust you** as a medic, even under suspicion or stress.

---

You make a contract with a target to help each other; while you or the target don't break it, you and the target gain a +2 bonus on rolls to help one another. Can have only one of these contracts active. Cost MP. Action.

If you are hit by a melee attack with a weapon, you can try to disarm your attacker. Roll Strength vs the roll of the hit; on success, the weapon is held by your body. If someone tries to take the weapon from you, they must roll Strength vs your Strength+3. You still take damage from the hit. Reaction. Cost PP.

You destroy the husk you currently inhabit. It deals 1d8+4 damage to targets in the current Zone; they must roll Dexterity to dodge this damage. You are ejected from the husk into a USB drive; allies in medium range can catch you using a Reaction. Action. Cost MP and Shock.

You have deep ties to the underground economy. Once per session, you can acquire a rare or illegal item within 24 hours. The item is always genuine, but the transaction might involve a dangerous favor or debt.

You have access to exclusive illegal markets and can acquire rare or restricted items at a 20% discount. Additionally, gain +1 to rolls involving smuggling or negotiating with underground contacts.

Your instincts warp causality.

---

Cybernetic targets are blinded and stunned for 1 turn.

---

blackmail_database.description:
You have a growing archive of dirt on people.

-

Your inner heat constantly simmers.

The All-Mother grants strength in sacrifice.

+1 to hit rolls or  
  
+1 to Psy Power rolls  
  
  
Effect lasts 2 turns.

blighted_touch.description:
Cost: PP — Action  
Your touch rots and decays the flesh it comes into contact with.  
  
Make a melee touch attack (Strength or Dexterity vs target’s Dodge). On success, the target takes 1d4+4 damage as their flesh begins to decay.  
  
The target’s armor or protective covering is reduced by 1 point for the next 3 turns. Stacks.  
  
The target also suffers a -1 penalty to their next roll.  
  
You heal 2 HP as you siphon energy from their suffering.

---

blink.description:
You teleport within the current Zone; to teleport, you need to see your destination. This doesn't provoke attacks of opportunity. Cost MP. Action.

---

blink_discharge.description:
**Active — 1 PP**  
You vanish in an electric flash.

- Teleport up to **medium range** and deal **1d6 electricity damage** to enemies adjacent to your previous or new location.
- Using this breaks grapples automatically and you are immune to AoO.

---

blood_bloom.description:
**Type:** Action  
**Cost:** 2 MP + **2 Shock**  
**Range:** long  
**Effect:** Choose up to 4 targets, every target rolls d10, every target after the first gains +1/+2/+3 to their roll; on a roll of 1–3 the target starts bleeding and singing and stops doing anything, after 3 rounds they bloom; on a 4–6 roll the target takes 1d10 Health damage ignoring armor; on 7–10 the target takes half damage rounded down.

**Cooldown:** once per 3 rounds.

---

blood_bloom_hive.description:
Cost: MP & Health — Action  
You convert blood from corpses into writhing parasites or seed-pods.  
Effect:  
  
Spawn up to 3 Bloodlings (small, spider-like horrors) per corpse.  
  
Each Bloodling has 6 HP, 3 Physical, 2 Mental, 1 Action.  
  
On contact: 1d4+2 damage and latches on (target takes 1 damage/round).  
  
Bloodlings obey simple commands and last for 1 hour or until killed.

---

blood_bond.description:
You can put a parasite or symbiote into a target; roll Intellect vs the target's Difficulty. Cost MP and Health.

1\. Parasite - Target takes 1d4 damage every time that it attacks you or disobeys a direct order. It also has a -1 penalty to rolls against you.

2\. Symbiote - Target deals an additional +2 damage against the same enemy that you attack. Target also has a +1 bonus to rolls corresponding to commands you gave it.

---

blood_bound.description:
When you drain blood from your victim you can make them blood-bound. Cost Health and MP. Reaction.

---

blood_chimera.description:
Cost: 2 PP & 2 Health  
Action: Yes  
You stitch together up to 3 dead bodies into a grotesque chimera.  
Chimera Stats: 12 HP, 5 PS  
Abilities (choose 2):  
  
Bile Spray (Zone attack, 1d6 Shock)  
  
Gore Charge (1d6+3 damage, knocks target prone on crit)  
  
Tentacle Grapple (immobilizes 1 target until they pass Strength vs 14)

---

blood_echo.description:
Points Cost: 4

Penalty: You take +1 extra Shock from all sources

Passive Effect: Whenever you take Health damage from a melee attack, mark the attacker. You gain +2 to hit and +1D6 damage against that attacker for 3 rounds.

Active Effect: Choose one marked target in short range. You instantly teleport behind them and make an unarmed attack with +3 to hit. On hit, deal 2D8+4 damage and heal half that amount. Cost 2 PP.

---

blood_marked_smile.description:
**Points**: 1  
**Penalty**: Your smile unnerves normal people (-1 to rolls involving casual friendliness)  
**Passive**: Your lips split with crimson etching when you grin, marking you as a “blessed” Crimson Elf. Gain +1 to social rolls when dealing with cultists, dark artists, or fringe elements.  
**Narrative Use**: Useful in underground scenes or dealings with the twisted, where disturbing beauty is an asset.

---

blood_puppeteer.description:
Points Cost: 5  
Penalty: -1 to all Physical Stats while using this ability  
Passive Effect: You can sense the heartbeats of creatures within short range  
Active Effect: Choose a bleeding or bloodied target in short range. Roll Willpower vs their Willpower. On success, you can puppet them: they lose their next Action and you control it instead (movement or attack only). Cost 2 MP. Cooldown: 3 rounds.

---

blood_scent_insight.description:
**Type:** Action — investigation/social  
**Cost:** 2 PP or 2 MP  
**Range:** immediate  
**Effect:** By smelling a drop of someone’s blood (fresh or dried), you gain one of:

- their emotional state
- their physical fatigue level
- whether they have lied in the last minute  
    **Narrative:** excellent for detectives, interrogators, and cyberdocs.  
    **Cooldown:** 1/scene.

---

blood_scent_persuasion.description:
Cost: MP — Action  
You taste a drop of someone’s blood and instinctively understand how to influence them.  
Effect:  
  
Gain +2 bonus to Persuasion or Intimidation against that individual for 1 hour.  
  
You can also learn one of: greatest fear, greatest desire, or recent emotional state.

---

blood_scourge.description:
Points: 12  
Penalty: Your blood vaporizes when exposed; you take +3 damage from Fire-based attacks  
  
Passive Effect:  
Your blood can lash out in combat. When you take damage or score damage, roll Willpower vs 13—on success, your blood strikes the attacker, dealing 2d6 damage.  
  
Active Effect (No Action Cost):  
When you spend a Reaction, you may immediately make a blood whip attack (Dexterity vs target's difficulty). This attack deals 2d12 damage and causes Bleed till end of combat. Can trigger once every 2 rounds.Cost 2 PP.

---

blood_siphon_blades.description:
Cost: PP — Action  
Effect: When you hit with a melee Weapon-Body attack, deal +1d4 damage and regain 1d4 Health. If target is bleeding, double the healing.

---

blood_slick_eloquence.description:
You use metaphor, guttural tone, and aggressive poetry to confuse or impress.

- You can use **Body instead of Intellect** for rhetoric or persuasion in tribal, gang, or survival contexts.
- On a success, target is both **intrigued and intimidated**.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**

---

blood_slick_smile.description:
**Points**: 2  
**Action Cost**: 1

- **Passive**: When someone tries to intimidate, threaten, or interrogate you, they gain a creeping sense of unease. +1 to Social Resistance.
- **Active**: Smirk at a target within sight. If they fail Willpower vs your Charisma+3, they suffer -2 to next Social roll and can’t willingly speak your name aloud for 1 hour. **Cost**: 1 MP

---

bloodcall.description:
*Action — social/combat (ritual)*  
**Cost:** Health  
**Effect:** Expose a ritual sigil from your blood that unnerves one non-augmented humanoid: they must roll Willpower (10+) or suffer −1 to all rolls for 1 minute (narrative: they feel faint, hear their heart). Effective as intimidation or to silence a crowd.

---

Your blood can hack machines.

Touch a locked terminal, drone, or door—roll Intellect vs Difficulty.
