liquid courage.description:
- Booze doesn’t just numb pain—it fuels your will.
- **Effect:** When drunk, gain **+2 to Willpower rolls** (resisting fear, persuasion, or psychic influence).
- **Bonus:** Once per session, **ignore the first mental debuff** (fear, charm, confusion).

---

liquid form.description:
You turn into a red liquid akin to blood. You are slow, but you can squeeze through tight places. In this form you can interact with items and mechanisms. Cost PP and Health. Action.

---

liquid run.description:
You can run on liquid surfaces. Cost PP. Action.

---

living ammunition.description:
Cost: PP and Health — Action  
Effect: You generate and fire parasitic projectiles. These deal 1d6+2 damage and reduce target's Armor by 1 (minimum 0) for the rest of the encounter. Projectiles squirm on hit, giving the target -1 to their next roll.

---

living armor.description:
Your body grows a flexible organic armor that grants +2 to Armor and reflects 1d6 damage back to attackers when struck in melee. Lasts for 10 minutes. Cost MP. Action.

---

living legend.description:
Your name inspires awe, fear, or admiration.

- Once per session, you can **auto-succeed on a social interaction** where your fame/reputation matters.
- Additionally, you gain **+2 to all Charisma-based rolls** when interacting with anyone who knows your deeds.

---

living shield.description:
If you successfully grapple an enemy, you can use them as a shield. Until they break free, they take half the damage (rounded down) from attacks targeting you. Cost PP. Reaction.

---

living throne.description:
Cost: PP — Action  
You fuse a corpse into a mobile throne of bone and flesh.  
Effect:  
  
Grants +2 to all Leadership or Domination rolls.  
  
While seated, you gain +2 Armor and immune to being shoved/prone.  
  
Once per combat, it can shield you, absorbing 2d8 damage.

---

living weapon.description:
Your natural weapons (claws, teeth) now deal 2d6+1 H damage. Additionally, they ignore 2 points of armor. Req. Razor-sharp Teeth/Claws.

---

localized virus.description:
You can put a virus on an enemy ICE. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty; on success this ICE has a -3 penalty to all rolls until the end of combat. Costs MP. Action. Requires the Virus feat.

---

localized worm.description:
You can deploy a worm virus that targets a specific system or device. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty On success, the target suffers a -3 penalty to all rolls for the next 2 rounds. Costs MP. Action. Requires **Virus.**

---

lockdown tackle.description:
You charge and tackle, this attack have long range. Roll Strength vs target’s Dexterity. On success, both you and target are Prone and target is Grappled. Target takes 1d4+1 damage.  
Action. Cost: PP

---

logic bomb.description:
You plant a data-mine that fries enemy systems.  
  
Effect: Target electronic or cybernetic enemy. Roll Intellect vs Willpower. On success, deal 1d8 damage that ignores armor and inflict glitch status (lose 1 Action next turn).  
  
Action: Action  
  
Cost: MP

---

luck of the underdog.description:
When you roll a natural 1, you gain +2 to your next roll of the same type.

---

lucky.description:
You gain two luck dice (1d4) which you can add to any of your rolls. Each die is usable once per session.

---

lucky break.description:
Once per session, when you fail a roll, you can declare a “lucky break” and make this roll a critical success. Passive.

---

lucky gambit.description:
Spend all your remaining Luck Points to turn any failed roll into an automatic critical success. This feat can only be used once per session. Action.

---

luminous will.description:
Once per combat, you can negate the effects of a debuff or mind-altering ability targeting you or an ally within your zone. Cost MP. Reaction.- Timeless Beauty: You appear so captivating that enemies are hesitant to attack you directly. Once per combat, force an enemy to reroll a successful attack against you. Cost MP. Reaction.

---

lurker’s invitation.description:
Points: 4  
Action Cost: 2  
  
Passive: You leave behind false echoes of your presence. Enemies have -1 to hit you in Zones you’ve recently been in (lasts 2 rounds).  
  
Active: You and one willing ally instantly swap positions anywhere within long range. Enemies in either your original or new Zone must roll Willpower vs 14 or suffer Disorientation (-2 to rolls for 1 round). Cost 2 MP.

---

machine languages expert.description:
You master machine languages and can speak to any AI, even those with closed encrypted languages. Passive.

---

madman's lunge.description:
*When your mind slips, your enemies bleed.*

- **Effect:** Once per Combat, when you take Shock damage, you may immediately make a **melee attack** as a free action.
- If your attack hits, deal +2 damage.
- **Cost MP.**

---

mage armor.description:
Gain -1 to damage received for 4 rounds. Costs MP.

---

magic projectile.description:
Ranged attack with medium distance. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. Deals 1d8 damage. Costs MP.

---

magnetic boots.description:
\*\*Effect\*\* = You can walk on metallic surfaces even if there are walls and ceilings.   
\*\*Type of Feat\*\* = Passive  
\*\*Cost\*\* = 10000  
\*\*Difficulty to craft\*\* = 13  
\*\*Restrictions\*\* = Legs  
\*\*Special conditions\*\*

---

magnetic grasp.description:
**Effect**: Your hands can generate a magnetic field, allowing you to disarm metal weapons or hold onto metallic surfaces. Action.  
  
**Type of Feat**: Active  
**Cost**: 13000  
**Difficulty to craft**: 13  
**Restrictions**: Arms  
**Special conditions**: Can disarm once per round (your Strength + 2 vs target’s Strength).

---

magnetized.description:
**Effect**: You can throw this weapon up to short distance. It returns but after throw.  
**Type of Feat**: Passive  
**Cost**: 2500  
**Difficulty to craft**: 12  
**Restrictions**:   
**Special conditions**:

---

major abilities.description:
If your Willpower is less than 10, you take 1 Shock damage at the end of your turn while Transcendence abilities are activated. You also spend 1 MP at the end of your turn. Passive abilities don't spend MP or Shock.

When you activate Transcendence ability you gain passive effect, activating active effect is Free Action.

Ignore cost of PP,MP, Health, Shock. I will fix it later.

---

major curse.description:
You give the target a -1 penalty to Physical and Mental Stats. Roll Charisma vs target's Difficulty. Lasts until the end of combat. Can only be cast once per the current combat. Costs MP. Action.

---

major flesh grafts.description:
If you have Body less than 10, you take 1 Health damage at the end of your turn while Flesh Grafts in Active Phase. You spend 1 PP at end of your turn.Passive abilities don't spend PP or Health.

When you activate Flesh Graft ability you gain passive effect, activating active effect is Free Action.

Ignore Flesh Grafts cost of PP, MP,Health,Shock. I will fix this later.

---

make a pact.description:
Contracts that you made have binding power to them. If someone breaks this contract, including you, they must roll Willpower vs your Intellect. On a failure, they take 3 Shock damage.

---

manipulator hand.description:
\*\*Effect\*\* = Drone now has a metal hand which can hold and manipulate objects  
\*\*Type of Feat\*\* = Passive  
\*\*Cost\*\* = 700  
\*\*Difficulty to craft\*\* = 8  
\*\*Restrictions\*\* =  
\*\*Special conditions\*\*

---

mark as prey.description:
You mark one target as Prey. If you are the one who kills this target, you gain an extra Action on your next turn and all targets have a -1 penalty to all rolls against you. You can have one Prey per combat. Action. Costs MP.

---

mark of the devilish pact.description:
You have made a silent deal with the *Man with a Devilish Mind*. Once per Rest, you may **ask for help in a desperate situation**—a door opens, a system glitches, someone forgets seeing you.  
The effect is real, but the GM **gains an automatic Intrusion** to use on you later.  
**Passive.**

---

mark of the joshua.description:
Place a subtle mental brand tied to the Yellow Sign.  
**Effect**: Target must roll Willpower vs your Difficulty. On failure, they are **Marked** for 5 rounds. While Marked, they **take +1 damage from all psychic attacks** and **can be sensed** regardless of distance.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Action**

---

martyr.description:
You can try to ignite zeal in a crowd of humans, roll Charisma vs difficulty. On success, the crowd tries to protect you from harm, but they will not make aggressive moves or attack your enemies.

---

mass hex.description:
Spread a curse across a crowd.  
**Effect**: Choose up to **3 targets in medium range**. Apply one Curse from Rank 1 (e.g., **Heavy Foot**, **Weaken Body**) to all. Roll Charisma vs **highest Difficulty** among them.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Action**

---

mass levitate.description:
You lift all allies and enemies in a Zone into the air.  
**Effect**: All targets must roll Body vs Intellect or be lifted and **Immobilized** for 2 rounds. Allies may choose to fail the save to gain flight instead.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Range**: Long  
**Action**

---

mass madness.description:
Points: 2  
  
Action Cost: 2  
  
Passive: Everyone in the current Zone has a -2 penalty to resist mental effects  
  
Active: Everyone in the current Zone must roll Willpower vs your Willpower+5. On a failure, you choose a mental effect (PTSD, Mania, Paranoia, etc.). This effect lasts for 3 rounds. Cost 1 MP.

---

mass manipulation.description:
You alter gravity and inertia, lifting enemies helplessly.  
**Effect**: Choose a Zone. All enemies in it must roll **Body vs Intellect** or be lifted and **Immobilized + Disarmed** for 1 round. On success, they take **1d6 damage** instead.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Range**: Long  
**Action**

---

mass siphon.description:
Choose up to 4 targets in long range. Roll Perception or Willpower VS Body or Intellect. On success deal 1d4 Shock, restore as much Ectoplasm. Action. Cost MP.

Requires Siphon Energy feat.

---

mass telepathy.description:
You can link the minds of multiple individuals and communicate telepathically. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. On success, you can communicate with up to 5 people at once, and they can reply mentally. This link lasts for 60 minutes. Costs MP. Action.

---

master alchemist.description:
Your custom drugs now have heightened potency. When creating a drug, you can add one of the following effects: +2 to any stat for 1 hour, recover 5 Health, or resist one condition for 2 rounds. Costs PP. Action. Req. Modern Alchemist.

---

master craftier.description:
You can try to create an exceptional armor, exceptional weapon, armor feat, or weapon feat. Roll Intellect vs Difficulty. If it's armor or weapon, it has 4 feat slots. Costs MP. Requires Expert Craftier

---

master gambler.description:
When gambling, you can reroll once per session and gain an additional +4 to the roll. Req. Lucky.

---

master linguist.description:
You know five additional languages and can identify obscure dialects or ciphers with a roll.
Languages you can take:
Human
Elvish
Runic(Dwarf)
Eldritch(Fae)
Dragonspeak
Old Elvish(Crimson elf)
Machine
---

master manipulator.description:
You can play two sides against each other with ease.

- Once per session, you may **convince two hostile groups to distrust each other instead of you**, even temporarily.
- Requires at least **one minute of dialogue** with each side.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**

---

master of deception.description:
You gain +2 to all deception or disguise rolls. Additionally, you can attempt to impersonate a specific individual with a +1 bonus.

---

master of masks.description:
Your personas are so perfect, they pass legal and digital scrutiny.

- Gain **+3 to rolls involving false identities**.
- Once per session, you may **instantly activate a new identity**, complete with digital footprint and voiceprint.
- You count as a different person to facial and biometric scanners.

---

master of the grid.description:
You gain +2 to all Hacking, Surveillance, and Digital Manipulation rolls. Additionally, you can instantly detect any other Advent AIs within Long range — even if hidden. You can send secret digital pings to them. Passive.

---

mastermind protocol.description:
At the start of combat, you can coordinate multiple allies via your cyberdex, granting all allies in your zone +2 to Speed and +1 to all actions for the next 5 rounds. Costs PP. Reaction.

---

meat shield.description:
*Pain is irrelevant. You soak bullets like a sponge.*

- **Effect:** As a Reaction to being targeted by a ranged attack, you can impose **Disadvantage** on the attack roll, but immediately take 1d4 Shock damage.

Cost PP.

---

mechanical axillary heart.description:
\*\*Effect\*\* = You no longer need a heart transplant. You also now have 6 Axillary Pointe (AP) and you don't die at Heart Pressure (HPres) 7+, instead you become unconscious for the next 6 hours.

\*\*Type of Feat\*\* = Passive  
\*\*Cost\*\* = 25000  
\*\*Difficulty to craft\*\* = 16  
\*\*Restrictions\*\* = Torso  
\*\*Special conditions\*\*

Only for Xerm

---

mechanical possession.description:
You leave your android body behind and possess another mechanical shell.  
  
Effect: You possess any robotic or cybernetic being in range (except player characters or bosses).  
  
For 5 rounds, you use their stats + 2 of your abilities  
  
Your body lies inert and vulnerable  
  
  
Action: Action  
  
Cost: MP

---

medical authority.description:
Your presence demands respect in healthcare matters.

- When speaking in public or to groups, you can **use Intellect instead of Charisma** for persuasion if it’s about medicine or health.
- NPCs are more likely to **obey your orders in emergencies** if they see you as a medical expert.

---

mega corp rogue ai.description:
You were created by one of the mega corps; choose this mega corp. You have +1 to rolls about this corp and rolls to hack or breach systems of this corp. Passive.

---

memory graft.description:
**Cost:** MP  
**Effect:**  
By stitching in a brain (or part of one) from a corpse, you can **access specific memories** of that individual.

- Ask the GM **up to 3 detailed questions** about the person’s life, knowledge, secrets, or trauma.
- You gain a **+2 bonus to Intellect and Charisma** when interacting with people the donor knew, till Rest.
- Roll Intuition vs 14 at the end of the Scene. On failure, you experience a **brief identity confusion episode** (GM may impose hallucinations or personality drift).

---

memory of eternity.description:
**Type:** Passive — long-term foresight / narrative  
**Cost:** none  
**Effect:** Your draconic lineage gives you cosmic insight.

Once per session, declare **“I recall a forgotten truth.”**

You may:

- Ask the GM one **major lore question** and receive accurate insight
- Identify any magical, psionic, or technological anomaly within **Very Long range**
- Predict a likely outcome of a major decision or path

Additionally, gain **advantage (roll 1d4 dice and add result to your d10 roll)** on all Investigation checks involving ancient history.

---

memory parasite.description:
**Points**: 6  
**Penalty**: You sometimes lose track of which memories are truly yours  
**Passive**: When touching someone (skin-to-skin), you may absorb one of their recent surface memories  
**Active (2 MP)**: Extract a hidden or suppressed memory from a creature (willing or helpless). Willpower vs Intellect. GM may insert cryptic visions.

---

memory swap.description:
You confuse a target by swapping short-term memories.  
**Effect**: Roll Willpower vs Difficulty. On success, target loses track of the last 5 minutes. You can also change the target's memories.   
**Cost**: MP  
**Action**

---

memory web.description:
You can manipulate multiple targets’ memories in a Zone. Roll Willpower vs Difficulty for each target. On success, you erase or modify memories of up to 3 targets in the Zone, causing disorientation or confusion. Costs MP. Action.

---

mend ally.description:
You give +1 Health and Shock to an ally. Effect doesn't stack. Can only be cast once per target in the current combat. Action.

---

mental anchor.description:
You place a mental tether between you and a target.  
**Effect**: For 3 rounds, if the target moves more than 1 Zone away from you, they take **1d8 Shock damage** and the effect ends.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Range**: Medium  
**Action**

---

mental dash.description:
You momentarily boost a target’s mind-body link to surge forward.  
**Effect**: Target may move to an **adjacent Zone** immediately. This movement ignores opportunity attacks.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Action**

---

mental dominion.description:
You take full control over a target's body for 2 rounds. Roll Willpower vs Difficulty. On success, you control the target’s movement and actions, and they cannot resist. Costs MP. Action.

---

mental fortress.description:
You gain a +1 bonus to rolls against psychic attacks or mind-affecting abilities. Passive.

---

mental override.description:
Take command of mechanical or AI-driven beings.  
**Effect**: Roll Charisma vs target’s Difficulty. On success, **you control the target** for 2 rounds.  
**Target** must be **mechanical or AI-based**.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Action**  
**Requires**: *Break Machinery*

---

mental ping.description:
You send a mental signal to a creature you know.  
**Effect**: Transmit a short (few minutes) emotional or visual message to a willing creature you know within **1 kilometer**.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Free**

---

mental uplift.description:
\*\*Effect\*\* = You gain +1 to Mental Stat of your choosing   
\*\*Type of Feat\*\* = Passive  
\*\*Cost\*\* = 8000  
\*\*Difficulty to craft\*\* = 13  
\*\*Restrictions\*\* = Bio  
\*\*Special conditions\*\*  
Can be taken up to 4 times  
Can't choose same Stat

---

mentally gifted.description:
Add 2 extra points to your MP.

---

mentor.description:
When you get bonus XP from feat Fast Learner, other players also gain this bonus XP.

---

merge with host.description:
Cost: PP — Action  
You temporarily fuse into another creature. Roll Dexterity vs target Body.  
Effect:  
  
While merged, you can sense everything the host does. You cannot act directly, but may speak through them and influence their decisions with +2 to social rolls.  
  
You may burst out at any time, causing 2d6 damage to the host and appearing in an adjacent Zone.

---

mesmerizing glare.description:
Opened Third Eye. You mesmerize the target; roll Perception vs target Willpower. On success, the target can't take their eyes off your third eye. It will not move or attack while it sees your third eye. The effect will break if the target gets attacked. Action. Cost PP.

---

message.description:
You can send a message into the mind of a willing creature that you know. Range of 1 kilometer. That creature can also talk back to you. Costs MP. Free.

---

metal monk.description:
You combine your weapon augment and one of your Stances. This combines the effects that the augment and Stance give you and you choose damage of augment or Stance. Requires you to have a minimum of 3 Stances. Lasts while you are in the chosen stance. Costs PP. Action.

---

metamorphic range weapons.description:
You change part of your body into a ranged weapon:

1\. One dealing 1d8+2 damage and having Full Auto feat

2\. One dealing 1d4+4 Shock damage

3\. One dealing 1d4+3 damage, projectiles missed by this weapon will try to hit its intended target on next turn

Cost PP and Health. Action.

---

metamorphic weapons.description:
You make part of yourself into a melee weapon:

1\. Light weapon that deals 1d4+4 damage and has a +1 bonus to hit and dodge in melee combat.

2\. Medium weapon that deals 1d6+4 damage.

3. Heavy weapon that deals 1d8+4 damage but has a -1 penalty to hit and dodge in melee combat.

Cost PP and Health. Action.

---

military expertise.description:
You know how to use military vehicles like tanks, attack helicopters and so on.

---

mimic.description:
You can try to mimic another humanoid creature. You must know how this creature looks. Roll Dexterity. This roll is the difficulty against enemy rolls to call your bluff. Cost PP. Action.

---

mind block.description:
You can protect yourself or an ally from psychic attacks. Roll Willpower vs Difficulty. On success, the target gains immunity to psychic attacks for 3 rounds. Costs MP. Action.

---

mind cage.description:
Trap a target’s consciousness in a prison of their own thoughts.  
**Effect**: Roll Willpower vs target’s Difficulty. On success, the target is **Stunned** for 2 rounds and suffers **2d6 Shock damage**.  
**Cost**: MP and Shock  
**Action**

---

mind domination.description:
You can fully control a person’s mind, bending them to your will for a limited time. Roll Willpower vs Difficulty. On success, you control the target’s actions for 10 minutes, or 1d4 rounds if in battle. The target may resist with a Willpower roll once every 10 seconds, or every round if in battle. Costs MP and Shock. Action.

---

mind echo.description:
When you hear someone’s voice, you can perfectly recall their speech later, imitating their tone and words flawlessly. Gain +1 to deception rolls when using this mimicry.

---

mind leash.description:
Cost: MP — Action  
You mentally tether yourself to a target within sight.  
  
For 3 turns, target must pass a Willpower vs your Perception+3 each round.  
  
On failure: you know all their intentions for that turn and can impose -2 to one chosen roll they make.  
  
If they leave your sight, effect ends.  
  
If they succeed 2 times in a row, the link is broken.

---

mind prison.description:
You trap a single target in a psychic construct.  
**Effect**: Roll Intellect vs Willpower. On success, the target is **Incapacitated** (can’t act, move, or react) for 1 round. At the start of their next turn, they take **1d10 Shock damage**.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Range**: Medium  
**Action**

---

mind probe.description:
You can delve into a person's mind to gain information. Roll Willpower vs Difficulty. On success, you learn the target's surface thoughts or one piece of information they are actively thinking about. Costs MP. Action.

---

mind pull.description:
You yank a target toward you with invisible force.  
**Effect**: Pull target from their current Zone into your **Zone** or from an **adjacent Zone** into **immediate range**. Roll Intellect vs Body.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Range**: Medium  
**Action**

---

mind shatter.description:
Inflict psychic overload on a single target. Roll Charisma vs Difficulty. On success, the target takes 2d8 Shock damage and becomes Stunned for 1 round. Costs MP and Shock. Action.

---

mind shield.description:
When you take Health damage, you can choose to convert it into Shock damage (you choose how much). Costs MP. Reaction.

---

mind spike.description:
You project a sudden spike of psychic energy at a target’s brain.  
**Effect**: Roll Intellect vs target's Willpower. On success, deal **1d8 Shock damage**.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Range**: Medium  
**Action**

---

mind: shattered lens.description:
Cost: MP — Action  
Your presence distorts the minds of all who try to perceive you.  
  
For 3 turns, anyone who targets you must roll Intellect vs your Charisma+4.  
  
On failure, they lose their action and are Confused (roll a d4 for random behavior).  
  
On success, they act normally but with -1 to hit.  
  
  
Cameras and sensors display surreal, corrupted versions of your image.

---

mindforge implant.description:
**Effect** = You can temporarily "forge" a new psyonic ability by combining two existing ones. The combined ability lasts till end of current combat round and costs +2 MP to use.
**Type of Feat** = Active
**Cost** = 25000
**Difficulty to craft** = 15
**Restrictions** = Bio
**Special conditions** = Requires at least two psionic abilities. Once per combat. Must be psyonic.

---

mindlink.description:
\*\*Effect\*\* = You can control your augmented limbs even if they aren't directly connected to you.

\*\*Type of Feat\*\* = Passive  
\*\*Cost\*\* = 8000  
\*\*Difficulty to craft\*\* = 12  
\*\*Restrictions\*\* = Head  
\*\*Special conditions\*\*

---

mindroot virus.description:
Cost: MP, — Action  
You spawn an organic-psionic virus that targets cybernetic implants or AI minds.  
  
Roll Intellect vs target's Intellect.  
  
On success, choose one effect (lasts 3 rounds):  
  
AI/robotic targets suffer -2 to all rolls  
  
Cybernetic enemies lose use of 1 chosen implant/augmentation  
  
Organic enemies with implants take 1d6 psychic damage per round  
  
  
Virus spreads if target dies, jumping to another in same Zone (new roll required).

---

mindstorm generator.description:
**Effect** = You unleash a psyonic shockwave in a long range. All enemies in the area must roll Willpower vs. Difficulty 13 or suffer 2D6+2 mental damage that ignores armor. Action.
**Type of Feat** = Active
**Cost** = 15000
**Difficulty to craft** = 14
**Restrictions** = Bio
**Special conditions** = Once per 3 turns. Requires being a psyonic.

---

mithril coated armor.description:
\*\*Effect\*\* = You gain +1 damage reduction and you are immune to +3 bonus from adamantite coating.  
\*\*Type of Feat\*\* = Passive  
\*\*Cost\*\* = 6500  
\*\*Difficulty to craft\*\* = 13  
\*\*Restrictions\*\* =  
\*\*Special conditions\*\*

---

mod chic.description:
You know how to present your augmentations as style statements.

- Gain **+1 to Charisma-based rolls** when interacting with characters who appreciate augments.
- Once per scene, you can **impress, distract, or disarm** a target by showcasing or talking about your augments.

---

mod cult leader.description:
You’ve turned enhancement into a movement.

- Gain a **follower faction** (fanatics, clients, test subjects, or believers) who idolize you and your augment philosophy.
- Once per session, you can **rally them** to provide aid, distraction, or protection.
- Gain **+2 to persuasion and intimidation** rolls when referencing your "followers" or philosophy.

---

modern alchemist.description:
- You can create and abuse a special drug created by you. You work with the GM on what this drug does.

---

modular armaments.description:
Cost: PP and Health — Action  
Effect: Choose two Weapon-Body upgrades (from melee or ranged variants) and graft them together. You can freely swap between them once per round as a Free Action. Each change adds +1 to your next attack roll that round.

---

molding flash.description:
When you get hit in melee, you can contort your flesh to grab either the attacker or their weapon. Roll Dexterity vs difficulty of target. Cost PP. Reaction.

---

molten hunger form.description:
Cost: MP & Health — Action  
You liquefy into a mass of blood and teeth.  
Effect (lasts 2 rounds):  
  
Move through tight spaces, immune to bullets and melee.  
  
Can bite all enemies in Zone (roll once, apply 2d6+3 damage to each on success).  
  
Anyone damaged by bite takes -1 to resist your psychic powers until end of combat.

---

molten spirit.description:
**Type:** *Reaction*

*Cost PP*  
When you take elemental, fire, or psionic damage:

  
- Your next melee attack within 3 turns deals **+3 Damage of same kind**

---

momentum dash.description:
After striking a target, you can dash to another Zone as part of the same action.

---

moonlight persona.description:
You subtly alter your body language and voice to match the expectations of others.

- Gain **+2 to Charm or Deception** when pretending to be part of a social group (e.g., corporate, noble, resistance).
- Once per Rest, avoid suspicion or bypass a security check if watched or interrogated.  
    **Passive.**

---

mother touch.description:
You touch a plant or a tree. It starts to blossom. Can help even dying plant life. Cost PP. Action.

---

mother’s reach beyond skies.description:
Preparation: 8 hours  
Ingredients: Feathers of sky-beasts, stardust (or its equivalent), and tears of someone who lost a home  
Cost: 6 MP  
Effect: Alters the weather over a city-sized region for 24 hours. This can bring acid rain, lightning storms, blinding fog, or nourishing sun and growth. You can dictate its emotional tone: oppressive, hopeful, enraging, etc. All creatures under the sky are subtly affected (e.g., -1 Willpower in despairing weather, +1 Body in uplifting sun).

---

mother’s veil.description:
The All-Mother cloaks your presence from the impure.  
  
Effect: You and up to two allies become invisible to tech-based detection, scanners, and cameras for 10 minutes.  
  
If you stand still in a natural environment, you also become undetectable by most psychic means.  
  
  
Bonus: While Veiled, gain +2 to stealth.  
  
Cost: MP  
  
Type: Action

---

mount gun.description:
You mount range weapon to your vehicle. It takes about an hour to do.

---

mountain’s resilience.description:
Once per combat, you can negate a critical hit against you, reducing it to a normal hit instead. Cost PP. Reaction.

---

mouth flamethrower.description:
\*\*Effect\*\* = You breathe a lane of fire, roll Dexterity vs Difficulty; on a success, you deal 2D4+2 damage and the target gains the Burn condition  
\*\*Type of Feat\*\* = Active   
\*\*Cost\*\* = 12000  
\*\*Difficulty to craft\*\* = 13  
\*\*Restrictions\*\* = Head  
\*\*Special conditions\*\*  
Once per round

---

mouths in the skin.description:
Points: 3  
Action Cost: 2

override the limit.description:
**Description:**  
The Xerm were not designed to endure — they were designed to dominate. When the Axeliary Heart surges, limits shatter. Bone, sinew, muscle, and machine scream in perfect harmony. In this moment, the Xerm doesn’t just fight — they **become the weapon** they were built to be.

**Effect (Narrative):**  
Once per session, the Xerm may trigger *Override the Limit*, forcing their Axeliary Heart into overdrive to perform an impossible feat of physical might or tactical destruction. Choose one of the following effects:

- **Brutal Apex:** You lift, break, or throw something that should be untouchable — a tank, a blast door, a collapsing building. No roll. No hesitation. You simply *do it*, because no one told your second heart it couldn’t be done.
- **Quadrilimbed Onslaught:** All four arms move with perfect violence — parrying, firing, strangling, and ripping in one seamless motion. You wipe out a small squad, dominate a boss-tier foe, or demolish a defensive line in seconds.
- **Protective Instinct Surge:** You shield an ally with your entire body, catching explosions, falling debris, or energy blasts that should kill you both. The Axeliary Heart floods your system, turning pain into fury, and you rise from the rubble stronger than before.
- **Gravity is a Lie:** For one terrifying moment, the Axeliary Heart overpowers the rules of weight and inertia. You leap across a battlefield, tear through armored walls, or descend from above like a living meteor — a weaponized myth in motion.

**Flavor Hook:**  
When *Override the Limit* activates, the Axeliary Heart glows through the Xerm’s flesh — veins blacken, steam hisses from vents along their back, and their breath becomes a low, inhuman growl. Some whisper that the heart is not entirely mechanical — that it *hungers* when pushed too far.

patchwork persistence.description:
**Description:**  
You were not made to die — just torn apart and rebuilt, again and again. Where others fall, you reassemble. Where others break, you adapt. When the pain gets too loud, you become something worse: **focused**. In the moment between collapse and oblivion, you come back *wrong* — and stronger.

**Effect (Narrative):**  
Once per session, a Stitches may activate *Patchwork Persistence* when they are overwhelmed, wounded beyond reason, or mentally breaking down. They tap into the monstrous reservoir of spare parts, trauma, and raw survival to do something no living being should. Choose one of the following narrative effects:

- **Limb Reclaimed:** You tear off a ruined limb and jam a new one in — maybe your own, maybe not. It *works* instantly. A monstrous arm for crushing, a birdlike wing for gliding, or a stolen optic that sees through walls. For the rest of the scene, that limb grants an edge others can't match.
- **Pain Filter Engaged:** Your trauma burns so bright that it drowns out everything else. Pain? Gone. Fear? Gone. You move through bullets, fire, or agony like a force of nature. For one scene, you are unstoppable — not because you’re invincible, but because you *no longer care*.
- **Neurocascade:** Your fractured mind stutters, stalls — then blooms into chaotic brilliance. You hyperfocus, solve a complex puzzle, see a pattern in noise, or crack a digital lock no sane brain could process. Your madness is a key the world doesn’t understand.
- **Assemble the Monster:** You fall apart — and put yourself back together into something terrifying. You stand with two right arms, a mechanical spine, a face that isn’t yours. Enemies recoil. Allies hesitate. Your very presence alters the emotional tone of the scene, allowing you to dominate or disrupt it with raw monstrosity.

**Flavor Hook:**  
When *Patchwork Persistence* triggers, metal groans, bone cracks, and memories surface that aren’t entirely yours. A voice you don’t recognize whispers comfort or threat. The room fills with a sterile hum — as if Biolumina is watching, even now.

| ----------- | ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| −5          | Ghost       | Fully lucid. No episode risk. Augments feel heavy, almost foreign. −1 to rolls using augments.            |
| −3/−4       | Coherent    | You're yourself. Episode only on a natural 1.                                                             |
| −1/−2       | Feedback    | Occasional static. DM gives one false sensory input per session.                                            |
| 0           | Baseline    | Starting point. Nothing special.                                                                          |
| +1/+2       | Overclocked | Augments feel good. +1 to augment rolls. DM triggers an episode on a 1–2 (max twice per session).                                             |
| +3/+4       | Fragmented  | Your sense of self is breaking up. DM can trigger episodes freely (max twice per session).      |
| +5          | Chrome      | The ghost is gone. Full DM control. No save possible.                                                     |

What moves the dial toward Noise (+): Killing innocent, taking damage that makes you unconscious or in dying condition, stimulants, sleep deprivation.
What moves the dial toward Signal (−): Physical human contact, eating real food, genuine conversation with a comrade, downtime rituals (cleaning weapons, listening to old music).

reality is a suggestion.description:
**Description:**  
The Eldritch do not see the world as others do. Time is fractured, space is thin, and cause and effect are only polite traditions. When pressed, when *interested*, or when simply *bored*, they exert their alien will and show that existence is a game played by their rules — and they’re willing to cheat.

**Effect (Narrative):**  
Once per session, the Eldritch may activate *Reality Is a Suggestion* to irreversibly alter the rules of a scene, reshaping the environment, the flow of events, or the physics underpinning them. Choose one of the following narrative effects:

- **Folded Space:** You reach a place that should be impossible — stepping from an alley into a locked vault, speaking into a mic and being heard miles away, or dragging someone *out* of hiding through a wall. Space folds because you no longer feel like obeying it.
- **Inverted Cause:** You declare that something *has already happened* — a death, a deal, a betrayal — and the world agrees. Evidence appears, memories adjust, and consequences unfold. It’s not time travel; it’s something worse: narrative displacement.
- **Nothing Personal:** A weapon, spell, or force meant to destroy you simply… doesn’t. It passes through, breaks apart, or forgets what it was doing. Gravity fails, guns misfire, logic stutters. You are simply immune for a moment — not due to resistance, but irrelevance.
- **The Unmaking Glare:** You fix your gaze on something — a machine, a person, a concept — and it begins to unravel. Flesh curdles, circuits scream, or ideas fall apart in people’s minds. It doesn’t "die." It becomes a question that no longer makes sense.

**Flavor Hook:**  
When *Reality Is a Suggestion* is used, glass warps inward, lights bend toward darkness, and background noise hiccups like a skipping record. Eyewitnesses later stammer, “That’s not what happened,” while their pupils dilate in fear. The Eldritch remains still, but everything else shifts.

root access granted.description:
**Description:**  
Firewalls? Laughable. Encryption? Already broken. They thought the system was safe, but they didn’t plan for *you*. You don’t just hack into places — you **recode** them. And when you flip the switch, reality bends to the logic of your code.

**Effect (Narrative):**  
Once per session, the Hacker may activate *Root Access Granted* to seize total control over a digital system, device, or network — altering the course of an entire scene through raw cybernetic supremacy. Choose one of the following narrative effects:

- **Blackout Protocol:** You instantly crash all systems in an area — lights, turrets, drones, life support, comms. In the dark and silence, you move like a ghost. Panic spreads. You wrote the kill-switch. Now you’re flipping it.
- **Spoofed Reality:** You rewrite what the enemy sees — on HUDs, security cams, even neural implants. You become invisible, or everyone in your team does. The system tells them you’re somewhere else. The system lies. Because *you told it to*.
- **Worm Deployment:** You launch a handcrafted virus that spreads like wildfire — locking doors, frying targeting systems, erasing evidence, or triggering auto-payouts to your bank. It was already there, waiting. You just gave it the green light.
- **Cyberdex Ascension:** For one scene, you interface with the net at full capacity — fingers blurring, eyes glowing with datastreams. You can pull live feeds, decrypt anything, control enemy tech, or even “speak” to rogue AIs. Nothing in the digital realm can hide from you.

**Flavor Hook:**  
When *Root Access Granted* triggers, your cyberdex hisses with static. Glyphs and command lines dance across your eyes. Somewhere, a megacorp’s alarm goes off in panic — but it’s too late. You’re already inside. And now **you own it**.

signed in suffering.description:
**Description:**  
The Deviltouched are not just survivors — they are legal alchemists, bending words into chains or keys. Twisted by the Baroque Disease into devilish forms, they are feared for their sharp minds and sharper tongues. When the time is right, they reach into the fabric of law, promise, and guilt — and *rewrite reality’s fine print*.

**Effect (Narrative):**  
Once per session, the Deviltouched may activate *Signed in Suffering* to twist the terms of a deal, moment, or binding truth — turning systems, expectations, or power structures against their wielder. Choose one of the following narrative effects:

- **Clause Revealed:** You reveal a hidden term, loophole, or flaw in an agreement, law, or binding spell — one that everyone else missed. Use this to nullify a contract, free someone from punishment, or flip a deal so the enemy is bound instead.
- **Infernal Persuasion:** You speak with such controlled, dark precision that your words *cannot* be ignored. For one scene, you can force someone to treat your words as legally or morally binding — a criminal confesses, a noble reconsiders, or an AI follows your interpretation over its directive.
- **Contractual Trap:** You reveal that someone else *already agreed* to something — verbally, digitally, or metaphysically — and now the consequences arrive. This could mean a favor owed, an AI trigger phrase, a delayed curse, or a bureaucratic bomb detonating at the perfect time.
- **Sin Made Visible:** You point out hypocrisy, guilt, or corruption with such force that it cannot be denied — by law, by spell, or by social order. A corrupt Elf official is disgraced in public, a corporation’s crime is made undeniable, or a previously protected villain becomes vulnerable.

**Flavor Hook:**  
When *Signed in Suffering* is used, the air hums with whispered language. Words hang in the air like ash. Eyes glow faintly red. Somewhere, a pen clicks, a judge’s gavel falls, or an unseen signature seals itself in blood.

stillness in motion.description:
**Description:**  
You don’t fight like others. You breathe. You listen. You flow. In the heat of battle, when gunfire and panic drown thought, your mind becomes still — and your body becomes unstoppable. You are balance in violence. Precision in the storm.

**Effect (Narrative):**  
Once per session, the Street Fighter may activate *Stillness in Motion* to achieve a moment of perfect harmony between body, mind, and battlefield. In this state, you perform a feat of martial prowess or acrobatic dominance that redefines what’s possible. Choose one of the following effects:

- **Walk the Impossible:** You scale a collapsing wall, leap between speeding vehicles, or flip through laser grids in perfect rhythm. Gravity bows to discipline. You reach the unreachable — and look graceful doing it.
- **Strike the Soul:** You unleash a single, flawless blow — open-palm, elbow, kick, or even a finger tap — that bypasses armor, tech, and toughness. It doesn’t just hurt. It **ends** the fight. A cyber-soldier shorts out. A mutant convulses. A bodyguard folds with respect.
- **Flow Like Water:** Surrounded and outnumbered? You redirect, disarm, disable, and deflect — turning every attack into momentum. The scene ends with your enemies unconscious, confused, or defeated without you ever drawing a weapon.
- **Steel Mind, Living Body:** You shrug off pain, mind-control, panic gas, or psionic interference through sheer inner control. Your heartbeat slows. Your breathing centers. You act with total clarity, even as others break. For this scene, nothing sways your will.

**Flavor Hook:**  
When *Stillness in Motion* activates, the chaos around you seems to blur — as if time respects your calm. Your feet touch ground like whispers, your eyes never blink, and for one terrifying moment, even machines hesitate to interrupt your form.

stonebound resolve.description:
**Description:**  
A Dwarf may bend, but they do not break. Whether standing before a corporate enforcer, a collapsing tunnel, or a financial meltdown, they draw from an unshakable core of patience, knowledge, and will. When invoked, the Dwarf becomes the immovable object — physically, intellectually, or socially.

**Effect (Narrative):**  
Once per session, the Dwarf may activate *Stonebound Resolve* to exert their legendary resilience and commanding presence in a pivotal moment. Choose one of the following narrative outcomes:

- **Unyielding Stand:** In a situation where retreat or collapse seems inevitable — such as a falling structure, overwhelming enemy push, or equipment failure — the Dwarf holds the line or keeps the system stable long enough for others to act. Nothing moves them unless they will it.
- **Masterstroke Engineering:** You reveal a critical improvement or reinforcement you quietly made earlier — a machine doesn’t fail, a building doesn’t collapse, a rigged device works perfectly. Your foresight with tools, load-bearing, or code alters the course of events at a critical moment.
- **Iron Voice:** You raise your voice, and the room listens. Be it a negotiation, standoff, or mutiny, your words cut through noise like a mining drill. You can defuse a hostile crowd, shame a corrupt executive into silence, or rally workers behind you — not with violence, but with sheer presence.
- **Ale-Blooded Fortitude:** You resist toxins, pain, or mind-altering effects — chemical, magical, or digital — with dwarven stubbornness and liver-born grit. While others fall, hallucinate, or collapse, you remain standing, coherent, and dangerous.

**Flavor Hook:**  
As the Dwarf steps forward, there's a metallic creak, the hiss of pressure, or the rumble of earth — as if the city itself remembers its builders. Their voice booms like it belongs in a council hall or beneath a mountain. Whatever happens next, *they* decide how it ends.

the moment that bends.description:
**Description:**  
An Elf does not rush. Time, like people, bends to their will — subtly, gracefully, without protest. In a crucial instant, they step outside the tyranny of the clock and shift the rhythm of reality itself, seizing control of the moment and reshaping its outcome with charm, foresight, or sheer presence.

**Effect (Narrative):**  
Once per session, the Elf may activate *The Moment That Bends* to reshape a pivotal scene. Choose one of the following effects, each representing their partial dominion over time and society:

- **Second Glance:** Time slows just enough to reconsider, realign, and redirect. You may retroactively "change your mind" — an action you took moments ago didn’t happen the way others perceived. You reached for the right switch, said a different phrase, or made the smarter move. The scene shifts to reflect this rewritten choice.
- **Social Sync:** You subtly bring a conversation or negotiation under your temporal rhythm. Opponents falter, hesitate, or speak too quickly, while you deliver the perfect words. You dominate the moment socially — charming, commanding, or disarming a group or powerful individual with near-supernatural timing.
- **Grace Between Seconds:** You move with elegance outside expected time. You cross a battlefield untouched, arrive "just in time" to save someone, or retrieve a crucial item before disaster hits. No one sees how you got there — only that you did.
- **Foresight Unspoken:** You reveal that you predicted this event — a betrayal, trap, or twist — and subtly laid groundwork earlier. A hidden clause in a contract, a loyal informant, or a planted device turns the situation to your favor.

**Flavor Hook:**  
When *The Moment That Bends* is used, the world seems to inhale. Light stretches slightly. A drop of water pauses mid-fall. People forget what they were saying — and the Elf steps forward, eyes glowing with stillness, as if they were always meant to be in control.

---

the perfect lie.description:
**Description:**  
Truth is brittle. Reality is negotiable. And you? You make people believe what you need them to — whether that’s a forged identity, a fabricated event, or the idea that you were *never even there*. For one moment, the world bends around your story.

**Effect (Narrative):**  
Once per session, the Charlatan may activate *The Perfect Lie* to rewrite the immediate truth of a situation — not with hacking or magic, but through sheer force of charm, timing, and deception. Choose one of the following narrative effects:

- **False Identity:** You instantly convince a crowd, a guard, or even an AI that you are someone else — a trusted superior, a VIP, a corporate agent. You gain access, redirect suspicion, or command obedience. No one questions it… not until it’s far too late.
- **Disappear into the Lie:** Surrounded? Cornered? You vanish — not physically, but narratively. People look where you just were and second-guess what they saw. Were you even there? Did you slip away in the chaos? The truth doesn’t matter. You’re gone.
- **Weaponized Charm:** You talk down a killer, turn an enemy into an ally (for now), or convince someone to betray their own side. For this scene, your words hit like bullets. No coercion, no fear — just belief. You sell them the dream, and they *buy in hard*.
- **Fabricated Reality:** You sell a complete falsehood — that the building’s wired to blow, that reinforcements are coming, that you have diplomatic immunity — and everyone believes it. Alarms go off. People scatter. The story you told **becomes true**, at least for a moment.

**Flavor Hook:**  
When *The Perfect Lie* is activated, everything slows. Your voice takes on the cadence of conviction. Faces around you soften, stiffen, or pale. People glance at each other, unsure of their own memories. And in the quiet that follows, the con becomes **real**.

truthless form.description:
**Description:**  
The Fae are not bound by the rules of this world — not its biology, not its logic, not even its sense of reality. When cornered, threatened, or inspired, a Fae sheds its assumed shape and becomes something… else. Something wrong. Something magnificent. Something unforgettable.

**Effect (Narrative):**  
Once per session, the Fae may invoke *Truthless Form* to temporarily abandon the illusion of “normality” and unleash their alien nature in a way that shocks the world around them. Choose one of the following narrative outcomes:

- **A Body That Shouldn't Be:** You grow wings, extra eyes, serrated arms, or impossible muscle-mass — whatever is needed. For a short time, you can do something no one else could: scale impossible terrain, hold open sealed doors, fly, cling to ceilings, or survive an otherwise lethal blow. This transformation is *beautiful* and *wrong* all at once.
- **Unsettling Beauty:** You shift into a form that entrances, horrifies, or disorients — bioluminescent skin, dozens of blinking eyes, a face that morphs mid-sentence. Enemies hesitate. Crowds part. Those who see you must rethink whether you're divine, cursed, or simply beyond comprehension.
- **We Were Never Alone:** You reveal that your form was *never* truly one creature — wings unfurl, mouths open in your shadow, or small autonomous limbs detach to complete a task. Use this to bypass security, launch a surprise strike, or confuse and terrify those watching.
- **Fold the Scene:** Your perception twists space and identity. You walk out of one alley and into a boardroom. You pass through a locked door without opening it. The world around you doesn’t make sense for a moment — and in that disorientation, you gain advantage.

**Flavor Hook:**  
When *Truthless Form* is triggered, nearby lights flicker in impossible colors. Reality pulses. People forget what they were saying. Some swear they heard music from inside your skull. For a moment, you are not from here — and it shows.

---

tunnel vision.description:

Bonus: Your familiar can use one of your social or psy powers (choose per 2 hours).

---

twisted reflexes.description:

**Passive.**

You can exclude and include targets as you like  
Once per round

You issue a command that rewrites causality.  
  
Choose up to 3 targets who can hear you. Roll Charisma vs Willpower+3 for each.  
  
On failure, they must obey your next verbal command even if it defies logic or time:  
  
“Fall upward,” “Forget your weapon,” “Attack your ally,” etc.

Lasts 1 turn.  
  
If they survive, they may realize your influence after 1 hour, or instantly if someone else intervenes.

ultimate creator.description:
You can create your own augmentations, weapons, and armor. Requires Master Craftier and Aug Master.

ultimate persuasion.description:
You can convince anyone of anything, no matter how unbelievable, using the sheer force of your charm and cunning. Roll Charisma vs target’s Willpower. On success, you convince the target to follow your request or order without question, even if it goes against their best interests. Costs MP and Shock. Action.

---

umbra dash.description:
If you start your movement in dim light or darkness, you can move without provoking Attacks of Opportunity. Reaction. Cost PP.

---

umbral step.description:
You can teleport through shadows, moving up to 2 Zones feet to a location within line of sight that is in dim light or darkness. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Cost PP. Reaction.

- Your word is law—enforced by tradition and threat.

- **Bonus:** You can **sense when someone plans to betray you** (roll Perception vs their Charisma).

---

unbreakable will.description:
Requires Living Legend feat.

You've seen too much to crack.

- Immune to fear, charm, or social debuffs unless from supernatural or divine origin.
- Gain **+2 to all resistance rolls vs mind control or telepathy.**

---

unbroken.description:
Gain +1 to your Shock and MP.

---

underground rebirth.description:
Points Cost: 6  
Penalty: You lose 1 Action on your first turn each combat  
Passive Effect: If you would die, you instead drop to 1 HP and become immune to damage until the start of your next turn (once per day)  
Active Effect: You sink into shadows and reappear in any Zone within long range. All enemies in your current Zone must roll Perception vs your Dexterity or become Blinded for 1 round. Cost 3 MP.

---

undying will.description:
Points Cost: 7  
  
Penalty: You can’t be healed by others  
  
Passive Effect: You can continue to act at 0 HP for 1D3 rounds once per day, then fall unconscious  
  
Active Effect: Instantly heal 2D6+6 HP and remove all non-permanent debuffs. You also gain +2 to all rolls for 2 rounds. Cost 3 PP. Cooldown: Once per combat.

---

unfortunate incident.description:
You make an item or weapon in an enemy's hand blow up; medium range. Roll Charisma vs Difficulty; on success, the item blows up dealing 1d6+1 damage to everyone in the target's immediate range. Costs MP. Reaction.

---

unnatural flexion.description:
**Points**: 1  
**Action Cost**: 1

- **Passive**: Your joints bend in impossible ways. You ignore normal restrictions on tight spaces and gain +1 to Escape or Squeeze checks.
- **Active**: Rearrange your bones with a sickening crunch. For the next round, you cannot be grappled or pinned. **Cost**: 1 PP

---

unravel mind.description:
You flood a target’s consciousness with overwhelming truths.  
**Effect**: Roll Willpower vs Difficulty. On success, target must choose:

- Take **2d6 Shock damage**, or
- Be **Confused** for 2 rounds (acts randomly each round).  
    **Cost**: MP  
    **Action**

---

unreality bloom.description:
Cost: PP — Action  
You plant a seed of unreality in a Zone or target.  
  
For 3 rounds, reality bends—surfaces twist, voices echo backward, gravity reverses or fluctuates.  
  
All rolls in the area take -1 penalty, and anyone using technology must roll to avoid malfunction (Intelligence vs 12).  
  
You may force a Willpower save vs your Charisma+2. On failure, targets gain the “Unstable” condition and must roll twice on actions, taking the worse result for 2 turns.

---

unshackled mind.description:
**Description:**  
You are not bound by muscle or machine. Your mind is your weapon, and reality is your canvas. When you let go — fully, completely — the world bends to your will. For a moment, **you are pure thought**, unrestrained and terrifying.

**Effect (Narrative):**  
Once per session, the Psionic may activate *Unshackled Mind* to unleash the full spectrum of their mental and spiritual power, reshaping a scene with impossible force or devastating precision. Choose one of the following effects:

- **Kinetic Wrath:** You raise your hand — or simply think — and everything moves. Enemies are hurled into walls, vehicles are crushed like cans, bullets stop midair. You become a storm of invisible pressure, levitating above the chaos.
- **Soulfire Surge:** Your body burns, but it’s not flame — it’s thought made plasma. Pyrokinetic energy radiates outward, igniting weapons, melting armor, or drawing runes of flame across your skin. You are untouchable, radiant, and devastating.
- **Biomancer's Grasp:** You twist flesh like wet clay — regrow a shattered bone, turn an enemy's limbs against them, or force a creature to evolve or decay in seconds. Organic matter becomes **yours** to command.
- **Cursed Thought:** You speak a word or think a name, and a psychic curse takes hold. An enemy forgets how to use their powers, loses faith in their allies, or is haunted by hallucinations so vivid they mistake them for death itself.

**Flavor Hook:**  
When *Unshackled Mind* is activated, the air around you warps — heat shimmer, whispers from nowhere, flickering shadows. Your eyes may glow, bleed, or go black. Birds flee. Machines glitch. And for one terrible moment, even the rational minds around you question reality.

---

unspoken name.description:
**Points**: 1  
**Action Cost**: 1

- **Passive**: No one ever remembers your name unless you allow it. Names vanish from documents, tags, and speech.
- **Active**: Prevent someone from saying your name aloud for the next hour. Anyone attempting to say it stutters or forgets. This includes smart systems. **Cost**: 1 MP

---

unstable echo.description:
**Points**: 1  
**Action Cost**: 1

- **Passive**: People sometimes hear your voice even when you’re silent. You gain +1 to social rolls when trying to gaslight or confuse.
- **Active**: Whisper nonsense at a target. They must roll Willpower vs your Intellect+4, on a failure, they think they had a meaningful conversation with you. **Cost**: 1 MP

---

unstoppable attack.description:
You must wield a two-handed weapon; your attack ignores 2 points of armor and deals an additional 1d4+3 damage, but you have a -2 penalty to hit. Costs PP. Action.

---

unstoppable charge.description:
When you use Brutal Charge, if your attack hits, the target must roll Body vs difficulty 12 or be knocked prone. Req. Brutal Charge. Cost PP. Action.

---

unstoppable grapple.description:
You grab and crush with monstrous strength.  
  
Effect: Roll Strength vs target’s Strength or Dexterity. On success, the target is grappled and takes 2d6+4 crushing damage.  
  
Bonus: If target is still grappled next turn, you can slam them for 1d10+2 and toss them into an adjacent Zone (Strength vs Body to resist). This is a Free Action.  
  
Cost: PP.  
  
Type: Action.

---

urban legend.description:
Your reputation precedes you. Once per session, you can invoke your street cred to intimidate or inspire others. Enemies might hesitate to attack you, while allies gain +1 to their next roll. However, your notoriety attracts unwanted attention from rivals or authorities.

---

use weapon as intimidation.description:
You gain a bonus to Intimidation rolls if you have a weapon: +1/+2/+3/+4 for simple/standard/advanced/exceptional weapon.

---

vampiric bloom.description:
Cost: 2 MP & 2 Health  
Action: Yes  
Plant a parasitic seed in a corpse. After 2 turns, it explodes into a writhing organic bloom.  
Passive: Anyone in Zone receives -2 to Psy resistance  
Active Trigger (1x/combat): You can cause it to unleash a psychic scream: Willpower vs 14 or become Stunned (can't use Actions) for 1 round.

---

vanishing act.description:
You can disappear in a cloud of smoke, holographic distortion, or other misdirection. Roll **Dexterity vs Difficulty**. On success, you escape combat or pursuit and reappear in a hidden or safe location within **30 meters**. Costs **PP**. Action.

---

veil of night.description:
Points Cost: 3  
Penalty: -2 penalty to all actions in daylight or under UV light  
Passive Effect: You gain +2 to Stealth rolls in darkness or shadowy environments  
Active Effect: You become invisible until the start of your next turn or until you attack. While invisible, you ignore opportunity attacks and gain +2 to your next attack roll. Cost 1 MP.

---

veil of the unseen war.description:
**Description:**  
Every Drow carries generations of pain, cunning, and resistance in their blood. When pushed to the brink — by injustice, danger, or opportunity — they draw upon their ancestral cunning and mastery of shadows to shift the board in their favor. Whether as saboteurs, insurgents, or quiet revolutionaries, the Drow are never truly cornered.

**Effect (Narrative):**  
Once per session, the Drow may invoke *Veil of the Unseen War* to execute a masterstroke of subterfuge, fear, or rebellion. Choose one of the following narrative effects when activated:

- **Shadow Infiltration:** You reveal that you or your allies had already bypassed security, planted explosives, stolen data, or sabotaged a system — offscreen, in the background, unnoticed. This twist can flip the balance in a mission, break enemy defenses, or reveal a shocking truth.
- **Whispers of Rebellion:** You ignite unrest in the oppressed — workers halt production, prisoners riot, or security forces are distracted by growing unrest. You narratively redirect attention, collapse enemy morale, or create a major distraction.
- **Slip Through the Net:** With preternatural grace and knowledge of systems and shadows, you or a small group escape an otherwise inescapable situation: a sealed room, total lockdown, or overwhelming force. Guards find only silence, smoke, or graffiti scrawled in protest.
- **Mind Like a Trap:** You reveal that you predicted your enemy’s move. You prepared the room, laced the conversation with traps, or set the social board just right. Use this to take control of a negotiation, flip a betrayal back onto the betrayer, or unmask a spy or lie with perfect timing.

**Flavor Hook:**  
When *Veil of the Unseen War* is invoked, lights flicker and go cold, voices distort in comms, and your enemies realize — too late — that the war they thought they were winning was just the part you let them see.

---

veil of the verdant god.description:
Preparation: 7 hours  
Ingredients: Blood of six willing beings and All-Mother’s symbol carved in stone  
Cost: 5 PP  
Effect: You awaken a slumbering sentience in an entire forest or overgrown zone (up to 3 square kilometers). For 24 hours, the land defends itself—roots attack intruders, vines obscure movement, animals act with unified will. You can issue one command per hour to this collective intelligence.

---

veiled threats.description:
Your words are laced with menace, even when polite.

- Gain **+1 to Intimidation rolls** when speaking calmly or smiling.
- On a successful Intimidation check, the target is also **Shaken** for 1 minute, suffering -1 to social rolls.

Your natural attacks (e.g., claws or blades) can inject venom into your targets. On a successful attack, deal an additional 1d6 toxic damage, ignoring armor. Targets must also make a Willpower roll or become poisoned for 2 rounds. Cost PP. Action.

---

verbal uppercut.description:
Your words hit like fists.

verdant conquest.description:
You rapidly overgrow an area with mutant flora.  
  
Effect: Over the next minute, a Zone becomes overrun with aggressive plants:  
  
Provides +2 to Stealth for allies  
  
Enemy movement is halved  
  
Structures take 1d10 damage per turn as roots and vines crush them

Lasts for 4 hours

Your next successful hacking attempt against a hostile system implants a delay-virus. Target system or drone suffers 1d6 ongoing damage for 3 rounds unless rebooted. Cost: MP. Reaction.

virus.description:
If you completely hack a system, you can leave a simple virus. Roll an Intellect check against Difficulty. Costs MP and is a Reaction.

viscera puppeteer.description:
Cost: PP & Health — Action  
You send your blood through the air like threads into a dead or unconscious humanoid. Target must roll Body vs 13  
Effect:  
  
Control the body like a puppet for 1d6+1 rounds.

voice like a fight bell.description:
Your voice gets attention in a crowd.

- Enemies must **roll Intuition vs Charisma** or pause what they’re doing to listen.

voice of ancestors.description:

voice of the avalanche.description:
Your shout ability now deals 2d4+2 S damage.

---

voice of the devilish mind.description:
Once per session, you may **speak in the voice of the *Man with a Devilish Mind***. NPCs and even some psionic enemies will **pause, kneel, or become terrified**, depending on context.  
You may ask a single question or give a cryptic prophecy.  
**Action. Cost MP.**

void crown.description:

\*\*Cost\*\* = 20000  
\*\*Difficulty to craft\*\* = 14

Once per round

wail of the forgotten circuit.description:
**Description:**  
The banshee unleashes a terrifying scream that is not only audible but broadcasts through wireless channels, subverting both the physical and digital realms. This unholy wail is a fusion of anguish, corrupted data, and raw emotion — a cry from beyond the grave, magnified through silicon and steel.

**Effect (Narrative):**  
Once per session, the Banshee may unleash the *Wail of the Forgotten Circuit*. This scream causes one of the following narrative effects, chosen when activated:

- **Mass Panic:** All nearby NPCs (or one key NPC) experience intense fear, confusion, or despair. Guards flee, enemies falter, or a crowd scatters in chaos. Even those unaffected directly are rattled for the remainder of the scene.
- **Digital Possession:** The Banshee may temporarily possess and control a single unsecured or poorly protected machine or android within line of sight. For the duration of a dramatic scene, they may speak through it, issue basic commands, or use it as an extension of their own presence (e.g., turning cameras, opening doors, triggering alarms).
- **Echoes of Death:** For a few moments, characters nearby experience brief flashes of the Banshee’s death — a haunting memory embedded in code. Those affected must justify how this disturbing vision impacts their next action (hesitation, recklessness, compassion, etc.). This can be used to create a pause in combat, stall negotiation, or emotionally destabilize a target.

**Flavor Hook:**  
As the Wail erupts, screens glitch with distorted faces, lights flicker in time with heartbeats that no longer exist, and cold static coats every surface.

---

waking whispers.description:
Points: 2  
Action Cost: 1  
Passive:  
  
You always know when someone lies to you, but not what the lie is specifically about  
  
Gain +1 to Insight and Intimidation-related rolls, can be used outside of combat.  
Active:  
  
Choose a target in speaking range. Roll Willpower vs their Willpower.  
  
On success: implant a disturbing whisper — the target takes -1 to all rolls for 2 rounds and becomes Distracted (can’t use Reactions)  
Cost: 1 MP

walk with me.description:
You say just the right words to shift a scene.

- You can use this feat to **convince a hostile or neutral NPC** to talk or walk away with you from a tense situation.
- Roll **Charisma+2 vs Difficulty**. On success, they follow you out of the scene for at least 1 minute.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.** Once per session.

---

walking corpse reflex.description:
*Your nervous system is ruined, but it still knows how to flinch.*

- **Effect:** When hit by a melee attack, roll 1d6. On a **5-6**, you reduce the damage to **1**.
- **Limit:** Once per Rest.
- **Type:** Reaction.
    
    Cost MP.

---

wall run.description:
You can run against a wall. Costs PP. Action.

---

war cry.description:
You let out a fierce battle cry, inspiring allies. Your allies in the same Zone gain +1 to their next attack roll. Cost PP. Action.

---

war reputation.description:
Your violent reputation precedes you.

- When you enter a scene, you may **roll Charisma + Body vs Difficulty** to cause **Intimidated** status to one NPC for 1 hour.
- Intimidated characters avoid conflict with you unless provoked.  
    **Free Action. Once per Rest.**

---

warden of the wild.description:
You emit an aura of primal dominance over natural life.  
  
Effect: All hostile or neutral animals and beasts in medium range must roll Willpower vs your Charisma+3 or become passive.  
  
Bonus: Allies in range gain +1 to rolls involving animal handling, herbalism, or survival.  
  
Cost: PP  
  
Type: Action.

---

warping gaze.description:
Cost: MP — Action  
You focus your eldritch powers into your eyes, forcing anyone who meets your gaze to witness their worst nightmare. You can use a Reaction to change the target of your gaze.  
  
Target must make a Willpower vs your Intellect+3.  
  
On failure, the target suffers hallucinations, giving them a -1 penalty to all rolls for 1 minute. They also attack at random.  
  
Targets who are immune to fear effects or who succeed the Willpower roll are unaffected.

---

warzone instinct.description:
**Description:**  
You’ve fought in burning cities, corporate black sites, and offworld hellholes. You don’t flinch when bullets fly — you calculate. You don’t panic — you execute. When the chaos hits its peak, your instincts take over, and **every shot counts**.

**Effect (Narrative):**  
Once per session, the Merc may activate *Warzone Instinct* to take absolute control of a chaotic combat scene through sheer tactical mastery and raw destructive power. Choose one of the following effects:

- **Perfect Killzone:** You instantly identify the best vantage, cover, and angles. In a blur of motion, you eliminate multiple enemies up to 3 if their Body is less than 4, otherwise deal 2d10+1 damage, or kill one target instantly, snipe a target through a riot, or clear a room with flashbangs and precision fire. You control the battlefield like a conductor directing death.
- **One Shot, Big Boom:** You line up a shot or place an explosive in exactly the right spot — under a tank’s axle, in a gas main, behind a reinforced wall. The explosion is surgical and cinematic, changing the entire terrain or forcing enemies to scatter.
- **Keep It Together:** Under impossible odds, you rally broken allies, patch up a wound with one hand, and keep laying down fire with the other. Your grit becomes contagious — others stop panicking and start fighting smarter.
- **Ghost in the Crossfire:** With perfect calm, you move through bullets, debris, and chaos — diving, sliding, climbing, firing mid-roll. It looks like luck. It’s not. You eliminate the biggest threat and vanish behind cover before anyone realizes what happened.

**Flavor Hook:**  
When *Warzone Instinct* kicks in, your expression doesn’t change — just your posture. Calm, deadly calm. You start counting distances in your head. Targets move like they’re on rails. Civilians call it luck. Veterans call it **Merc time**.

---

way to perfection.description:
When you reach 0 or below Health, you now still can fight back. You have 1 Action and 1 Reaction. You still lose limbs or organs. Passive.

---

we rise together.description:
**Description:**  
Humans are not the strongest, fastest, or oldest — but when the moment demands it, they adapt, they resist, and they rise. Whether through grit, defiance, or unity, a human can spark a fire in others and change the course of history in the blink of an eye. No one fights alone when a human leads the charge.

**Effect (Narrative):**  
Once per session, the Human may invoke *We Rise Together* to transform a scene through sheer force of will, defiance, or connection. Choose one of the following narrative effects:

- **Last Stand, First Spark:** When everything is collapsing — an ambush, betrayal, or overwhelming enemy force — your courage steadies the group. Allies who would break rally. Despair becomes fury. You hold the line, turning a doomed moment into a legendary one.
- **Improvised Brilliance:** In a moment where no clear path exists, you piece together a solution with whatever is at hand — a broken drone, scraps of code, or a chaotic crowd. Your improvisation opens an escape route, a tactical edge, or a stunning revelation that no specialist would’ve seen.
- **Unified Front:** You coordinate multiple allies, factions, or strangers under a single cause or plan. People listen — not because they must, but because they want to. For one scene, you may narratively unify NPCs or divided groups toward a shared goal, even if they were previously hesitant or hostile.
- **Rebellion Ignited:** You channel the collective anger and hope of the people around you, triggering resistance — from a worker uprising, to prisoners turning on their captors, to a corrupt official backing down. This can be subtle or explosive, but always shifts power away from the oppressors.

**Flavor Hook:**  
As the Human stands up, bloody but unbroken, their words cut through chaos. Others look to them — not for orders, but for hope. And in that moment, the world remembers: you don’t need to be born special to change everything.

---

weaken body.description:
Roll Charisma vs target's Difficulty. On success, the target has a -2 penalty to damage from attacks. Lasts 2 rounds. Costs MP. Action.

weapon proficiency.description:

\*\*Cost\*\* = 9500

- Gain **+1 to all rolls involving social manipulation or reputation**.  
    **Passive.**

weeping idol.description:

Action Cost: 3  
Passive:  
  
You radiate unnatural stillness; enemies take a -1 penalty to being intimidated within short range

You freeze and release psychic energy

**Action**

whirling spin.description:

whirlwind barrage.description:

whirlwind brutality.description:
You unleash a spinning flurry of limb strikes.

Cost: PP. Action.

Choose non hostile target, this target immune to effects of your next transformation (changing of form). It doesn't see you becoming a terrible monster, but it still can have questions about what happened. Target can also try to remember what really happened but taking Intelligence vs your Charisma+5 roll. Action. Cost MP.

whisper of the weave.description:

whisper of the wilds.description:

---

whispering veins.description:
**Points**: 1  
**Penalty**: -1 to resist social effects  
**Passive**: Your blood subtly vibrates with sound. You can communicate silently with others by syncing heartbeats, long range.  
**Active**: Pulse your blood to emit a low-frequency sound that confuses small surveillance devices or bugs. Temporarily disables eavesdropping in your Zone for 1 minute. **Cost: 1 MP**
