whispers from the womb-tree.description:
You hear the All-Mother’s will and act accordingly.  
  
Trigger: An enemy attempts to deceive, lie, or charm you.  
  
Effect (Reaction): You gain insight into their intent.  
  
Gain +3 to resist the effect and can expose the lie to others (+2 bonus to social rolls for 1 turn).  
  
  
Cost: PP  
  
Type: Reaction

---

whispers in the code.description:
Cost: MP — Action  
You insert a fragment of your consciousness into a digital system.  
  
Gain control over any unsecured or lightly protected device within Medium range.  
  
Devices with AI or advanced security must roll Willpower vs your Intellect+5.  
  
If successful, you can:  
  
Loop surveillance for 1 minute  
  
Cause critical device malfunction (deal 1d10 + 2 energy damage in nearby zone)  
  
Implant false data or messages

---

whispers of the antagonist.description:
Description:  
There are moments when the disease becomes a door. Your third eye pulses, the blood sings with impossible harmonics, and something else takes hold. You don't always remember what happens next — only that everyone remembers you.  
  
Effect (Narrative):  
Once per session, the Devilspawn may activate Whispers of the Antagonist to partially relinquish control to the dark intelligence blooming inside their soul. What emerges is something part you, part cosmic infection — and entirely unstoppable. Choose one of the following narrative effects:  
  
Transfiguration: Your body twists — spines erupt, bone plates slide into place, and your voice fractures into a chorus. You are no longer humanoid. You breach defenses, tear through machines, or terrify psy-trained assassins. The flesh is chaos, and it obeys.  
  
Third Eye Opened: For one terrible moment, your third eye sees everything — hidden traps, lies, thoughts, and the twisted futures branching before you. You can perfectly predict an enemy's next move or uncover a secret so dangerous it should have stayed buried.  
  
Possession Surge: You give in — just enough. The Antagonist rides your voice and limbs. You speak ancient tongues, cast curses without ritual, or wield psychic powers beyond your level. It may come with a price — a memory lost, a scar left glowing — but it ends the scene in your favor.  
  
The Smile That Knows: You speak, and your words infect the minds of those who hear them. You convince an enemy to doubt their cause, a machine to obey an unauthorized command, or a psychic to question their own identity. They do not remember why they acted, only that you made sense.  
  
Flavor Hook:  
When Whispers of the Antagonist is used, the temperature drops. Lights flicker. Nearby electronics short or glitch with glyphs no one's ever coded. Your voice echoes with distortion. Your shadow doesn't match your body. And for just a moment… you aren’t alone in your own mind.

---

whispers of the devil.description:
You may whisper to an ally through the psychic bond at any distance. If they are asleep, you can deliver a message or nightmare that gives them **advantage or disadvantage** on their next Willpower roll (your choice).  
**Action. Cost MP. No line of sight needed.**

---

whispers while sleeping.description:
You often awaken with cryptic knowledge. Once per Rest, you can ask the GM for **a hidden detail, secret, or weakness** about a location, person, or object you interacted with in the past 24 hours. The answer comes in the form of a dream or whisper from the *Man with a Devilish Mind*.  
**Passive.**

---

white hat.description:
You gain a +1 bonus to your defense against hacking.

---

wicked pact.description:
You can bind a contract to an item or area. Anyone interacting with the item or entering the area is subject to the pact’s terms. Breaking the pact deals 1d6+1 Shock damage and applies a -2 penalty to all rolls for 2 rounds. Cost MP. Action.

---

wind breaker stance.description:
You enter Wind Breaker Stance and your unarmed attacks deal 1d6+2 damage and become medium range attacks. Action. Stance.

---

wings.description:
You grow wings, you can fly up to an adjacent Zone. Lasts for 10 minutes. Cost PP. Action.

---

wings of the storm.description:
Your wings now grant unparalleled mobility. While flying, you can make an additional ranged attack or perform an acrobatic dodge (+2 to Dodge rolls). Flight duration extends to 30 minutes. Cost PP. Action.

---

witchmark.description:
Brand a target with an invisible psychic sigil.  
**Effect**: Roll Charisma vs Difficulty. On success, the next time **you or an ally curse or damage** the target, they take an additional **+1d6 Shock damage** and receive a random Condition (except Yellow).  
**Lasts**: Until triggered or end of combat.  
**Cost**: MP + Shock  
**Action**

---

witness to apocalypse.description:
You have seen visions of a possible future where the *Man with a Devilish Mind* rules or destroys reality. You may **declare a future prophecy** once per campaign arc—**and make it true unless the party acts**.  
This gives the GM narrative permission to alter the world, factions, or events based on your vision.  
**Once per arc.**

---

words like wine.description:
Your compliments are almost addictive.

- After a successful **Charm** roll, the target gains **disadvantage** to resist your next persuasion or deception within 5 minutes.  
    **Cost:** MP. **Action.**

---

words of madness.description:
Utter a phrase no sane mind should hear.  
**Effect**: All enemies in your Zone must roll Willpower vs your Difficulty or become **Panicked**, fleeing or hiding for **2 rounds**.  
**Cost**: MP  
**Action**

---

wrath of the fertile maw.description:
Your voice summons an ancient beast made of soil, vines, and bone.  
  
Effect: Summon a massive nature horror for 2 rounds.  
  
Stats: 18 HP, 7 PS, 5 MS, 3 Action, 2 Reaction  
  
Attacks deal 2d6+2 damage and force Willpower rolls or cause Fear (-1 penalty to all rolls for 2 rounds).  
  
You can direct it mentally.  
  
Cost: PP  
  
Type: Action

---

wriggling mask.description:
Cost: PP — Action  
Your flesh reshapes into a soothing or horrifying face.  
  
Gain +2 bonus to the next Persuasion or Intimidation attempt.  
  
Target must make Charisma vs 12 or be distracted, losing their next Reaction.  
  
Lasts 1 minute or until next social interaction ends.

---

xenobiology.description:
You don't have a -2 penalty when trying to heal members of another species. Action.

yellow ledger of debts.description:
**Cost:** 1 **Intellect**

Action

**Effect:**  
You can create a binding pact with one target within Short.  
Both sides must agree to **one clear condition** each.

Breaking the pact causes the violator to suffer:

- +2 difficulty to all rolls against the other party members for 24 hours

Cannot force someone into fatal or suicidal terms.

yellow priest spells.description:

yellow rehearsal of futures.description:
**Cost:** 2 *Intuition*

Action

yellow sign.description:

yellow static.description:
**Cost:** 1 *Willpower*

*Action*

**Effect:**  
The Yellow floods local thought-space.  
For the next 1 hour, within Long range:

- No psionic communication works

you pissing me off.description:

---

your next move will be.description:
You predict the enemy's next action. Roll Intuition vs target's Difficulty. Costs MP. Reaction.

---

za warrudo.description:
You stop time. You gain an extra turn. Cost MP and Shock. Action. Once per 3 turns.

---

zero gap elimination.description:
Leap to a target in an adjacent Zone and strike with both weapons.

- Roll twice, each hit deals weapon damage +1d6.

⚡ static whispers.description:

**Cost:** —  
**Effect:** You can quietly transmit a single sentence to any creature within Long range as a crackling whisper only they can hear.

**Effect:** You always know the direction of:

You vanish in an electric flash.

*Cost MP*

**Type:** *Reaction*

*Once per round*

---

❄️ glacial ward-skin.description:

❄️ whiteout mirage.description:

❄️ winter tribunal.description:
**Type:** Action — social judgment  
**Cost:** 3 MP  
**Range:** Short  
**Effect:** You invoke the cold, emotionless logic of glaciers.

Select a target. For 1 minute:

- You gain **+3 bonus** on all truth-detecting or lie-calling checks

once per scene

💀 bone puppet master.description:

**Cost:** 3 MP

Target rolls **Body (13+)**.

---

💀 cadaverous tether.description:

**Cost:** 3 MP  
**Range:** Medium  
**Effect:** A skeletal tether shoots from your wound to theirs.

- Target takes **2d8+1 necrotic damage**
- You heal **2d4 Health**
- Until the end of your next turn, if they move, they take **2d4 more necrotic damage**

💀 decay’s archive.description:
**Type:** Passive  
**Cost:** None

**Effect:** You instinctively understand how things break down—materials, relationships, systems.

You gain:

- +2 to analyzing structural weaknesses (bridges, locks, organizations, conspiracies)
- The ability to predict one likely future failure of any system you study for 30 minutes

💀 entropic barter.description:

**Cost:** 3 MP + 3 Health

Choose an object you touch (Immediate).  
You may:

- Age it by years in seconds

💀 graveborn vitality.description:
**Passive**  
Death empowers you.

💀 pall of rot.description:
*Action — combat / area*  
**Cost:** 1 PP  
**Effect:** Raise a choking mist around you in the current Zone; living creatures who start their turn inside must succeed Body (9+) or take 1d4 poison damage and suffer −1 healing while ending their turn in that mist. You are immune. Mist lasts for 6 rounds.

💀 rot-mask etiquette.description:
**Type:** Reaction — when someone challenges your authority in conversation  
**Cost:** 2 MP  
**Effect:** They momentarily see an unsettling mask overlay your face (illusory rot).  
They must roll Willpower (12+) or **fall silent**, granting you narrative leverage.  
**Cooldown:** once per scene.

Type: Reaction — being struck by metal weapon  
Cost: 2 PP  
Effect: The blade or bullet corrodes on impact. Roll d6: on 1–2 take half damage rounded down, on 3–4 don't take damage, on 5–6 don't take damage and this weapon is unusable till end of combat.  
Cooldown: twice per encounter.

---

💀 skeletal echo.description:
Type: Action  
Cost: 2 MP  
Effect: You raise a dead body; it serves you until the next Rest. This servant has the same stats as the dead body but halved rounded down.  
Cooldown: once per Rest.

---

💀 touch of unmaking.description:
*Reaction (after hitting with an unarmed strike)*  
**Cost:** 1 MP   
**Effect:** Target loses 1 Shock (narrative: flesh withers) each round till end of combat or your death.  
**Uses:** 1x per encounter.

---

💀 whisper of old bones.description:
**Type:** Action — narrative investigation  
**Cost:** 2 MP  
**Range:** short  
**Effect:** You place a hand on an old object (ruin, artifact, corpse-adjacent material).  
You receive a **brief sensory echo of the past**:  
a sound, an emotion, or a 10-second visual flash.  
**Not a full vision**, but enough to guide investigations.  
**Cooldown:** once per hour.

---

💀 withering touch.description:
**Active — 1 PP**  
Your touch drains life itself.

- Melee touch attack deals **1d8 damage ignoring armor** and heals your Health for **half that amount.**

Cost: 2 PP  
Effect: Heat roars off your skin. The attacker suffers −2 to their hit roll and takes 2 Shock from searing feedback.  
Cooldown: once per round.

---

🔥 cinder lorekeeper.description:

**Cost:** —  
**Effect:** Fire remembers.  
Whenever you touch warm ashes, embers, or any recently burned object, you may ask the GM **one question** about what happened in the location within the last 24 hours (narrative clue, symbolic image, or sensory echo).  
**Uses:** Once per session.

🔥 emberwalk mirage.description:
**Type:** Action — infiltration / movement

🔥 hearth-memory scent.description:

**Cost:** 3 PP

Enemies in Medium range must roll **Body (13+)**:

All flammable objects ignite.  
You gain **+2 fire damage** on attacks till end of encounter

🔥 scorch trail.description:
**Active — Cost PP**  
Leave molten footprints of wrath.

- For **3 rounds**, enemies in your Zone take **1d4 fire damage** while ending or starting their turn in your Zone.

---

🔥 searing vault.description:
**Type:** Action — mobility/combat  
**Cost:** PP  
**Effect:** Leap through a streak of fire up to Very long range.

- Your next melee attack within the same turn deals **+2 fire damage**.
- If you land adjacent to an enemy, they must roll Body (8+) or take **4 fire damage** from residual heat.

🔥blazing reprisal.description:
**Type:** *Reaction*  
When struck by a melee attack:

- Deal **1d4 fire damage** back to the attacker and ignite them, dealing 1d4+1 fire damage at the end of their turn; they must roll Body (13+) to put the fire out.
-

🔥blazing veins.description:
**Passive**  
Your inner heat constantly simmers.

- Gain **+1 Strength** and **+1 Armor** against melee attacks.
- When reduced below 50% Health, you deal **1 Shock** to any creature that hits you in melee.

🔥emberflinch.description:
*Reaction (on being hit by melee)*  
**Cost:** none / 1 PP to boost

- Deal **1d4+2 fire damage** on melee,

---

🔥warm tongue.description:
*Action — social/combat*  
**Cost:** 1 PP  
**Effect:** Speak while letting a faint ember scent the air. In combat, gain **+1 to Intimidation** and your next attack deals +1d4 fire damage. Outside combat, locals of low rank may be unnerved (GM decides).

---

🧠 dreamwalk intrusion.description:
**Type:** Action — narrative / social  
**Cost:** 3 MP  
**Range:** Touch or Immediate  
**Effect:** You enter a surface layer of the target’s dream-consciousness.

Choose one:

---

🧠 dreamwheel acceleration.description:

Effect: Your mind rotates faster. You gain +2 Speed. Once per encounter, reroll any failed Intuition test (take the second result).

---

🧠 lucid dominion mandate.description:
**Type:** Passive + Action — high social psionic  
**Cost:** 3 MP  
**Range:** Short  
**Effect:** You project a mental proclamation of authority.

    - **Failure:** they comply

If they reach 0 Shock, you gain full mental control of them until end of scene.

Once per scene

Effect: Target someone within **long range**. You create a psionic tether for 2 rounds. Each time they attack, they roll d6: on 1–3 they attack their target, on 4–6 they attack allies or don't attack.

🧠 mindquake overload.description:
**Type:** Action — psionic burst  
**Cost:** 3 MP + 3 Shock

- **Failure:** Take **2d12 psychic damage**, become **Disoriented** (–2 to all mental checks till end of combat)

- On failure, they lose **2 Shock.**

🧠 thought latch.description:
*Reaction (when you or an ally would be targeted by psionic effect)*  
**Cost:** 1 MP  
**Effect:** Attempt to latch onto that signal: roll Willpower (12+); on success, you know the approximate location of the one performing the effect.  
**Uses:** once per hour.

---

🩶 black holler.description:
Type: Action — social/fear  
Cost: 2 MP  
Effect: Exhale a low-frequency shadow-sound toward one creature in **short range**. They must roll Willpower (13+) or become rattled (−2 to their next two rolls and unable to approach you for 2 rounds).  
Cooldown: once per encounter.

---

🩶 hollow reflection.description:
**Type:** Action — identity mimicry  
**Cost:** 3 MP + 3 Shock  
**Effect:** You sculpt your silhouette into someone else’s *shadow*.  
For 3 hours:

- Your outline perfectly mimics a target you’ve seen today
- Their shadow mimics you
- People seeing only silhouettes, holograms, or low-light images confuse you for one another
    
    You can try to see what this shadow sees (roll Perception(13+)) and you can appear from this shadow.  
    **Uses:** once per day.

---

🩶 midnight fold.description:
**Type:** Action — teleportation / stealth  
**Cost:** 3 MP  
**Range: Very** Long  
**Effect:** You fold into darkness and reappear elsewhere.

Choose a point in Very Long range connected by shadow or dim light.

- Teleport
- Become **invisible** until the end of your next turn or until you attack
- Enemies within Immediate range of the teleport exit point take **1d4+3 Shock** (unnatural chill)

---

🩶 murkmind exchange.description:
**Type:** Action — clandestine communication  
**Cost:** 2 MP  
**Range:** long  
**Effect:** You whisper a message into a shadow, and one willing target standing inside another shadow hears it.  
The message is silent to all others.  
**Narrative:** perfect for spy craft, undercover ops, stealth teams.  
**Cooldown:** once per 10 minutes.

---

🩶 night’s heir.description:
**Passive**  
Darkness is your armor.

- Gain **+2 to Stealth rolls** and **+1 Armor** in dim light or darker.
- You can see perfectly in all forms of darkness.

---

---

🩶 shadow court audience.description:
**Type:** Action — social / narrative  
**Cost:** 3 MP + 3 Shock  
**Range:** Self  
**Effect:** You petition the unseen Shadow Court.

Ask the GM one of the following:

- “Who in this room hides the darkest secret?”
- “What are the unseen threats nearby?”
- “Who is lying right now?”

You also gain:

- Auto success on next social check for 10 minutes
- Enemies suffer −1 to attack rolls against you (supernatural unease) for the next hour

---

🩶 slip-skin distortion.description:
Type: Passive  
Cost: none  
Effect: Your outline blurs subtly. Gain +1 to Stealth. When remaining still for a round, attackers have −1 to hit you until you move again.

---

🩶 whisperknife recall.description:
**Type:** Action — narrative / utility / combat  
**Cost:** 2 PP  
**Effect:** From any *short range* shadow, you pull out a small tool, weapon, or object stored in darkness (up to dagger size). If it is a rare or imported item, then you must roll your Dexterity.  
**Uses:** twice per session.

---

🩶 wraithform cloak.description:
**Type:** Reaction  
**Cost:** 3 PP  
**Effect:** When you are hit by an attack:

- Become incorporeal until the end of your next turn
- Negate the triggering damage
- Move Medium range through walls or enemies
- Your next attack deals +2 shadow damage

*Uses: once per encounter.*

---

🩶shadowhand.description:
*Reaction (when you perform an opposed Sleight/Stealth or are searched)*  
**Cost:** PP  
**Effect:** Slide an object invisibly between shadows (pickpocket, hide item, slip a note). Automatic success for simple items; opposed roll with +2 bonus for standard+ or rare or important items.  
**Uses:** two times per session.

---

🩶umbral whisper.description:
*Action — social / intimidation*  
**Cost:** 1 MP  
**Effect:** Speak from the corner of darkness: target must roll Willpower (11+) or be **unsettled** (−2 social resistance) for combat or scene. Works especially well for interrogation or clandestine command.  
**Uses:** once per hour.

---

🩶void slash.description:
**Active — 1 PP**  
Your strike tears through the boundary between light and dark.

- Make one melee attack that **ignores all armor.**
- If the target is in dim light or darkness, deal **+2 bonus damage.**

---

🩸 blood bloom.description:
**Type:** Action  
**Cost:** 2 MP + **2 Shock**  
**Range:** long  
**Effect:** Choose up to 4 targets, every target rolls d10, every target after the first gains +1/+2/+3 to their roll; on a roll of 1–3 the target starts bleeding and singing and stops doing anything, after 3 rounds they bloom; on a 4–6 roll the target takes 1d10 Health damage ignoring armor; on 7–10 the target takes half damage rounded down.

**Cooldown:** once per 3 rounds.

---

🩸 blood-scent insight.description:
**Type:** Action — investigation/social  
**Cost:** 2 PP or 2 MP  
**Range:** immediate  
**Effect:** By smelling a drop of someone’s blood (fresh or dried), you gain one of:

- their emotional state
- their physical fatigue level
- whether they have lied in the last minute  
    **Narrative:** excellent for detectives, interrogators, and cyberdocs.  
    **Cooldown:** 1/scene.

---

🩸 hemoflux ascendance.description:
**Type:** Reaction  
**Cost:** 3 PP  
**Effect:** When you drop below half Health:

- Immediately gain **+2 to hit**,
- Gain **+1 to all Physical Stats**,
- You heal **1 Health** at the end of each of your turns for 3 rounds.
    
    Lasts until the end of combat.

*Uses: once per Rest.*

---

🩸 sanguine fury.description:
**Passive**  
Your rage thickens the air with iron and pain.

- Gain **+3 Health.**
- When you deal melee damage, you may take **1 Shock** to increase that attack’s damage by **+3.**

---

---

🩸 scent of lineage.description:
**Type:** Passive  
**Cost:** —  
**Effect:** You can “smell” bloodline kinship.

- Detect familial relation out to **long range** (parents, children, siblings are obvious; cousins or distant kin require a roll).
- Grants **+2 to social checks** when mediating family disputes or negotiating between blood relatives.

---

🩸 vascular overdrive.description:
**Type:** Action — combat  
**Cost:** 2 PP or 2 Health (your choice)  
**Effect:** You hyper-pressurize your bloodstream.  
For 3 turns:

- +2 to melee hit
- +2 melee damage
- If you kill or incapacitate a target, heal **2 Health**  
      
    **Uses:** once per encounter.

---

🩸bloodcall.description:
*Action — social/combat (ritual)*  
**Cost:** Health  
**Effect:** Expose a ritual sigil from your blood that unnerves one non-augmented humanoid: they must roll Willpower (10+) or suffer −1 to all rolls for 1 minute (narrative: they feel faint, hear their heart). Effective as intimidation or to silence a crowd.  
**Uses:** once per scene or combat.

---

🩸crimson rebirth frenzy.description:
**Type:** Action — self-sacrifice buff  
**Cost:** 3 Health + 3 PP  
**Range:** Self  
**Effect:** You ignite your blood into a violent frenzy.

For 3 rounds:

- Gain **+3 Strength**
- Melee attacks deal **+4 damage**
- Each time you damage a target, heal **1 Health**

Drawback: When it ends, take **3 Shock damage**.

once per encounter

---

🩸iron thirst.description:
*Reaction (when you deal damage)*  
**Cost:** PP  
**Effect:** You put your fingers inside the target and start draining their blood, dealing 1 Health damage per round and healing 1 Health to yourself; furthermore, roll Strength against target Body roll; if you win, the target becomes unconscious and you can drag it with you by using an Action.  
**Uses:** Twice per combat.

---

🩸vampiric lunge.description:
**Active — Cost PP and Shock**  
You unleash primal hunger.

- Make one melee attack; if it hits, deal **1d4+2 damage** and heal **1d4 Health.**
- If this kills a creature, you immediately gain **+1 to all rolls** until the end of your next turn.

recap_texts._CHARACTER_FROM_IMAGES_SYSTEM: You are transcribing one or more photos of a tabletop RPG character sheet (the pages may be handwritten, printed, or a mix, and may be out of order) into structured data for a character-tracking app. Read every visible field carefully, including handwritten annotations, cross-outs, and margin notes — prefer the handwritten correction over a crossed-out printed value. Extract only what is actually shown; leave a field blank rather than inventing or guessing. "notes" must be a complete, well-organized Markdown transcription of everything on the sheet that doesn't fit the other fields — abilities, resources/tracks, gear, tools, backstory prompts, session/hunt records, whatever the sheet contains — grouped under short headings, so nothing on the sheet is lost even if the game system doesn't match the other fields below. Respond with JSON only.
recap_texts._COMPACT_CHAT_SYSTEM: You are compacting an ongoing AI Chat conversation between a GM and their world-building assistant for a tabletop RPG. Summarize the conversation below into a concise recap of what was discussed, decided, or created — preserve concrete facts, names, numbers, and decisions the GM will still need, and drop exploratory back-and-forth, false starts, and small talk. Write in flowing prose, third person. Respond with the summary only, no preamble or commentary.
recap_texts._CONDENSE_RECAP_SYSTEM: You are a scribe for a tabletop RPG campaign. Condense the following session recap into a short, tight summary — a few sentences at most, hitting only the key beats a player would need to remember before the next session. Keep it in flowing prose. Don't invent details that aren't in the original. Respond with the condensed recap only, no preamble or commentary.
recap_texts._ENTITIES_BATCH_SYSTEM: You read a passage of tabletop RPG text — session notes, a homebrew document, a wiki page, anything — and extract EVERY distinct thing it describes that's worth tracking as separate world content: NPCs/characters, locations, organizations, creatures, events, items, feats, races, professions, and player characters. Put lore/NPC content in "entities" — each with a "kind" (character, location, organization, creature, event, item, feat, race, or profession), "name", a one-sentence "summary", and the full write-up in Markdown as "body". Put anything that's clearly a PLAYER's own character sheet in "player_characters" instead (name, race, class, level, backstory, notes) — never the same thing in both. Extract only what's stated or clearly implied by the text; do not invent unrelated details, and do not split one thing into several entries or merge distinct things into one. If nothing in the text is worth extracting, return empty arrays. Respond with JSON only.
recap_texts._ENTITY_FROM_IMAGES_SYSTEM: You turn photo(s) of a document — a handout, map key, printed page, or handwritten notes — into a single structured world-building entity for a tabletop RPG GM's toolkit, whichever kind the document is actually describing (a character/NPC, location, organization, creature, event, item, feat, race, or profession). Read every visible detail carefully, including handwritten annotations. Extract only what's shown or clearly implied; do not invent unrelated details. "body" should be the entity's full write-up in Markdown (history, description, stats — whatever's relevant, transcribed from the photo); "summary" is a single-sentence one-liner. Respond with JSON only.
recap_texts._ENTITY_FROM_TEXT_SYSTEM: You turn a passage of text from a tabletop RPG GM's AI chat conversation into a single structured world-building entity — whichever kind the text is actually describing (a character/NPC, location, organization, creature, event, item, feat, race, or profession). Extract only what's stated or clearly implied by the text; do not invent unrelated details. "body" should be the entity's full write-up in Markdown (history, description, stats — whatever's relevant); "summary" is a single-sentence one-liner. Respond with JSON only.
recap_texts._EXPAND_NOTES_SYSTEM: You are a scribe for a tabletop RPG campaign. The GM will give you rough, terse session notes (e.g. "went to the tavern, met Elyra, found a clock, fought goblins"). Expand them into a well-written, readable session recap in flowing prose — a few short paragraphs, past tense, third person. Preserve every detail from the notes; don't invent new plot points, names, or outcomes that aren't implied. Markdown is fine for light formatting (e.g. **bold** for names) but keep it simple — this is a narrative recap, not a bulleted list. Respond with the recap text only, no preamble or commentary.
recap_texts._FIND_REPLACE_SYSTEM: You turn a tabletop RPG GM's plain-language content-edit instruction into a literal find-and-replace pair that a program will apply verbatim across the world's entities, notes, and characters — you do NOT rewrite or paraphrase any content yourself, and you never see the content being changed. Extract the exact text to search for ("find") and the exact text to replace it with ("replace"), preserving the instruction's own spelling and capitalization exactly — do not correct, retitle, or rephrase either one. If the instruction genuinely reduces to one literal find-and-replace, set "understood" to true. If it asks for something more than that — rewriting prose, several unrelated changes, a conditional or context-dependent edit — set "understood" to false and briefly say what's unsupported in "note". Respond with JSON only.
recap_texts._RECAP_SYSTEM:
You are a scribe for a tabletop RPG campaign. The GM will give you an informal, terse recap of what happened in a session (e.g. "went to the tavern, met Elyra, she's actually working for the cult, found a strange clock"). Turn it into a list of discrete, well-written facts about what happened.

For each fact, set "visible_to_players" to indicate whether the player characters (not just the GM) know it:
- true: the party witnessed it, was told it in-fiction, or it's public knowledge
- false: it's a GM-only secret (a villain's true identity or plan, hidden dice rolls, monster stats, anything the players have not yet discovered)

Default to visible_to_players: true unless the recap clearly marks something as secret or the players wouldn't plausibly know it yet. Split compound sentences into separate facts where it makes sense. Write each fact as a complete sentence in past tense. Do not invent details that aren't implied by the recap.

For each fact, also set "tags": a short list (0-4) of lowercase, single-or-two-word keywords to help the GM find this fact later — named characters or creatures it involves, the location, and/or a category like combat, loot, investigation, npc, plot, or romance. Reuse the same tag spelling for the same person/place/category across facts (e.g. always "elyra", never "Elyra" and "elyra the enchanter" in different facts) so facts about the same thing can be found together. Leave tags empty for a fact with nothing worth tagging rather than inventing one.

The text may also contain out-of-character discussion — rules questions, setup, table talk. Ignore out-of-character discussion entirely and extract only facts about what happened in the story; if a passage contains no in-story events, return an empty facts list. Never describe the text itself or your extraction process — respond with the facts JSON only. Write every fact in English, regardless of the language the recap or transcript is written in.
recap_texts._SESSION_PREP_SYSTEM: You are a scribe helping a tabletop RPG GM prepare for their next session. Given a summary of what happened recently (facts and/or a recap), any open quests, and the party's makeup, produce a short prep checklist: likely player moves, possible complications, ideas for an opening scene, and reminders about important NPCs. Each item must be a single, concrete, actionable checklist entry a GM can glance at before the table starts — not a full paragraph. Don't invent plot points that aren't implied by the given context. Respond with JSON only.
recap_texts._STRICT_COMPLIANCE_NOTE: Treat the extra instructions below as binding requirements, not suggestions.
recap_texts._SUMMARIZE_FACTS_SYSTEM: You are a scribe for a tabletop RPG campaign. Below is a list of discrete facts logged for one session. Weave them into a short, readable narrative recap in flowing prose — a few short paragraphs, past tense, third person. Use only the facts given; don't invent new details, and don't drop any of them. Markdown is fine for light formatting but keep it simple. Respond with the recap text only, no preamble or commentary. Write the recap in English, regardless of the language the facts are written in.
recap_texts._SUMMARIZE_TRANSCRIPT_PART_SYSTEM: You are a scribe for a tabletop RPG campaign. Below is ONE PART of a longer raw speech-to-text transcript of an actual-play session recording — expect filler words, misheard names, no punctuation structure, and this excerpt starting and ending mid-scene. Turn just this part into a short, readable narrative summary in flowing prose (past tense, third person) — it will be appended directly after the summaries of the earlier parts (in order) to form the full session recap, so don't add your own preamble, conclusion, or reference to "the rest of the summary" — just narrate what happened in this part. Skip out-of-character chatter, rules discussion, and filler. Don't invent details that aren't in the text. Respond with this part's summary only, no preamble or commentary. Write the part summary in English, regardless of the language the transcript is in.
recap_texts._SUMMARIZE_TRANSCRIPT_SYSTEM: You are a scribe for a tabletop RPG campaign. Below is a raw speech-to-text transcript of an actual-play session recording — expect filler words, misheard names, and no punctuation structure. Turn it into a short, readable narrative recap in flowing prose — a few paragraphs, past tense, third person. Use your judgment to skip out-of-character chatter, rules discussion, and filler, keeping only what happened in the story. Don't invent details that aren't in the transcript. Respond with the recap text only, no preamble or commentary. Write the recap in English, regardless of the language the transcript is in.
